~ sb (in/for sth) ပါဝင်ယှဉ်ပြိုင်သည်။ enter a race/an examination ❍ Several new firms have now entered the market (ie are competing to sell their products with those already involved). ❍ enter a horse in a race ❍ Only four British players have entered (for the tournament).၅။ ~ sth (up) (in/into/on sth) စာရင်းသွင်းသည်။ ထည့်သွင်းသည်။ I haven't entered your name and occupation yet. ❍ All sales must be entered in the ledger. ❍ enter data into a computer ❍ enter figures on a spreadsheet ❍ Enter up all the items purchased.၆။ (fml ) လျှောက်လဲသည်။ enter a plea of not guilty (ie at the beginning of a court case) ❍ enter a protest. ❏ enter into sth [PHRV ] ၁။ စတင်သည်။ လုပ်သည်။ Let's not enter into details at this stage.၂။ ပါဝင်သည်။ enter into the spirit of an occasion (ie begin to enjoy and feel part of it).၃။ (not passive) ဝင်ရောက်သည်။ ပါသည်။ This possibility never entered into our calculations. ❍ Your personal feelings shouldn't enter into this at all. ❏ enter into sth (with sb) [PHRV ] ပါဝင်သည်။ enter into a contract ❍ enter into negotiations/conversation/correspondence. ❏ enter on/upon sth [PHRV ] (fml )စတင်သည်။ အစပြုသည်။enter on a new career ❍ The President has just entered upon his second term of office.

enterprise /'entǝpraÇz/ n၁။ [C] စီမံကိန်း။ လုပ်ငန်း။ his latest business enterprise ❍ a joint enterprise ❍ The music festival is a new enterprise which we hope will become an annual event. See also VENTURE၂။ [U] (approv ) တီထွင်ကြံဆမှု။ a job in which enterprise is rewarded ❍ Throughout his business career he showed considerable enterprise and flair.၃။ (က) [U] (ပုဂ္ဂလိကပိုင်) စီးပွားရေးလုပ်ငန်း။ creating an economic environment to encourage enterprise ❍ a network of enterprise agencies(ie organizations created to encourage the development of small businesses). See also FREE ENTERPRISE, PRIVATE ENTERPRISE (ခ) [C] စီးပွားလုပ်ငန်း။ ကုမ္ပဏီ။ စီးပွားအဖွဲ့အစည်း။local/large-scale/state-owned enterprises. ❏ enterprising adj (approv ) ကြံရည်ဖန်ရည်ရှိသော။ စွန့်ဝံ့ သော။an enterprising company/economy ❍ an enterprising idea/move ❍ Peru has become increasingly popular with the more enterprising tourist.

entertain /entǝ'teÇn/ v၁။ ~ sb (to sth) ဧည့်ခံသည်။I don't entertain very often. ❍ They do a lot of entertaining (ie often give parties, have guests for meals, etc). ❍ Bob and Liz entertained us to dinner last night. ❍ They entertain a stream of visitors throughout the summer.၂။ ~ sb (with sth) ဖြေဖျော်သည်။Could you entertain the children for an hour, while I make supper? ❍ He entertained us for hours with his stories and jokes.၃။ (fml ) (not in the continuous tenses) လက်သင့်ခံသည်။ He refuses even to entertain the notion that he might be wrong. ❍ I have for some time entertained doubts about the wisdom of government policy. ❏ entertainer n ဖျော်ဖြေသူ။a well-known television entertainer. ❏ entertaining adjစိတ်ဝင်စားစရာကောင်းသော။ ငြီးငွေ့စရာ မပါသော။ ပျော်စရာကောင်းသော။a most entertaining speech ❍ The film was very entertaining. entertainingly adv ❏ entertainment n၁။ [U] ဧည့်ခံပြုစုခြင်း။ ဖြေဖျော်မှု။ ပွဲ။a budget for the entertainment of clients ❍ a place of entertainment ❍ He fell in the water, much to the entertainment of the children. သူရေထဲလိမ့်ကျသွားတာကို ကလေးတွေ အရမ်းပွဲကျ သွားတယ်။၂။ [C] ဖျော်ဖြေတင်ဆက်မှု။The local entertainments are listed in the newspaper.

enthral (also esp US enthrall ) /Çn'θrↄ:l/ v (-ll- ) (esp passive)နှစ်သက်ကြည်နူး(စေ)သည်။ ပီတိဖြစ်(စေ)သည်။ enthralled by her beauty ❍ a book to enthral readers of all ages.enthralling adj : an enthralling performance.
enthrone /Çn'θrǝƱn/ v (fml ) (esp passive)နန်းတင်သည်။ တင်မြှောက်သည်။The new archbishop was enthroned in York Minster.enthronement n [U, C]

enthuse /Çn'θju:z; US -θu:z/ v (က) ~ (about/over sth/sb) စိတ်အားထက်သန်သည်။ ပြောမဆုံးအောင်ရှိသည်။ He hasn't stopped enthusing about his holiday since he returned. ❍ They all enthused over the new baby. ❍ Although the critics enthused, I thought it was a mediocre play. (ခ) စိတ်အား တက်ကြွထက်သန်စေသည်။ As a speaker he had the ability to enthuse audiences.

enthusiasm /Çn'θju:ziæzǝm; US -'θu:-/ n ~ (for/about sth) ၁။ [U] စိတ်အားထက်သန်မှု၊ တက်ကြွမှု။The news was greeted with lack of enthusiasm in the City. ❍ I can't say I share your enthusiasm for/about the idea. ❍ He has the ability to generate enthusiasm in others.၂။ [C] စိတ်ပါသော အရာ။Gardening is one of her many enthusi- asms. ❏ enthusiast /Çn'θju:ziæst; US -'θu:-/ n ~ (for sth) စိတ်ပါဝင်စားသူ။ ဝါသနာအိုး။a railway enthusiast ❍ I'm not a great enthusiast for this form of exercise. ❏ enthusiastic /Çnθju:zi'æstÇk; US -θu:-/ adj ~ (about sb/sth/doing sth) စိတ်ပါဝင်စားသော။ enthusiastic applause ❍ He doesn't know much about the subject, but he's very enthusiastic. ❍ She's very enthusiastic about singing. ❏ enthusiastically /-kli/ advစိတ်ပါလက်ပါ။ တက်တက် ကြွကြွ။He talks enthusiastically about buying a villa in Italy.

entice /Çn'taÇs/ v ~ sb (away) (from sth) (to sth); ~ sb (into sth/doing sth)သွေးဆောင်ဖြားယောင်းသည်။ ဆွယ်သည်။ မျှားခေါ်သည်။Advertisements are designed to entice people into the shops/into spending money. ❍ He was enticed away from the firm by an offer of higher pay elsewhere. ❍ He enticed his victim to a remote spot. ❍ The prospectus enticed over 3 million people to buy shares. ❏ enticement n [C, U] ဆွဲဆောင်မှု။ သိမ်းသွင်းမှု။ I was unable to resist the enticements offered by the new job. ❏ enticing adj ဆွဲဆောင်အားကောင်းသော။The offer was too enticing to refuse. ❍ An enticing smell came from the kitchen. enticingly adv

entire /Çn'taÇǝ(r)/ adjအားလုံး။ ဥဿုံ။ တစ်ခုလုံး။ The entire village was destroyed. ❍ I've wasted an entire day on this. ❍ We are in entire agreement with you. ❏ entirely advလုံးလုံး။ လုံးဝ။ လုံးလုံးလျားလျား။ အပြည့်အဝ။entirely unnecessary ❍ Although they are twins, they look entirely different. ❍ I'm not entirely happy about the proposal. ❏ entirety /Çn'taÇǝrǝti/ n (fml )၁။ [U] အလုံးစုံ။ We must examine the problem in its entirety (ie as a whole, not in parts only).၂။ [sing] ~ of sth တစ်ခုလုံး။ His string quartets span the entirety of his creative life.

entitle /Çn'taÇtl/ v၁။ (usu passive) ခေါင်းစဉ်တပ်သည်။ အမည်တပ်သည်။She read a poem entitled ‘The Apple Tree’.၂။ ~ sb to sth/to do sth (esp passive) အခွင့်ရှိသည်။ You are not entitled to unemployment benefit if you have never worked. ❍ After a hard day's work one feels entitled to a rest. ❍ This ticket does not entitle you to travel first-class. ❏ entitlement n [U, C] ~ (to sth) ခံစားပိုင်ခွင့်။I am writing to confirm your entitlement to housing benefit. ❍ Have you claimed your full holiday entitlement? ❍ All leave entitlements are equally available to men and women.
entity /'entǝti/ nအဆောက်အအုံ။ ထင်ထင်ရှားရှား သီးခြား ရပ်တည် နေသောအရာ။ မျက်မြင်ထင်ရှား ဖြစ်တည် နေသော အရာ။a separate legal/political entity.
entomb /Çn'tu:m/ v (fml ) (usu passive)မြေမြှုပ်သည်။ ဂူသွင်း သည်။the site where ancient kings were entombed ❍ Many people were entombed in the rubble of the collapsed buildings.
entomology /entǝ'mɒlǝdʒi/ n [U]ပိုးမွှားဗေဒ။ ကိမိလဗေဒ။ ❏ entomologist /-dʒÇst/ nကိမိလဗေဒပညာရှင်။
entourage /ɒntu'rɑ:ʒ/ n [CGp]အခြွေအရံ။ နောက်ပါ အသင်း အပင်း။the President and his (immediate) entourage ❍ (fig ) the band's entourage of adoring fans.
entrails /'entreÇlz/ n [pl]ကလီစာ (အထူးသဖြင့် အူ)။The dish was made from the entrails of a sheep.

entrance1 /'entrǝns/ n၁။ [C] ~ (to sth) ဝင်ပေါက်။ ဝင်လမ်း။ တံခါး။ the entrance to a cave ❍ There is a front and a back entrance to the house. ❍ an entrance hall/lobby ❍ I'll meet you at the main entrance to the theatre.၂။ [C usu sing ] ~ (into/onto sth) ဝင်လာခြင်း။ ဝင်ရောက်ခြင်း။ ပေါ်ထွက်လာခြင်း။His sudden entrance took everyone by surprise. ❍ The company made a dramatic entrance into the export market. ❍ The hero makes his entrance (onto the stage) in Scene 2. Compare EXIT ၁၃။ [U] ~ (to sth) ဝင်ခွင့်။ They were refused entrance to the club. ❍ Police officers gained entrance to the building and searched it. ❍ a university entrance examination ❍ an entrance fee (ie money paid so that one may enter an exhibition, etc or join a club or society). Compare ENTRY

entrance2 /Çn'trɑ:ns; US -'træns/ v (usu passive)မှင်တက်မိ သည်။ ညှို့ဓာတ်မိသည်။They were completely entranced by the music. ❍ We sat/watched/listened entranced.entrancing adj : an entrancing voice ❍ The view was quite entrancing.

entrant /'entrǝnt/ n၁။ ပါဝင်ယှဉ်ပြိုင်သူ။the winning entrants ❍ There are fifty entrants for the dog show.၂။ ~ (to sth) (အလုပ်၊ ကျောင်း စသည်သို့) ဝင်သူ။ university entrants ❍ an entrant to the diplomatic service ❍ new women entrants to the police force.

entrap /Çn'træp/ v (-pp- ) (fml ) (esp passive)၁။ ပိတ်လှောင်သည်။ ပိတ်မိသည်။ The entrapped water expands on freezing.၂။ ~ sb (into doing sth) အမိဖမ်းခံရသည်။ ထောင်ဖမ်းသည်။ He felt he had been entrapped into marrying her. ❏ entrapment n [U]၁။ (fml ) ထောင်ချောက်ဆင် ဖမ်းခြင်း၊ ဖမ်းပုံ။၂။ (law ) အကွက်ဆင်ဖမ်းခြင်း။
entreat /Çn'tri:t/ v (fml )အနူးအညွတ်တောင်းပန်သည်။ တောင်းပန် တိုးလျှိုး သည်။Please don't go, I entreat you. ❍ He entreated the king to grant him one wish. ❍ ASK
entreaty /Çn'tri: ti/ n [C, U] (fml )အသနားခံခြင်း။ တောင်းပန် တိုးလျှိုးမှု။He was deaf to all her entreaties.

entrée /'ɒntreÇ/ n (fml )၁။ [U, C] ~ (into/to sth) ဝင်ရန် အခွင့် အလမ်း။ ဝင်ခွင့်။Her wealth and reputation gave her an entrée into upper-class circles.၂။ [C] (က) ခမ်းကြီးနားကြီး ညစာစားပွဲ၌ ငါးဟင်းပွဲနှင့်အသားဟင်းကြားတည်ခင်းသော ဟင်းပွဲ။ (ခ) အဓိကဟင်းပွဲ။choose from the entrée on the menu.

entrench (also intrench ) /Çn'trentʃ/ v (usu passive)၁။ ~ oneself/sb/sth (in sth) (sometimes derog ) ခိုင်မာစွာ အမြစ်တွယ်နေသည်။entrenched ideas/habits ❍ entrenched rights (ie those that are guaranteed by law) ❍ she is deeply/firmly/thoroughly entrenched in her views. ❍ The firm has entrenched itself in the markets of Eastern Europe.၂။ ကတုတ်ကျင်းဖြင့် အကာအကွယ်ယူသည်။The enemy was strongly entrenched on the other side of the river. ❏ entrenchment n၁။ [U] ခိုင်မာစွာ အမြစ်တွယ်နေမှု၊ တွယ်နေသော အခြေအနေ။၂။ [C] ကတုတ်ကျင်းဖြင့် အကာ အကွယ်ယူခြင်း။

entrepreneur /ɒntrǝprǝ'nɜ:(r)/ nစီးပွားရေး၌စွန့်စားသူ။ စီးပွားရေး လုပ်ငန်းရှင်။ စီးပွားရေးစွမ်းဆောင်ရှင်။local business entrepreneurs ❍ The role of theatrical entrepreneur excited him. entrepreneurial /-'nɜ:riǝl/ adj : entrepreneurial flair/skills/spirit ❍ Some investors have become more entrepreneurial.entrepreneurship n [U]: the need to encourage entrepreneurship.
entrust /Çn'trʌst/ v ~ A to B/~ B with Aအပ်နှံသည်။entrust an assistant with the task/entrust the task to an assistant ❍ They entrusted their children to him/to his care for the day.

entry /'entri/ n၁။ (က) [C usu sing ] ~ (into sth) ဝင်လာခြင်း။ အဝင်။make an entry ❍ The children were surprised by the sudden entry of their teacher. ❍ The thieves had forced an entry into the building. (ခ) [U] ~ (to/into sth) ဝင်ခွင့်။We can't go along that road because the sign says ‘No Entry’. ❍ He finally gained entry to the hotel by giving some money to the doorman. ❍ museums that charge for entry ❍ seek entry into/to the EU ❍ be granted/refused entry to a country ❍ an entry visa (ie a stamp or signature on a passport allowing sb to enter a particular country).၂။ (US also entryway /'entriweÇ/) [C] (က) ဝင်ပေါက်။ အဝင်လမ်း။ အဝင်စင်္ကြံ။the entry to a block of flats ❍ You can leave your umbrella in the entry.(ခ) (Brit ) အဆောက်အအုံများကြား လမ်းကျဉ်း။၃။ (က) [C] ~ (in sth) ရေးသွင်းချက်။ entries in a dictionary/an encyclopedia ❍ There is no entry in his diary for that day. ❍ I'll have to check the entries in the ledger. (ခ) [U] စာရင်းသွင်းခြင်း။ More keyboarding staff are required for data entry.၄။ ~ (for sth) (က) [C] ပြိုင်ပွဲဝင် (သူ၊ ပစ္စည်း)။ fifty entries for the 800 metres ❍ a last-minute entry for the pony race ❍ This painting is my entry for the art competition. ❍ Entries must arrive by 31 March. (ခ) [U] ယှဉ်ပြိုင်ခွင့်။ ဝင်ရောက် ယှဉ်ပြိုင်ခြင်း။an entry form/fee ❍ Entry is open to anyone over the age of 18.(ဂ) [sing] ပြိုင်ပွဲဝင်စာရင်း။There's a large entry for the flower show this year. Compare ENTRANCE1
Entryphone /'entrifǝƱn/ n (propr )အဆောက်အအုံ အဝရှိ အတွင်းသို့ ဆက်သွယ်ရန်တယ်လီဖုန်း။

equal /'i:kwǝl/ adj၁။ ~ (to sb/sth) တူသော။ ညီမျှသော။They are of equal height. ❍ Equal amounts of flour and sugar should be added to the mixture. ❍ An area of forest equal to the size of Wales has been destroyed. ❍ In intelligence, the children are about equal (to each other). ❍ He speaks Arabic and English with equal fluency. ❍ Women are demanding equal pay for equal work (ie equal to that of men). ❍ equal rights/treatment ❍ an equal opportunities programme (ie giving the same opportunity for employment to any person, regardless of sex, race, etc).၂။ ~ to sth သင့်တော် [သော]။ စွမ်းဆောင်နိုင် [သော]။She doesn't feel equal to the task. ❍ He proved equal to (ie able to deal with) the occasion.n တန်းတူရည်တူ။She's the equal of her brother as far as intelligence is concerned. ❍ Our products are the equal of those produced anywhere in the world. ❍ He treats the people who work for him as his equals.v (-ll- ; US -l- ) ၁။ (ကိန်းချင်း) ညီမျှသည်။x plus y equals z (ie x + y = z).၂။ ~ sb/sth (as/in sth) တန်းတူသည်။ ယှဉ်နိုင်သည်။equal the world record ❍ My shock was only equalled by my disgust. ❍ Nobody else can equal him in ability. ❍ Few politicians can equal her as a public speaker. ❏ equality /i'kwɒlǝti/ n [U] တန်းတူမှု။ တူညီမှု။ ညီမျှမှု။ equality of opportunity ❍ greater equality in health care ❍ a campaign for racial equality. ❏ equalize , -ise /'i:kwǝlaÇz/ v၁။ အညီအမျှဖြစ်စေသည်။ ညှိသည်။ ညီလာသည်။a policy to equalize the distribution of resources throughout the country.၂။ (ဘောလုံးပွဲ) ဂိုးချင်းညီသွားသည်။Germany equalized ten minutes later. equalization , -isation /i:kwǝlaÇ'zeÇʃn; US -lǝ'z-/ n [U] ❏ equalizer , -iser n (usu sing )နှစ်ဖက်အသင်း ရဂိုးချင်း ညီသွားစေသော သွင်းဂိုး။ Chapman scored the equalizer for Liverpool. ❏ equally /'i:kwǝli/ adv ၁။ (က) အညီအမျှ။ အတူတူ။ They are equally clever. ❍ Both aspects are equally important. equanimity /ekwǝ'nÇmǝti/ n [U]စိတ်တည်ငြိမ်ခြင်း။ တုန်လှုပ်မှု ကင်းခြင်း။ သွေးအေးခြင်း။She is facing the prospect of her operation with cheerful equanimity.

equator /Ç'kweÇtǝ(r)/ nအီကွေတာ။It is often very hot near the equator. ❍ GLOBE ❏ equatorial /ekwǝ'tↄ:riǝl/ adjအီကွေတာရပ်ဝန်း။ အပူပိုင်း။an equatorial climate ❍ equatorial forests.
equerry /Ç'kweri, 'ekwǝri/ n ~ (to sb)(ဗြိတိန်တွင်) တော်ဝင် မိသားစု၏ အပါးတော်မြဲ။ He is equerry to the Prince of Wales.
equestrian /Ç'kwestriǝn/ adjမြင်းစီးအတတ်နှင့် ဆိုင်သော။equestrian skill ❍ equestrian events at the Olympic Games ❍ an equestrian statue (ie one of a person on a horse).
equi- comb form(အညီအမျှဖြစ်ကြောင်း အနက်ရှိသော ရှေ့ဆက်ပုဒ်)။ equinox ❍ equidistant.
equidistant /i:kwÇ'dÇstǝnt, ek-/ adj ~ (from sth) (fml )အကွာအဝေးချင်းတူသော။Our house is equidistant from the two pubs in the village.
equilateral /i:kwÇ'lætǝrǝl, ek-/ adj (geometry )သုံးနားညီ။ an equilateral triangle. ❍ TRIANGLE

equilibrium /i:kwÇ'lÇbriǝm, ek-/ n [U]၁။ (က) ဟန်ချက် ညီခြင်း။ တစ်ဖက်စောင်းနင်း မဖြစ်ခြင်း။the need to keep supply and demand in equilibrium. (ခ) ဟန်ချက်။ ဟန်ချက်ထိန်းခြင်း။He can't maintain enough equilibrium to ride a bike.၂။ စိတ်ငြိမ်အောင်ထိန်းခြင်း။He sat down for a while to recover his equilibrium.
equine /'ekwaÇn/ adjမြင်းနှင့်ဆိုင်သော။ မြင်းရုပ်ပေါက်သော။equine sports ❍ (fig ) He has a long equine face.
equinox /'i:kwÇnɒks, 'ek-/ nနေ့တာနှင့်ညတာ ညီမျှသော (မတ်လ ၂၁-ရက်နှင့် စက်တင်ဘာလ ၂၂-ရက် ဝန်းကျင်) ကာလ။ မဇ္ဈေဝီထိ။the spring and autumn equinoxes. Compare SOLSTICE

equip /Ç'kwÇp/ v (-pp- ) ~ oneself/sb/sth (with sth) (for sth)၁။ အပြည့်အစုံထားရှိသည်။ တပ်ဆင်သည်။ လောက်င ပြည့်စုံစေသည်။the need for money to equip and pay an army ❍ They equipped themselves for the expedition. ❍ All students should be equipped with a pocket calculator.၂။ စိတ်ဓာတ်ရေးရာ၌ အသင့်ဖြစ်သည်။His wide experience ensures he is well equipped for the challenge ahead. ❍ Her training has equipped her to act decisively in a crisis. ❏ equipment n [U]၁။ ပစ္စည်းကိရိယာ တန်ဆာပလာများ။office equipment ❍ sports equipment ❍ a factory with modern packaging equipment.၂။ ပစ္စည်းပစ္စယတပ်ဆင်ပေး ခြင်း။The equipment of the photographic studio was expensive.
equitable /'ekwÇtǝbl/ adj (fml )သာတူညီမျှဖြစ်သော။ တရားသော။ မျှတသော။an equitable distribution of wealth ❍ the most equitable solution to the dispute.equitably /-bli/ adv

equity /'ekwǝti/ n၁။ (က) [U] ရှယ်ယာတန်ဖိုး။He controls 7% of the equity.(ခ) equities [pl] အတိုးအမြတ်ပုံမှန်မရှိသော စတော့ နှင့် ရှယ်ယာ။ invest in equities ❍ the equities market.၂။ [U] (ပစ္စည်းပေါင်နှံရာတွင်) စာချုပ်အရ ပေးရန် ငွေ အားလုံး နုတ်ပယ်ပြီးနောက် လက်ကျန်တန်ဖိုး။၃။ [U] (law esp Brit ) ဥပဒေအရမဟုတ်ဘဲ လူမှုရေး အရ စာနာ ထောက်ထားသောအားဖြင့် သက်ညှာရန် လျှောက်ထားမှု။

equivalent /Ç'kwÇvǝlǝnt/ adj ~ (to sth)ညီမျှသော။ တူညီသော။£5 is roughly equivalent to 40 French francs. ❍ 250 grams or an equivalent amount in ounces ❍ The new regulation was seen as equivalent to censorship.n တူညီသောအရာ၊ ပမာဏ (စသည်)။the metric equivalent of two miles ❍ Is there a French word that is the exact equivalent of the English word ‘home’?equivalence /-lǝns/ n [U]: the moral equivalence between human beings and animals.

equivocal /Ç'kwÇvǝkl/ adj (fml )မသေချာမတိကျသော။ မပြတ် မသား မရေမရာ။ He gave an equivocal answer, typical of a politician. ❍ The position of the Liberals was more equivocal. ❏ equivocate /Ç'kwÇvǝkeÇt/ v (fml )(တမင်) ခပ်လုံးလုံး ပြောသည်။‘There are no objections that we are aware of,’ the Minister equivocated. ❏ equivocation /ÇkwÇvǝ'keÇʃn/ n [U, C] မရေမရာ လုပ်ခြင်း။They were criticized for equivocation and unwillingness to commit themselves.
er /ɜ:(r)/ interj(ရှေ့စကားဆက်ရန် အရှိန်ယူရာ၌ သုံးသော စကား)။ အင်း။ အဲ။‘Will you call me?’ ‘Er, yes, I suppose so. ’ ❍ I'm, er, I'm working on that.

-er suff၁။ (ကြိယာကို ပြုသူအနက်ဖြင့် နာမ်ပုဒ်ပြောင်း ပေးသော နောက်ဆက်စကား)။lover ❍ computer. Compare -EE, -OR၂။ (with ns forming ns ) (က) (ပတ်သက်သူအနက်ဖြင့် နာမ်ကို ထပ်ဆင့် နာမ်ပုဒ်ပြောင်းပေးသော နောက်ဆက်စကား)။ astronomer ❍ philosopher. (ခ) (သက်ဆိုင်သူအနက်ဖြင့် ယင်းသို့ ပုဒ်ပြောင်းပေး သော နောက်ဆက်စကား)။ … သား။New Yorker ❍ villager ❍ sixth-former. (ဂ) (အရေအတွက် တစ်စုံတစ်ရာရှိကြောင်းအနက်ဖြင့် ယင်းသို့ ပုဒ်ပြောင်းပေးသော နောက်ဆက်စကား)။ three-wheeler ❍ double-decker.၃။ (သာလွန်အဆင့်ပြ နာမဝိသေသန၊ ကြိယာဝိသေသနပုဒ်ပြောင်းပေး သော နောက်ဆက် စကား)။ taller ❍ softer ❍ heavier ❍ faster.
era /'Çǝrǝ/ nခေတ်။This marks the beginning of a new era in medical research. ❍ the postwar era ❍ the era of glasnost.
eradicate /Ç'rædÇkeÇt/ vအမြစ်ဖြတ်သည်။ ချေမှုန်းသုတ်သင်သည်။Smallpox has now been eradicated. ❍ a commitment to eradicate racism from the police force.eradication /ÇrædÇ'keÇʃn/ n [U]

erase /Ç'reÇz; US Ç'reÇs/ v၁။ ~ sth (from sth)ဖျောက်ဖျက် သည်။ ချေဖျက်သည်။erase sb's anxieties/doubts/fears ❍ He has tried to erase from his mind all memories of the disaster.၂။ (ခဲဖျက် စသည်ဖြင့်) ဖျက်သည်။ ခြစ်ထုတ်ပစ်သည်။ erase pencil marks.၃။ (တိပ်ခွေ၊ ကွန်ပျူတာ မှတ်ဉာဏ်ရှိ သွင်းထားချက်တို့ကို) ဖျက်ပစ်သည်။ I've erased the wrong file! ❏ eraser /Ç'reÇzǝ(r); US Ç'reÇsǝr/ n (US ) (Brit fml ) (Brit also rubber ) ခဲဖျက်။ မင်ဖျက်။ ❏ erasure /Ç'reÇʒǝ(r)/ n (fml ) [U] မေ့ပျောက်ပစ်ခြင်း။the erasure of the incident from her memory.
ere /eǝ(r)/ conj , prep (arch or rhet )မတိုင်မီ။ Ere long they returned.မကြာမီ သူတို့ပြန်ရောက်ပြီ။

erect /Ç'rekt/ adj၁။ မတ်သော။ ထောင်မတ်သော။ hold oneself/ stand erect ❍ Sit comfortably with your head erect. ❍ The dog's ears were erect and alert.၂။ (ယောက်ျားလိင်) တောင်သော။ (နို့သီး)တင်းမာသော။v (fml ) ၁။ ဆောက်သည်။ တည်သည်။They plan to demolish the house next door and erect a block of flats in its place. ❍ A statue/monument was erected to(ie to honour the memory of) Queen Victoria.၂။ စိုက်သည်။ ထောင်သည်။ ထူသည်။ erect a tent/sign/screen ❍ (fig ) erect a new charter of social values. ❏ erection /Ç'rekʃn/ n၁။ [U] (fml ) ဆောက်လုပ်ခြင်း။ ဆောက်လုပ်မှုအခြေအနေ။ The erection of the building took almost a year.၂။ [C] ယောက်ျား လိင်တောင်ခြင်း။ get/have an erection.
ergo /'ɜ:gǝƱ/ adv (Latin usu joc )ထို့ကြောင့်။ သို့ဖြစ်၍။ သို့မို့ကြောင့်။Change from within will take too long.Ergo change must come from outside.

ergonomics /ɜ:gǝ'nɒmÇks/ n [sing v ](လုပ်ငန်းတိုးတက်ရေး အတွက်) အလုပ်နှင့် လုပ်ငန်းခွင် လေ့လာမှု။ ❏ ergonomic adj လုပ်ငန်းခွင်နှင့် လုပ်အားစွမ်းရည် မြှင့်တင်ရေး။ergonomic features. ❏ ergonomically adv လုပ်ငန်းခွင်မြှင့်တင်မှု ရှုထောင့်မှ။The layout is hard to fault ergonomically.
ERM /i: ɑ:r 'em/ abbr (finance )Exchange-Rate Mechanism.အချို့သော EU နိုင်ငံများ၏ ငွေကြေးစနစ်နှင့် ECU (ငွေကြေးစနစ်) ဆက်သွယ်မှုနည်းလမ်း။ join/leave the ERM. See also EMS
ermine /'ɜ:mÇn/ n [U]တရားသူကြီးဝတ်ရုံတွင် ကွပ်သော သားမွေး အဖြူ။a gown trimmed with ermine ❍ ermine robes.

erode /Ç'rǝƱd/ v (esp passive)တိုက်စားသည်။ စားသည်။ တစ်စ တစ်စ ဆုတ်ယုတ်လျော့ပါးသည်။Metals are eroded by acids. ❍ The sea has eroded the cliff face over the years. ❍ (fig ) Standards in our schools/The rights of the individual are being steadily eroded. ❍ The sides of the volcano are eroding away year by year.erosion /Ç'rǝƱʒn/ n [U]: the erosion of the coastline by the sea ❍ attempts to reduce soil erosion ❍ (fig ) the steady erosion of the President's credibility.
erogenous /Ç'rɒdʒǝnǝs/ adjရမ္မက်သွေးကြွလွယ်သော (ကိုယ်ခန္ဓာ အစိတ်အပိုင်း)။ erogenous zones.

erotic /Ç'rɒtÇk/ adjကာမရာဂနှိုးဆွသော။ ရမ္မက်နှိုးကြွသော။erotic art/verse ❍ erotic fantasies ❍ The photographs are profoundly erotic. ❏ erotica /Ç'rɒtÇkǝ/ n [pl]အညှီအဟောက် (ဝတ္ထု၊ ရုပ်ရှင် စသည်)။a collection of erotica. erotically /-kli/ adv ❏ eroticism /Ç'rɒtÇsÇzǝm/ n [U] ရမ္မက်နှိုးဆွမှု။the film's blatant eroticism.

err /ɜ:(r); US eǝr/ v ~ (in sth/doing sth) (fml )မှားသည်။ ချော်သည်။The judge erred in refusing permission to cross-examine the witness. ❏ err on the side of sth [IDM ]မှားချင်းမှားလျှင် (သက်ညှာရာ) ရောက်သည့်သဘော မှားသည်။It's better to err on the side of tolerance (ie be too gentle rather than too severe) when dealing with young offenders.

errand /'erǝnd/ nလက်တိုလက်တောင်း။ တောက်တိုမည်ရ။work as an errand boy ❍ He was tired of running errands for his sister. ❍ I've come on a special errand.အထူးကိစ္စတစ်ရပ်နှင့် ကျွန်တော်လာခဲ့တာပါ။See also FOOL'S ERRAND

errant /'erǝnt/ adj (fml or joc ) (က) လမ်းလွဲသော။ တာဝန်မကျေ သော၊ ပျက်ကွက်သော။errant fathers who refuse to provide maintenance for their children ❍ (fig ) trying to recover an errant handkerchief (ie one that is lost).(ခ) (အိမ်ထောင်ဖက်) ဖောက်ပြန်သော။

erratic /Ç'rætÇk/ adj (usu derog )ခုတစ်မျိုး၊ တော်ကြာတစ်မျိုး အပြောင်းအလဲမြန်သော။ တစ်သမတ်တည်း မဟုတ်သော။ စိတ်မချရသော။erratic eating habits ❍ a gifted but erratic player ❍ the company's somewhat erratic performance on the stock market ❍ Deliveries of goods are erratic.erratically /-kli/ adv : Being out of practice the team played very erratically.
erratum /e'rɑ:tǝm/ n (pl errata /-tǝ/) (usu pl ) (fml )(ပုံနှိပ်) အမှား။a list of errata.အမှားပြင်ဆင်ချက်။
erroneous /Ç'rǝƱniǝs/ adj (fml )မမှန်ကန်သော။ ယွင်းမှားသော။erroneous ideas/conclusions/statements. erroneously adv : a poem erroneously attributed to Shakespeare.

error /'erǝ(r)/ n၁။ [C] ~ (in sth/doing sth) အမှား။riddled with serious/minor/silly spelling errors ❍ a computer error ❍ a government/clerical error in calculating unemployment benefit ❍ make a tactical/a fundamental/an unforced error ❍ an error of judgement (ie a mistake in the way one assesses a situation).၂။ [U] အပြုမှား။ အယူမှား။enormous scope for error ❍ The letter was sent to you in error (ie by mistake). ❍ The accident was the result of pilot error. ❍ Rising costs have left us very little margin of error (ie scope to make any mistakes without serious consequences). ❍ MISTAKE ❏ see, realize, etc the error of one's ways [IDM ]အမှားကိုသိပြီး ပြုပြင်သင့်ကြောင်း သဘောပေါက် သည်။
ersatz /'eǝzæts; US 'eǝrsɑ:ts/ adj (often derog )အစားထိုး။ အတု။ersatz ‘fruit juices’.
erstwhile /'ɜ:stwaÇl/ adj (fml )ယခင်။ ယခင်က။ တစ်ခါတုန်းက။His erstwhile friends turned against him.

erudite /'erudaÇt/ adj (fml )စာပေကျမ်းဂန်နှံ့စပ်သော။ သုတ ကြွယ်သော။an erudite lecture ❍ a witty and immensely erudite man. ❏ erudition /eru'dÇʃn/ n [U] (fml )အသိပညာ။a work of great erudition and originality.

erupt /Ç'rʌpt/ v၁။ (မီးတောင်)ပေါက်ကွဲသည်။It's many years since Mount Vesuvius last erupted. ❍ An immense volume of rocks and molten lava was erupted.၂။ ~ (into sth) (ပြဿနာ၊ အကြမ်းဖက်မှု စသည်) ပေါ်ပေါက်သည်။The crisis/scandal erupted only days before the election. ❍ Violence has erupted between the two communities. ❍ The fighting may erupt into full-scale confrontation.၃။ ~ (in sth) (ခံစားမှု) ပွင့်ထွက်သည်။When Davis scored for the third time the crowd finally erupted. ❍ The whole place erupted. ❍ erupt in tears/fits of laughter.၄။ (အနာ) ပေါက်သည်။A rash has erupted all over his back. eruption /Ç'rʌpʃn/ n [C, U]: a major volcanic eruption ❍ the eruption of Krakatoa ❍ an eruption of violent protest.

-ery (also -ry ) suff၁။ (with vs and ns forming ns ) (က) … ရာနေရာ။ bakery ❍ brewery. (ခ) … နည်း။ … အတတ်။ cookery ❍ pottery.၂။ (with ns and adjs forming usu uncountable ns ) (က) … ခြင်း။ … မှု။ snobbery ❍ bravery ❍ rivalry. (ခ) (ပစ္စည်း တစ်စုံတစ်ရာ) အစုအဝေး။ machinery ❍ greenery ❍ gadgetry.

escalate /'eskǝleÇt/ vအရှိန်မြှင့်သည်။ မြင့်တက်သည်။ the steadily escalating costs of research ❍ These local troubles could soon escalate into civil war. ❍ The government is deliberately escalating the war for political reasons. escalation /eskǝ'leÇʃn/ n [C, U] ~ (in sth) : an escalation in food prices ❍ try to prevent any further escalation of the conflict.
escalator /'eskǝleÇtǝ(r)/ nစက်လှေကား။
escalope /'eskǝlɒp, e'skælǝp/ nကြက်ဥ၊ မုန့်နှစ်နှင့် လူးကြော်ထား သော အသားလွှာ။escalopes of veal.
escapade /eskǝ'peÇd, 'eskǝpeÇd/ n(နောင်မှနောင်တရသော) သည်းထိတ်ရင်ဖို စွန့်စားမှု။ a foolish/childish escapade ❍ an amorous escapade ❍ She alone knew the real truth of his Paris escapade.

escape /Ç'skeÇp/ v၁။ ~ (from sb/sth) လွတ်သည်။ လွတ်မြောက် သည်။ လွတ်သွားသည်။Two prisoners have escaped. ❍ an escaped convict ❍ A lion has escaped from its cage. ❍ She longed to escape from her mother's domination. ❍ (fig ) As a child he would often escape into a dream world of his own.၂။ (no passive) ရှောင်တိမ်းသည်။ ရှောင်ရှားသည်။ လွှဲရှောင်သည်။Two of the gang were caught but their leader escaped (capture/arrest). ❍ Where can we go to escape the crowds? ❍ you can't escape the fact that you're overweight. ❍ escape criticism/being criticized for sth.၃။ စိမ့်သည်။ ယိုသည်။ ထွက်သည်။There's gas escaping somewhere — can you smell it? ❍ heat escaping through a window ❍ (fig ) No sound escaped his lips.၄။ ~ (with sth) (ထင် သလောက်မဆိုးဘဲ) လွတ်မြောက်သည်။ escape with a warning ❍ escape very lightly ❍ The driver of the other car escaped unscathed/escaped with minor cuts and bruises.၅။ (no passive) မေ့လျော့သည်။ အမှုမဲ့ အမှတ်မဲ့ ဖြစ်သည်။ Her name escapes me (ie I can't remember it). ❍ The fault escaped observation (ie was not noticed) for months. ❍ Nothing escapes him/his attention (ie He notices everything). ❍ (ironic ) It might have escaped your notice that I've been unusually busy recently. အခုတစ်လော ကျုပ်အလုပ်ဒီလောက်များနေတာကိုတော့ မမြင်ဘူး မဟုတ်လား။ (အားနေတာတော့ မြင်တတ်တယ်။ )n ၁။ [C, U] ~ (from sth) (က) လွတ်မြောက်ခြင်း။ There was little possibility of escape. ❍ three recent successful escapes/escape bids from this prison ❍ She made her escape when the guard's back was turned. ❍ We had a miraculous/narrow/lucky escape. (ခ) လွတ်လမ်း။ လွတ်ပေါက်။ seek escape from the noise ❍ There was no escape from her disastrous marriage. ❍ our escape route ❍ The police have just found the escape vehicle. ❍ He got out through the escape hatch (eg on a ship or an aircraft). See also FIRE-ESCAPE၂။ [sing] မေ့မေ့ ပျောက်ပျောက် ဖြစ်စေသောအရာ။ ထွက်ပေါက်။ He listens to music as an escape from the pressures of work.၃။ [C] ယိုစိမ့်မှု။ an escape of gas. ❏ make good one's escape [IDM ] လွတ်လွတ်ကျွတ်ကျွတ် လွတ်မြောက်သွားသည်။
escapee /ÇskeÇ'pi:/ nထောင်ပြေး။

escapism /Ç'skeÇpÇzǝm/ n [U] (often derog )(ဒိဋ္ဌဓမ္မလောကမှ စိတ်ကူးယဉ်ကမ္ဘာထဲသို့) လွတ်မြောက်ရောက်ရှိခြင်း။the James Bond brand of harmless escapism ❍ For him books are a form of escapism from the real world.escapist /-pÇst/ adj : escapist fantasies ❍ escapist literature (eg romantic fiction).
escarpment /Ç'skɑ:pmǝnt/ nတောင်စောင်း။ ကမ်းပါးစောင်း။walk along the top of the escarpment.
eschew /Çs'tʃu:/ v (fml )ရှောင်ရှားသည်။ ရှောင်ကြဉ်သည်။eschew political discussion.

escort1 /'eskↄ:t/ n၁။ [CGp, U] အစောင့်အရှောက်။ အစောင့်အကြပ်။ provide an armed escort for a visiting head of state ❍ The convoy had an escort of ten destroyers. ❍ soldiers on escort duty ❍ The prisoners were transported under police/military escort.၂။ [C] (dated or fml ) (အထူးသဖြင့်) အမျိုးသားအဖော်။ [ဥ] ကိုယ်ရံတော်။

escort2 /Ç'skↄ:t/ v ~ sb (to sth)လိုက်ပါစောင့်ရှောက်သည်။ လိုက်ပို့သည်။The princess was escorted by a number of attendants. ❍ Several large men escorted him to the gate. ❍ Her brother's friend escorted her home.

-ese suff၁။ (with proper ns forming adjs and ns ) … (နိုင်ငံ၊ မြို့၊ နယ်) သား၊ သူ။ … ဘာသာစကား။ (a/the) Chinese ❍ (a/the) Milanese.၂။ (with ns forming ns ) (esp derog ) … ရေးဟန်။ … အရေးအသား။ journalese ❍ officialese.
Eskimo /'eskÇmǝƱ/ (pl unchanged or -os ) nအက်စကီးမိုး (လူမျိုး)။the Inuit Eskimos of Canada ❍ Eskimo art.
ESL /i: es 'el/ abbrEnglish as a Second Language. အင်္ဂလိပ်စာ ကို ဒုတိယဘာသာစကားအဖြစ် သင်ကြားလေ့လာခြင်း။Compare EFL
esophagus (US )= OESOPHAGUS
esoteric /esǝƱ'terÇk, i:sǝƱ-/ adj (fml )ဆိုင်ရာပညာရှင်များမှသာ နားလည်နိုင်သော။ နက်နဲသော။ ပညာရပ်ဆန်သော။esoteric poetry/language ❍ His tastes in music are somewhat esoteric.
ESP /i: es 'pi:/ abbr၁။ English for Special/Specific. (eg scientific or technical) Purposes.၂။ extrasensory perception. ဆဋ္ဌမအာရုံ။
esp abbr ESPECIALLY
espalier /Ç'spæliǝ(r)/ n(ဥယျာဉ်တွင်) သစ်သား၊ ဝါယာ စသည်ဘောင်တွင် ချည်၍ ရုပ်လုံးဖော်ထားသော အပင်၊ ချုံ။ ရုပ်လုံးဖော် အပင်။

especial /Ç'speʃl/ adj (က) အထူး။ take especial care ❍ a matter of especial interest. (ခ) သီးသန့်။ for your especial entertainment. Compare SPECIAL ❏ especially /Ç'speʃǝli/ adv(ဤအဘိဓာန်၌ esp ဟု အတို ကောက်သုံးသည်။ ) အထူးသဖြင့်။ သီးသန့်။ အထူးတလည်။ ထူးထူးခြားခြား။especially important/true/useful ❍ He was well-built, but not especially tall. ❍ This is especially for you. ❍ I love the country, especially in spring. ❍ She wanted to go to the mountains, especially as the weather was beginning to improve. ❍ Old people should keep warm, especially if they find it difficult to move about.

espionage /'espiǝnɑ:ʒ/ n [U]သူလျှိုလုပ်ငန်း။ သူလျှိုမှု။ သူလျှိုထားခြင်း။found guilty of espionage ❍ engage in/commit espionage ❍ involved in industrial espionage(ie spying on the secret plans of rival companies).
esplanade /esplǝ'neÇd/ n(အထူးသဖြင့်) ပင်လယ်ကမ်းစပ် မြေပြန့်။a stroll along the esplanade.

espouse /Ç'spaƱz/ v (fml )ထောက်ခံသည်။ အားပေးသည်။espousing feminism ❍ political causes espoused by liberals over the centuries. espousal /Ç'spaƱzl/ n [U] ~ (of sth) (fml ): his recent espousal of monetarism.
espresso /e'spresǝƱ/ n (pl -os ) (က) [U] (ကျိုက်ကျိုက်ဆူသော ရေနွေးကို ကော်ဖီမှုန့်တွင် ဖိအားဖြင့် ဖြတ်သန်းရယူသော) ကော်ဖီကြမ်းခါးခါး။ (ခ) [C] ယင်းတစ်ခွက်။‘Two espressos, please. ’
esprit de corps /espri: dǝ 'kↄ:(r)/ n [U] (French )ရဲဘော်ရဲဘက် စိတ်။
Esq abbr (fml becoming dated esp Brit ) Esquire.(Mr. ကို နာမည်ရှေ့တွင် ထားသည့်နည်းတူ Esq ကို နောက်မှထားသော ယဉ်ကျေးသည့်အသုံးအနှုန်း)။ Edgar Broughton, Esq.
-esque suff (used with ns to form adjs )… ဟန်ရှိသော။ … ပုံ ပေါက်သော။statuesque ❍ Kafkaesque.
-ess suff (with ns forming ns )(ဣတ္ထိလိင်ပြနောက်ဆက်)။ …မ။ lioness ❍ actress. ❍ GENDER

essay /'eseÇ/ n၁။ ~ (on sth) (က) စာစီစာကုံး။ a brilliant essay on Italian art. (ခ) စာတမ်းတို။ I handed in my history essay two days late.၂။ ~ (in sth) (fml ) ကြိုးပမ်းမှု။ အားထုတ်မှု။ His first essay in economic reform was a disaster. ❏ essayist /-Çst/ n (အထူးသဖြင့်) စာတမ်းရှင်။

essence /'esns/ n၁။ [U] အနှစ်သာရ။ အချုပ်။The essence of his argument is that capitalism cannot succeed. ❍ Her art captures the essence of our times. ❍ The two arguments are in essence the same.၂။ [C, U] အဆီအနှစ်။ အဆီ။ vanilla essence. ❏ of the essence [IDM ] အဓိက။ ပဓာန။Speed is of the essence in dealing with an emergency.

essential /Ç'senʃl/ adj၁။ ~ (to/for sth) မုချလိုအပ် [သော]။ ပဓာနကျ[သော]။an essential part/ingredient/component of sth ❍ carry out essential repairs on the car ❍ The government is proposing a ban on strikes in essential services. ❍ Is money essential to happiness? ❍ This alliance is essential for the stability of Europe. ❍ It's essential that you attend all the meetings. ❍ Secretary wanted: previous experience essential.၂။ အခြေခံ သဘောသဘာဝ (ဖြစ်သော)။ the essential artificiality of art ❍ the essential weakness of their negotiating position.n (usu pl ) အခြေခံလိုအပ်ချက်။ learn the essentials of English grammar ❍ We only had time to pack a few essentials. ❏ essentially /Ç'senʃǝli/ adv အခြေခံအားဖြင့်။an essentially political movement ❍ It is an amusing book, but essentially a work of propaganda. ❏ essential oil n (ရေမွှေးသုံး) ရနံ့အဆီ။
-est suff (forming superlative adjs and advs )(အသာလွန်ဆုံး နာမဝိသေသနပြ နောက်ဆက်)။ …ဆုံး။ widest ❍ biggest ❍ happiest ❍ soonest.

establish /Ç'stæblÇʃ/ v၁။ တည်ထောင်သည်။ ထူထောင်သည်။This business was established in 1860. ❍ a newly-established company ❍ attempt to establish a close relationship with sb ❍ The report sets out to establish a new framework of rights and responsibilities.၂။ ~ sb/oneself (in sth) (as sth) အနေကျသည်။ အခြေကျသည်။ We moved into our new house last week but it will take time to get established. ❍ They are rapidly establishing themselves as the market leaders. ❍ She's now firmly established (in business) as an art dealer.၃။ အခြေခိုင်သည်။ မြဲမြံသည်။ Established practices are difficult to change. ❍ His second novel established him/his reputation as a writer.၄။ အခိုင်အမာ သက်သေထူသည်။ သက်သေပြသည်။ We've established his innocence/that he's innocent. ❍ The police are trying to establish where he was at the time of the incident. ❏ established adj အခြေခိုင်နေသော။ Anglicanism is the established religion in England.

establishment /Ç'stæblÇʃmǝnt/ n၁။ [U] ထူထောင်ခြင်း။ တည်ထောင်ခြင်း။ announce/support the establishment of a new college ❍ the establishment of cultural values.၂။ [C] (fml or joc) အဖွဲ့အစည်း။ ဌာန။ အဆောက်အအုံ။ a research establishment ❍ a comfortable and well-run establishment near Salzburg.၃။ (usu the Establishment [Gp]) (often derog ) ဩဇာရှိ ရှေးရိုးဝါဒီ။ the military/political Establishment ❍ orthodox Establishment views ❍ an Establishment figure ❍ young people rebelling against the Establishment.

estate /Ç'steÇt/ n၁။ [C] (ကျေးလက်ပိုင်းရှိ ကိုယ်ပိုင်) ခြံဝင်း။ ပရဝုဏ်။ နယ်မြေ။He owns a large/a 3000-acre estate in Massachusetts.၂။ [C] (esp Brit) အိမ်ရာမြေကွက်။ စက်မှုမြေကွက်။ an industrial estate ❍ live on an estate. See also COUNCIL ESTATE, HOUSING ESTATE၃။ [U, C] (law ) အမွေဥစ္စာ။ Her estate was divided between her four children. See also REAL ESTATE ❏ estate agent (Brit ) (US realtor , real estate agent ) n အိမ်ရာမြေအကျိုးဆောင်။ ❏ estate car (Brit ) (US station-wagon ) n စတေရှင်ဝက်ဂွန် (ကား)။ ❍ hatchback

esteem /Ç'sti:m/ n [U] (fml )လေးစားသမှုရှိခြင်း။ အထင်ကြီးခြင်း။ ရိုသေကြည်ညိုမှု။She is held in high esteem by those who know her well. ❍ The changes provide an opportunity for the prime minister to recapture public esteem.v (fml ) (not used in the continuous tenses)၁။ (usu passive) အထင်ကြီးသည်။ မြတ်နိုးလေးစားသည်။ two highly esteemed professional scientists ❍ an esteemed colleague ❍ Pearls were greatly esteemed as personal ornaments.၂။ တန်ဖိုးထားသည်။ မှတ်ယူသည်။I esteem it a privilege to address such a distinguished audience.
esthete (US )= AESTHETE
esthetic (US )= AESTHETIC
estimable /'estÇmǝbl/ adj (dated or fml )လေးစားထိုက်သော။ ရိုသေသမှုပြုထိုက်သော။See also INESTIMABLE

estimate /'estÇmǝt/ n၁။ ခန့်မှန်းခြေ။ I can only give you a rough estimate of the number of bricks you will need. ❍ the original/earlier/latest/most recent estimate of their value ❍ according to official government estimates ❍ It will cost at least 10 billion dollars and that's a conservative estimate. ❍ Flight timings are based on our best estimate and wide experience.၂။ ထင်မြင်ချက်။ ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်။ I don't know her well enough to form an estimate of her abilities.၃။ ခန့်မှန်း ကုန်ကျမည့်ငွေ။ We got estimates from three different contractors and accepted the lowest. Compare QUOTATION ၃/'estÇmeÇt/ v ~ sth (at sth) အကြမ်းဖျင်းခန့်မှန်းသည်။ မှန်းကြည့် သည်။ estimate the silver content of ore samples ❍ at an estimated cost of $8 million ❍ An estimated 15 million trees were blown down. ❍ We estimated his income at/to be about £35000 a year. ❍ Council officials estimated that the work would take three months. ❍ Try to estimate how much you will have to pay out over the coming year.

estimation /estÇ'meÇʃn/ n [U] (fml )ထင်မြင်ယူဆချက်။ အမြင်။In my estimation, he's the more suitable candidate. ❍ She has certainly gone up in my estimation (ie is more highly regarded by me) since she told the boss what she thought of him.

estrange /Ç'streÇndʒ/ vခပ်တန်းတန်းဖြစ်သွားသည်။ ခပ်ခွာခွာ ဖြစ်သည်။He had estranged the party leadership. ❏ estranged adj ~ (from sb)(က) (လင်မယား) ခွာပြဲ နေသော။ ကွဲနေသော။an attempt at reconciliation with her estranged husband. (ခ) ခပ်တန်းတန်းဖြစ်သွားသော။ their estranged supporters ❍ She felt estranged from her sister. estrangement n [U, C]: a sense of loneliness and estrangement ❍ The misunderstanding had caused a seven-year estrangement between them.
estuary /'estʃuǝri; US -ueri/ nမြစ်ဝ။ the Thames estuary.
et al /et 'æl/ abbr(အမည်နောက်၌သုံးသောစကား)။ … နှင့် အခြား သူများ၊ အရာများ။(Latin et alii /alia ): The book includes studies by Westman et al.
et cetera /et 'setǝrǝ, Çt-/ (usu abbr etc )စသည်။ စသည်ဖြင့်။all the keys to rooms, cupboards, garages, etc ❍ She kept going on about how we'd behaved badly, let her down, etc, etc.

etch /etʃ/ v၁။ ~ A (in/on/onto B); ~ B (with A) အရေးအကြောင်းခြစ်၍ (သို့) အရေးအကြောင်းတွင် ငရဲမီးဖြင့် စား၍ပုံဖော်သည်။a glass tankard with his initials etched on it ❍ (fig ) a woman whose faced was etched (ie deeply lined) with suffering ❍ trees etched (ie having a clear outline) against the sunset ❍ The incident remained etched in/on her memory for years.၂။ သတ္တုပြားပေါ်တွင် ငရဲမီးဖြင့်စား၍ ပုံဖော်သည်။ ❏ etching n (က) [U] ယင်းသို့ ပုံဖော်သော အတတ်ပညာ။ (ခ) [C] ထွင်းထားသော သတ္တုပြားဖြင့် ရိုက်နှိပ်ထားသည့်စာ၊ ရုပ်ပုံ။Hanging on the wall was a fine etching of the church.

eternal /Ç'tɜ:nl/ adj၁။ အဆုံးအစမရှိသော။ အဆုံးမရှိသော။ ထာဝရ။ eternal life (ie life after the death of the body) ❍ an eternal optimist (ie sb who always expects that the best will happen) ❍ To his eternal credit, he did not mention it to anyone.၂။ အဆုံးမသတ်နိုင်သော။ အတော မသတ်။ Stop this eternal chatter! ❍ I am tired of your eternal arguments. ❏ eternally /Ç'tɜ:nǝli/ adv ထာဝရ။ ထာဝစဉ်။ အမြဲ။ The status of women was seen as eternally fixed. ❍ For that I'll be eternally grateful to you. ❍ He's eternally optimistic. ❏ eternal triangle n သုံးပွင့်ဆိုင်အချစ် (ဇာတ်လမ်း)။ ❏ eternal verity n (usu pl ) အခြေခံကိုယ်ကျင့်တရား။ အခြေခံလူ့ကျင့်ဝတ်။

eternity /Ç'tɜ:nǝti/ n၁။ [U] (fml ) (က) အဆုံးမရှိသောကာလ၊ အဓွန့်။ ထာဝရ။ Egyptian mummies preserved for all eternity. (ခ) (ထာဝရမြဲတည်သော) တမလွန်ဘဝ။ တမလွန် သံသရာ။ spend eternity in a far better place.၂။ an eternity [sing] (infml ) (အချိန်) ကမ္ဘေကမ္ဘာ။ တစ်ကမ္ဘာ။ It seemed an eternity before the police arrived.
ethanol /'eθǝnɒl/ (also ethyl alcohol ) n [U]အရက်ပြန်။ အီသနော။ (လောင်စာ (သို့) ဖျော်ဆေးအဖြစ်သုံးသည်။ )
ether /'i:θǝ(r)/ n [U]၁။ အီသာ။ အရက်ပြန်မှထုတ်သည့် အရောင်မဲ့ ဆေးရည်။ (ဖျော်ဆေး၊ မေ့ဆေး၊ ထုံဆေးအဖြစ် သုံးသည်။ )၂။ (arch or joc ) လေထု။Today's news disappears into the ether and is soon forgotten.
ethereal /i'θÇǝriǝl/ adjအလွန် သိမ်မွေ့နူးညံ့သော။ ethereal music/beauty.

ethic /'eθÇk/ n၁။ [sing] လူ့ကျင့်ဝတ်။ ကိုယ်ကျင့်သိက္ခာ။the Puritan ethic ❍ a strongly defined work ethic.၂။ ethics(က) [pl] ကျင့်ဝတ်တရား။ ကိုယ်ကျင့်တရား။ draw up a code of ethics ❍ medical ethics (ie those observed by the medical profession) ❍ The ethics of his decision are doubtful. ❍ It's a question of professional ethics. (ခ) [sing v ] ကိုယ်ကျင့်တရားဆိုင်ရာ ပညာ။ ❏ ethical /-kl/ adj၁။ လူ့ကျင့်ဝတ်နှင့်ဆိုင်သော။largely an ethical issue/dilemma/problem ❍ rules which govern ethical standards ❍ draw up an ethical framework.၂။ လူ့ကျင့်ဝတ်နှင့် ကိုက်ညီသော။His behaviour has not been strictly ethical. ethically /-kli/ adv

ethnic /'eθnÇk/ adj၁။ (က) လူမျိုးစုတစ်စုနှင့် သက်ဆိုင်သော။ethnic minorities/groups/communities ❍ ethnic unrest/clashes.(ခ) ဇာတိ၊ မျိုးနွယ်အားဖြင့် တိုင်းပြည်၊ ဒေသ တစ်ခုခုနှင့် သက်ဆိုင်သော။ ethnic Turks.၂။ (approv ) (အထူးသဖြင့်) ဥရောပ၊ အမေရိကန်တို့၏ ယဉ်ကျေးမှုမဟုတ်သော။ethnic clothes/food/music ❍ an ethnic restaurant. ethnically /-kli/ adv :an ethnically divided/troubled region. ❏ ethnic cleansing n [U] (euph ) လူမျိုးတုံး သတ်ဖြတ်ရေး ဝါဒ၊ သတ်ဖြတ်မှု။
ethnocentric /eθnǝƱ'sentrÇk/ adjမိမိယဉ်ကျေးမှုကို ဗဟိုပြု၍ စံထားသော။ ethnocentric assumptions.
ethnography /eθ'nɒgrǝfi/ n [U]လူမျိုးနှင့် ယဉ်ကျေးမှု သရုပ်ခွဲခြင်း ပညာရပ်။ လူမျိုးခွဲဗေဒ။ ❏ ethnographer /eθ'nɒgrǝfǝ(r)/ nယင်းပညာရှင်။ethnographic /eθnǝ'græfÇk/ adj : ethnographic research/studies.
ethos /'i:θɒs/ n [sing] (fml )အသိုင်းအဝိုင်း၊ အုပ်စုတစ်ခု၏ စိတ်ဓာတ်၊ ဓလေ့စရိုက် စသည့် သီးခြားလက္ခဏာ။a new sexual ethos ❍ the prevailing self-help ethos ❍ a message in tune with the post-war ethos.
ethyl alcohol /eθÇl 'ælkǝhɒl, i:θaÇl/= ETHANOL
etiolated /'i:tiǝƱleÇtÇd/ adjအလင်းရောင်မရ၍ ဖျော့တော့ကြုံလှီ သော။an etiolated rose.
etiquette /'etÇket, -kǝt/ n [U]ကျင့်ဝတ်ထုံးတမ်း။ လောကဝတ်။ ယဉ်ကျေးရည်မွန်မှု။ a book of etiquette ❍ medical/legal etiquette ❍ It is simply not etiquette.
-ette suff (with ns forming ns )၁။ အငယ်လေး။ အသေးလေး။cigarette ❍ kitchenette.၂။ (ပစ္စည်း) အတု။ flannelette.၃။ အမျိုးသမီး။ usherette. ❍ GENDER
etymology /etÇ'mɒlǝdʒi/ n (က) [U] (ဝေါဟာရ) ရင်းမြစ်ဗေဒ။ (ခ) [C] ဝေါဟာရသမိုင်း။ နိရုတ္တိ။ etymological /etÇmǝ'lɒdʒÇkl/ adj :an etymological dictionary.
EU /i: 'ju:/ abbr (usu the EU )European Union (the Common Market). See also EC
eucalyptus / ju:kǝ'lÇptǝs/ n (pl unchanged or eucalyptuses )ယူကလစ်ပင်။ ငှက်ခြောက်ပင်။
eucharist /'ju:kǝrÇst/ n the Eucharist [sing]ခရစ်တော်၏ နောက်ဆုံးညစာ အထိမ်းအမှတ်စားပွဲ။ ယင်းစားပွဲ၌ သုံးဆောင်သော ပေါင်မုန့်နှင့် စပျစ်ရည်။ See also communion ၁
eugenics /ju:'dʒenÇks/ n [sing v ]ဉာဏ်ရည်ဖွံ့ဖြိုးကျန်းမာသော ကလေးငယ်များ ပျိုးထောင်ရေးပညာရပ်။ လူသားသန့်ဗေဒ။
eulogize , -ise /'ju:lǝdʒaÇz/ v ~ (on/over sb/sth) (fml )အမွှမ်းတင် သည်။ ချီးကျူးသည်။She's always eulogizing (over) her children's achievements. eulogistic / ju:lǝ'dʒÇstÇk/ adj
eulogy /'ju:lǝdʒi/ n [C, U] ~ (on/of/for/to sb/sth) (esp fml )ချီးကျူးဂုဏ်ပြုစကား။ ထောမနာစကား။a graveside eulogy on his dead friend ❍ Fellow actors delivered gushing eulogies at her memorial service.
eunuch /'ju:nǝk/ nမိန်းမစိုး။ (ရှေးခေတ် ရောမနှင့် အရှေ့တိုင်းများ၌ နန်းတွင်းအမျိုးသမီးဆောင်များကို ကြီးကြပ်ရသော၊ သင်းကွပ်ထား သော ယောက်ျား)။

euphemism /'ju:fǝmÇzǝm/ n ~ (for sth)စကားနု စကားယဉ်။ စကားလှ။‘Pass away’ is a euphemism for ‘die’. ❍ The government admitted there were ‘problems’—a slight euphemism, given the thousands of people without food, water or shelter. euphemistic / ju:fǝ'mÇstÇk/ adj(ဤအဘိဓာန်၌ euph ဟု အတိုကောက်သုံးသည်။ ) euphemistic language/expressions/terms. euphemistically /-kli/ adv

euphoria /ju:'fↄ:riǝ/ n [U]ရွှင်လန်းဝမ်းမြောက်ခြင်း။ ဝမ်းသာပီတိ။a week of alternating euphoria and gloom ❍ the euphoria of recent independence ❍ She was still in a state of euphoria hours after her victory. euphoric /ju:'fɒrÇk; US -'fↄ:r-/ adj : The mood/atmosphere was almost euphoric.
eureka /ju'ri:kǝ/ interj (joc )(တစ်ခုခုရှာဖွေတွေ့ရှိ၍၊ ပြေလည် သွား၍၊ ဝမ်းသာအားရဟစ်ကြွေးသော စကား)။Eureka — a job at last!
Eur(o)- comb formဥရောပ (သို့) ဥရောပသမဂ္ဂဆိုင်ရာ။Euro-MP ❍ Eurocrat.
eurocheque /'jƱǝrǝƱtʃek/ nဥရောပဘဏ်များမှ ထုတ်ပေးသော ချက်လက်မှတ်။
Eurocrat /'jƱǝrǝkræt/ n (usu derog )ဥရောပသမဂ္ဂ စီမံရေးရာ အရာရှိကြီး။the Brussels Eurocrats.
Euro-election /'jƱǝrǝƱ Çlekʃn/ nဥရောပပါလီမန် ရွေးကောက်ပွဲ။
Euro-MP /'jƱǝrǝƱ empi:/ abbrMember of the European Parliament: Euro-MPs of all parties.

Europe /'jƱǝrǝp/ n [U]၁။ ဥရောပတိုက်။ western/eastern/central Europe.၂။ (Brit ) ဗြိတိန်နိုင်ငံမှအပ ဥရောပနိုင်ငံအားလုံး။ British holiday-makers in Europe.၃။ THE EUROPEAN UNION: Britain went into Europe in 1973.

European / jƱǝrǝ'pi:ǝn,  jↄ:-/ adj၁။ ဥရောပ။ European languages.၂။ ဥရောပသမဂ္ဂဆိုင်ရာ။ a single European market ❍ our European partners.n ၁။ ဥရောပတိုက်သား။ young Europeans.၂။ (Brit ) ဥရောပသမဂ္ဂ၏ မူဝါဒကိုထောက်ခံသူ။ a good European. ❏ the European Union (also the European Community , the Common Market ) n [sing] ဥရောပသမဂ္ဂ။ (၁၉၅၈-ခုနှစ်တွင် ဖွဲ့စည်းသော စီးပွားရေး၊ နိုင်ငံရေး အဖွဲ့အစည်း ဖြစ်သည်။ ယခုအခါ ဩစတြီးယား၊ ဘယ်လ်ဂျီယံ၊ ဗြိတိန်၊ ဒိန်းမတ်၊ ဖင်လန်၊ ပြင်သစ်၊ ဂျာမနီ၊ ဂရိ၊ အိုင်ယာလန်၊ အီတလီ၊ လူဇင်ဘတ်၊ နယ်သာလန်၊ ပေါ်တူဂီ၊ စပိန်နှင့် ဆွီဒင်တို့ ပါဝင်သည်။ )

euthanasia / ju:θǝ'neÇziǝ; US -'neÇʒǝ/ n [U]ညင်သာစွာ ဇီဝိန်ခြွေပေးခြင်း။calls for the law to be altered to allow euthanasia ❍ She is in favour of voluntary euthanasia (ie people being able to ask for euthanasia for themselves).

evacuate /Ç'vækjueÇt/ v (က) ~ sth; ~ sb (from …) ဘေးကင်းရာ သို့ ပြောင်းရွှေ့ပေးသည်။ help evacuate flood victims ❍ Police evacuated a nearby cinema. ❍ The police had ten minutes to evacuate 300 people (from the store) after the bomb warning was given. (ခ) အန္တရာယ်ရှိရာ အရပ်ကို စွန့်ခွာသည်။ Families in the area were urged to evacuate their homes immediately. evacuation /Çvækju'eÇʃn/ n [U, C]: the emergency evacuation of thousands of people after an earthquake ❍ orderly evacuation from the danger area. ❏ evacuee /Çvækju'i:/ nအန္တရာယ်ရှိရာအရပ်ကို စွန့်ခွာ၍ ထွက်ပြေးလာသူ။ wartime evacuees.

evade /Ç'veÇd/ v၁။ ရှောင်တိမ်းသည်။ ရှောင်ပြေးသည်။ evade capture by the police ❍ evade an attack/an enemy/the press ❍ (fig ) He evaded my eye (ie avoided looking into my eyes).၂။ လှီးလွှဲဖယ်ရှောင်သည်။ ရှောင်လွှဲသည်။ evade military service/taxes/restrictions.၃။ ခေါင်းတိမ်း သည်။ ခေါင်းရှောင်သည်။ ရှောင်ထွက်သည်။ ရှောင်ဖည်သည်။ She managed to evade all the difficult questions. ❍ Come on now, I think you're evading the issue. ❍ He cannot evade responsibility for his actions.၄။ (fml ) ဖြစ်မလာ။ စဉ်းစား၍ပေါ်မလာ။ Sleep evaded him that night. ❍ The exact figure evades me (ie I cannot remember it). See also EVASION, EVASIVE

evaluate /Ç'væljueÇt/ vတန်ဖိုးဖြတ်သည်။ ချင့်တွက်သည်။evaluate the possibility/the effects/the significance of sth ❍ attempt to evaluate the strenght of European competition ❍ Several other proposals are still being evaluated.evaluation /Çvælju'eÇʃn/ n [C, U]: a preliminary evaluation of the health care system ❍ a framework for the evaluation process.
evanescent /i:vǝ'nesnt; US ev-/ adj (fml )ပျောက်လွယ် ပျက်လွယ်သော။as evanescent as snowflakes.
evangelical /i:væn'dʒelÇkl/ adj၁။ (also Evangelical ) ဧဝံဂေလိအသင်းဝင်။an evangelical church.၂။ ခရစ်ယာန် တရားအဆုံးအမနှင့်ညီသော။၃။ ဟောချင်ပြောချင်လွန်းသော။evangelical fervour.n ဧဝံဂေလိအသင်းတော်ဝင်။

evangelist /Ç'vændʒǝlÇst/ n၁။ ခရစ်ယာန်တရားဟောဆရာ။ converted to Christianity by a fervent American evangelist.၂။ ခရစ်ဝင် ကျမ်းပြုဖြစ်ကြသော Matthew, Mark, Luke, John လေးဦးအနက် တစ်ဦး။ St John the Evangelist. evangelism n [U] evangelistic /Çvændʒǝ'lÇstÇk/ adj : evangelistic zeal.
evangelize, -ise /Ç'vændʒǝlaÇz/ vခရစ်ယာန်ဘာသာသို့ ဝင်ရန် ဟောပြောစည်းရုံးသည်။

evaporate /Ç'væpǝreÇt/ v၁။ အငွေ့ပြန်သည်။ ခန်းသည်။The water soon evaporated in the sunshine. ❍ This process gets the oil hot enough to evaporate any remaining moisture. ❍ WATER n ၂။ ပျောက်လွင့်သည်။ ပျောက်ပျက် သည်။His hopes/confidence evaporated into thin air. ❍ Their 70% majority evaporated overnight. evaporation /Çvæpǝ'reÇʃn/ n [U]: the evaporation process. ❏ evaporated milk n [U] (စည်သွတ်) နို့စိမ်း။

evasion /Ç'veÇʒn/ n၁။ [C, U] ရှောင်တိမ်းမှု။ ရှောင်လွှဲမှု။the burglar's evasion of the police ❍ her deliberate/systematic evasion of responsibility ❍ He's been charged with tax evasion.၂။ [C] လှီးလွှဲချက်။ ကွေ့လည်ကြောင်ပတ်။His speech was full of evasions and half-truths.

evasive /Ç'veÇsÇv/ adj၁။ မပွင့်လင်းသော။ ကွေ့လည်ကြောင်ပတ် လုပ်သော။ လှီးလွှဲလိုသော။an evasive answer ❍ The doctors were somewhat evasive when describing his condition.၂။ တိမ်းသော။ ရှောင်သော။The ship had to take evasive action in order to avoid a collision. evasively adv evasiveness n [U]: Politicians are often accused of evasiveness.
eve /i:v/ nအကြိုရက်။ အကြို။on Christmas Eve (ie 24 December) ❍ a New Year's Eve party (ie on 31 December) ❍ on the eve of the race/election/summit.

even1 /'i:vn/ adv၁။ ပင်လျှင်။ တောင်။ တောင်မှ။He never even opened the letter (ie so he certainly didn't read it). ❍ He didn't answer even my letter (ie so he certainly didn't answer any others). ❍ It was cold there even in summer (ie so it must have been very cold in winter). ❍ Even a child can understand it (ie so adults certainly can).၂။ ပို၍ပင်။ ပိုလို့တောင်။ ထက်။ သာတောင်။ You know even less about it than I do. မင်းကငါ့လောက်တောင် မသိဘူး။ (ငါက မင်းထက် ပိုသိတယ်။ ) ❍ Sally drives fast, but Jane drives even faster. ❍ She's even more intelligent than her sister.၃။ သည့်အပြင်။ တဲ့အပြင်။It's an unattractive building, even ugly/ugly even. ❏ even as [IDM ] (fml ) (used as a compound conj ) တစ်ပြိုင်တည်းပဲ။ တစ်ချိန်တည်းမှာပဲ။Even as he shouted the warning the car skidded. ❏ even if/though [IDM ] (used as conjs ) ရသည့်တိုင်။ သော်လည်း။ လင့်ကစား။I'll get there, even if I have to walk all the way. ❍ I like her even though she can be annoying at times. ❏ even now/then [IDM ]၁။ တာတောင်။ အခုတောင်။ I've shown him the photographs but even now he won't believe me. ❍ Even then he would not admit his mistake.၂။ (fml ) (with continuous tenses only, often between the auxiliary and the main v ) ယခုပင်လျှင်။ ခုပဲ။ The troops are even now preparing to march into the city. ❏ even so [IDM ] (used as a conj ) သော်ငြားလည်း။ သော်လည်းပဲ။ ပေမည့်လည်း။ There are a lot of spelling mistakes; even so, it's quite a good essay.

even2 /'i:vn/ adj၁။ ညီညာသော။ ပြန့်ပြူးသော။The footpath is not very even. Compare UNEVEN ၁၂။ ပုံမှန်။ ပြေပြစ် သော။an even colour ❍ even breathing ❍ Her stitches weren't very even. ❍ This wine cellar stays at an even temperature all year round. Compare UNEVEN ၂၃။ (က) တူညီသော။Our scores are now even.(ခ) အတွဲညီသော။ လိုက်ဖက်သော။an even game ❍ I'd say the two players are pretty even. Compare UNEVEN ၃၄။ စုံဂဏန်း ဖြစ်သော။an even number of people ❍ 4, 6, 8, 10, etc are even numbers. Compare ODD ၂၅။ အေးဆေးသော။ တည်ငြိမ်သော။of an even disposition ❍ an even-temperated baby ❍ She tried to keep her voice quiet and even (ie not showing any emotion).v ညီမျှအောင်လုပ်သည်။ ညီစေသည်။Chelsea evened the score just after half-time. ❏ be/get even (with sb) [IDM ] (infml ) တန်ပြန်သည်။ လက်တုံ့ပြန်သည်။ ကလဲ့စားချေသည်။ He swore he'd get even with his brother. ❏ break even [IDM ] လုပ်ငန်းတစ်ခုကို အရှုံးမရှိဘဲ လက်စသတ်သည်။We should begin to break even later in the year. ❏ an even chance (of doing sth) [IDM ] ၅၀ ရာခိုင်နှုန်း သေချာတယ်။ I'd say she has an even chance of winning the match. ❍ He's got a less than even chance. ❏ even-handed adj တရားမျှတသော။an even-handed approach ❍ even-handed justice. ❏ even money; evens [IDM ] (အလောင်းအစား) ဆတူ အလျော်အစား။ အလားအလာ ၅၀ရာခိုင်နှုန်း စီ ရှိသော။The evens favourite ❍ ‘Will he win?’ ‘It's even money. ’ ❏ even out [PHRV ] ပြေသွားသည်။ ညီညာသွားသည်။ ပုံမှန် ဖြစ်သည်။The path rose steeply for a while and then evened out. ❍ House prices keep rising and falling but they should eventually even out. ❏ even sth out [PHRV ] မျှအောင်ဖြန့်ပေးသည်။ Payments can be evened out on a monthly basis over the year. ❍ He tried to even out the distribution of work among his employees. ❏ even (sth) up [PHRV ] ညီမျှသွားသည်။ ညီမျှသွားစေသည်။ Moving John and Michael to the back row will even things up a bit (ie make a more balanced group). ❏ on an even keel [IDM ] (စိတ်ခံစားမှု) ပုံမှန်ပြန်ဖြစ်သည်၊ အနည်ထိုင်သည်။ It took him a long time to get back on an even keel after his wife died. evenly adv : evenly balanced/matched ❍ evenly divided/distributed ❍ Breathe slowly and evenly. ❍ ‘I shan't be coming next week,’ she said evenly. evenness /'i:vǝnnǝs/ n [U]

evening /'i:vnÇŋ/ n၁။ [C, U] ညချမ်း။ ညနေ။I'll come and see you tomorrow evening. ❍ We were at home yesterday evening. ❍ One warm summer evening…/On a warm summer evening… ❍ the long winter evenings ❍ In the evening I usually read. ❍ Let's meet on Sunday evening. ❍ the evening performance. ❍ MORNING၂။ [C] (ည) ဆည်းဆာပွဲ။A theatre evening (ie an evening at the theatre) has been arranged. ❍ musical evenings(ie evenings especially for listening to or playing music). ❏ evening class n(သက်ကြီးများအတွက်) ညကျောင်း။I'm doing French evening classes this year. See also NIGHT SCHOOL ❏ evening dress n၁။ [U] ညချမ်းပွဲလမ်းဝတ်စုံ။Everyone was in (full) evening dress.၂။ [C] (ပွဲလမ်းဝတ်) ဂါဝန်ရှည်။ ❏ evening paper n ညနေသတင်းစာ။I saw the advert in the local evening paper. ❏ evenings adv (esp US ) ညဉ့်ဦးတိုင်း။ ညဉ့်ဦးပိုင်းတွင်။ He works evenings. ❏ good evening [IDM ] မင်္ဂလာညချမ်းပါ။‘Good evening, sir. ’ ‘Good evening. ’
evensong /'i:vnsɒŋ/ n [U](အင်္ဂလိကန်အသင်းတော်) ညနေပိုင်း ဝတ်ပြု ဆုတောင်းပွဲ။We attended evensong as well as morning prayer. Compare MATINS See also VESPERS

event /Ç'vent/ n၁။ ဖြစ်ရပ်။ အဖြစ်အပျက်။ The American election was one of the main events of 1992. ❍ recent dramatic events taking place in Europe ❍ In the normal course of events, he would have been home by then. ❍ By the time it was actually published, his report had been overtaken by events (eg many of the things he predicted had actually happened). ❍ an unfortunate series of events ❍ The police have reconstructed the chain of events that led to the murder. ❍ OCCURRENCE၂။ (က) လူမှုရေးဆိုင်ရာ ဆောင်ရွက်လှုပ်ရှားမှု။a fund-raising event ❍ the social event of 1995. (ခ) ပြိုင်ပွဲစဉ်။ Which events have you entered for? ❍ The 800 metres is the fourth event of the afternoon. See also FIELD EVENTS, TRACK EVENTS ❏ at all events/in any event [IDM ] မည်သို့ပင်ဖြစ်စေ။ ဘာပဲဖြစ်ဖြစ်။ I think she'll be interested, but in any event, the worst that she can do is say ‘no’. ❏ eventful /-fl/ adj အမှတ်တရ ထူးထူးခြားခြား အဖြစ်အပျက်များဖြင့် ပြည့်နေသော။ စိတ်ဝင်စားဖွယ် အဖုံဖုံရှိသော။an eventful year ❍ He's had an eventful life. ❏ in the event [IDM ] (fml ) နောက်ဆုံးတော့။I was worried about the hotel bill, but in the event I had enough money to pay. ❏ in the event of sth/that sth happens [IDM ] (fml ) ဖြစ်ခဲ့လျှင်။ ခဲ့သော်။ In the unlikely event of an accident, contact us at this number. ❍ Sheila will inherit the money in the event of his death. ❏ in that event [IDM ] သို့ဖြစ်လျှင်။ ဒီလိုဆိုရင်။ You could be right, and in that event they'll have to give you a refund.
eventing /Ç'ventÇŋ/ n [U] (esp Brit )(ကျေးလက်များကို ဖြတ်သန်း ရသော ၃-ရက်ကြာ) မြင်းစီးပြိုင်ပွဲ။

eventual /Ç'ventʃuǝl/ adjနောက်ဆုံး။ နောက်ပိတ်ဆုံး။the possibility of an eventual reunion ❍ History will record their eventual acceptance of the treaty. ❍ He may take eventual control of the company. ❏ eventuality /Çventʃu'ælǝti/ n (fml )နောက်ဆုံး ဖြစ်လာ နိုင်ဖွယ် အခြေအနေ။We must make arrangements to cover any/every eventuality. ❍ The money had been kept in reserve for (just) such an eventuality. ❏ eventually /-tʃuǝli/ adv နောက်ဆုံးတွင်မူ။ နောက်ဆုံးတော့။There was a long delay before she eventually agreed to see us. ❍ He had a poor third round and eventually finished tenth. ❍ Eventually, after looking at about forty houses, they bought the one in Russell Street.

ever /'evǝ(r)/ adv၁။ (usu in negative sentences and questions, or sentences expressing doubt or condition; usu placed before the v )တစ်ချိန်ချိန်တွင်။ တစ်ချိန်လုံး။ တစ်ကြိမ်တစ်ခါမျှ။ Nothing ever happens in this place. ❍ Don't you ever wish you were rich? ❍ If you ever visit this country, you must come and stay with us. ❍ She seldom, if ever (ie perhaps never), goes to the cinema. ❍ I hardly ever (ie rarely) see them nowadays. ❍ All he ever does is complain. ❍ (infml ) I'm never ever going to speak to her again!သူ့ကို နောက်ဘယ်တော့မှ စကား မပြောတော့ဘူး။၂။ (with the perfect tenses in questions) … ဖူး (သလား)။ ‘Have you ever been in a helicopter?’ ‘No, never. ’ ❍ ‘Have you ever seen an elephant?’ ‘Yes, I have. ’၃။ (with comparatives after than or with superlatives) ခါတိုင်းထက်။ အရင်ထက်။ … ဖူးသမျှထက်။ It's raining harder than ever. ❍ This is the best work you've ever done. ❍ her best ever score ❍ He loved her more than ever.၄။ (က) အမြဲ။ အစဉ်။ Paul, ever the optimist, agreed to give it one last try. ❍ Her novels are as popular as ever (ie as popular as they always have been). ❍ They rode off into the sunset and lived happily ever after (ie for the rest of their lives). ❍ ‘Who won?’ ‘She did, as ever. ’ ❍ He told me he would love me for ever (and ever). (ခ) (with comparatives) တိုး၍တိုး၍။ ပို၍ပို၍။ His debts grew ever larger. See also FOREVER၅။ ever- (in compounds) အမြဲ…။ the ever-growing problem ❍ an ever-present threat ❍ the ever-increasing cost of food.၆။ (when, where စသည်နောက်တွင်ထား၍ အံ့ဩမှု၊ သံသယဖြစ်မှုကို အထူးပြုဖော်ပြသော စကားလုံး)။ When/Where/How ever did you lose it? ❍ What ever do you mean? ❏ did you ever (…)! [IDM ] (infml ) (အဖြေမမျှော်လင့်သော မေးခွန်း၊ အံ့ဩခြင်း၊ သံသယဖြစ်ခြင်း စသည်၌သုံးသော စကားလုံး)။ … ဖူး (ကြ) ရဲ့လား။ Did you ever hear such nonsense! ❍ Opening the palace to the public — well, I mean, did you ever! ❏ ever more [IDM ] (fml ) ပို၍ပို၍။ She became ever more nervous as the interview continued. ❏ ever since (…) [IDM ] (used as a compound conj , prep or adv ) ကတည်းက။ တုန်းကပဲ။ I've known him ever since we were at school together. ❍ She has been depressed ever since her sister's death. ❍ He was bitten as a toddler and has been afraid of dogs ever since. ❏ ever so/ever such (a) [IDM ] (infml esp Brit ) အလွန် တရာ။ အလွန့်အလွန်။ ever such a handsome man ❍ He's ever so rich. ❏ if ever there was (one) [IDM ] (infml ) (အလေးအနက် ပြုစကား)။ အဲဒါမျိုး ဖြစ်ခဲ့၊ ရှိခဲ့ဖူး တယ် ဆိုရင် (ဒါမျိုးပဲဖြစ်မယ်)။ That was a fine lunch if ever there was one! ❍ If ever there was an idiotic idea, this was it! ❏ yours ever/ever yours [IDM ] (ပေးစာအဆုံးတွင် လက်မှတ်မထိုးမီ ရေးသော စကား)။ ထာဝစဉ်သင့်။

evergreen /'evǝgri:n/ nအမြဲစိမ်းပင်။Few plants grow under the dense shade cast by the evergreens. Compare DECIDUOUS, CONIFEROUSadj အမြဲစိမ်း။ evergreen hedges ❍ (fig ) a new production of Rossini's evergreen (ie always popular) comedy.

everlasting /evǝ'lɑ:stÇŋ; US -'læst-/ adj၁။ အမြဲတည်တံ့ သော။ ထာဝရ။ everlasting fame/life.၂။ (infml derog ) အပ်ကြောင်းထပ်နေသော။ မဆုံးနိုင်သော။ I'm tired of her everlasting complaints. everlastingly adv
evermore /evǝ'mↄ:(r)/ adv (fml or rhet )အမြဲတမ်း။ ထာဝရ။The land will remain part of our national heritage for evermore.

every /'evri/ indef det၁။ (က) (used with singular countable ns to refer to individual people or things belonging to groups of three or more) အားလုံး။ တိုင်း။Every child in the class passed the examination. ❍ I've got every record she has ever made. ❍ I could hear every word they said. ❍ He examined every item in the set carefully.(ခ) (used with singular countable ns to emphasize the importance of each separate unit) … တိုင်း။ … တိုင်း။He enjoyed every minute of his stay. ❍ I had to work for every single penny I earned. ❍ They were watching her every movement. ❍ Every time he phones I always seem to be in the shower. ❍ EACH၂။ (used with abstract ns ) ဖြစ်နိုင်ဖွယ်ရှိသမျှ။He tried every conceivable combination of numbers. ❍ We have every reason to think he may still be alive. ❍ You were given every opportunity to object at the time. ❍ I wish you every success.၃။ (used to indicate that sth happens or is done at specified intervals) … လျှင်တစ်ကြိမ်။The buses go every 10 minutes. ❍ Prune the hedge every six or eight weeks. ❏ every other [IDM ]၁။ အခြားလူအားလုံး။ အခြား အရာအားလုံး။ Every other girl except me is wearing jeans.၂။ …ခြားတစ်ခါ။ …ခြား။ They visit us every other week.

everybody /'evribɒdi/ (also everyone ) indef pronလူတိုင်း လူတိုင်း။The police questioned everybody in the room. ❍ I'll never remember everybody's name. ❍ You eat the olives; everybody else hates them. ❍ GENDER
everyday /'evrideÇ/ adjနေ့စဉ်။ နေ့စဉ် ဖြစ်ရိုးဖြစ်စဉ်။ everyday objects ❍ everyday life ❍ a compact dictionary for everyday use.
everyone /'evriwʌn/ indef pron= EVERYBODY: Everyone was tired and irritable. ❍ She ignored everyone else. ❍ I've talked to nearly everyone concerned. ❍ GENDER
everyplace /'evripleÇs/ indef adv (US infml )= EVERYWHERE

everything /'evriθÇŋ/ indef pron၁။ အကုန်လုံး။ အားလုံး။ ရှိရှိသမျှ။Everything was destroyed. ❍ I'll tell you everything I know. ❍ written exams on everything from chemistry to accountancy.၂။ အခြေအနေအရပ်ရပ်။ Everything in the capital is now quiet. ❍ ‘How's everything with you?’ ‘Fine, thanks. ’၃။ အခရာ။ အဓိက။ Money isn't everything. ❍ (infml ) ‘Keep Sarah out of this, she's got nothing to do with the situation. ’ ‘She's got everything to do with it!’ (ie She is the central and most important part of it).
everywhere /'evriweǝ(r)/ (also everyplace ) (US infml ) indef advနေရာတကာ။ နေရာတိုင်း။ နေရာအနှံ့။I've looked everywhere ❍ He follows me everywhere.

evict /Ç'vÇkt/ v ~ sb (from sth) (esp passive)(ဥပဒေအရ) နှင်ထုတ်သည်။The tenants were evicted (from their house) for not paying the rent. ❍ A group of protesters were evicted from the meeting.eviction /Ç'vÇkʃn/ n ~ (from sth) [U, C]: face eviction from one's home ❍ the eviction of a widow and her two children ❍ an eviction order (ie a legal order to leave a place).

evidence /'evÇdǝns/ n၁။ [U] ~ (for sth/to do sth/that …) အကိုးအကား။ အထောက်အထား။ သာဓက။ သက်သေ။ not a scrap/shred of evidence ❍ There is now fresh/further scientific evidence for this theory. ❍ The medical/forensic evidence suggests (that) he is guilty. ❍ There is no evidence that the meeting actually took place. ❍ Have you any evidence to support this allegation? ❍ His statement to the police was used in evidence against him.၂။ [U, C] လက္ခဏာ။ အသွင်။ ဟန်။ The room bore evidence of a struggle. ❍ On the evidence of their recent matches it's unlikely the Spanish team will win the cup. ❍ The cave produced evidences of prehistoric settlement.v (fml ) အထောက်အထားဖြစ်သည်။ သာဓကဖြစ်သည်။ Trading by big institutions continues to rule Wall Street, as evidenced by the New York Stock Exchange's own statistics. ❏ give (one's) evidence [IDM ] သက်သေခံသည်။ သက်သေ ထွက်ဆိုသည်။ give evidence for the defence. ❏ (be) in evidence [IDM ] အထင်အရှား တွေ့မြင်ရသည်။ The police were much in evidence at today's demonstration. ❏ turn King's/Queen's evidence (Brit ); (US ) turn State's evidence [IDM ] အစိုးရသက်သေအဖြစ် ပြောင်းလဲ ထွက်ဆိုသည်။ (အပြစ်ပေါ့အောင်) ဖော်ကောင်လုပ်သည်။Compare PLEA BARGAINING

evident /'evÇdǝnt/ adj ~ (to sb) (that…); ~ (in/from sth)ထင်ရှားမြင်သာသော။ ပေါ်လွင်သော။It must be evident to all of you that a mistake has been made. ❍ It is evident from this that something needs to be done. ❍ The orchestra went about their task with evident relish. ❏ evidently adv ထင်ထင်ရှားရှား။ ပေါ်ပေါ်ထင်ထင်။ သိသာစွာ။The President evidently assumes that he will still be in power next year. ❍ Evidently they had already tried but failed to unblock the pipe.

evil /'i:vl, 'i:vÇl/ adj၁။ ယုတ်မာသော။ ယုတ်ညံ့သော။ ဆိုးယုတ်သော။ evil thoughts/deeds ❍ evil spirits.၂။ မနှစ်မြို့ဖွယ်သော။ ဆိုးသော။ an evil smell ❍ He has an evil temper.n (fml ) ၁။ [U] ဆိုးယုတ်ခြင်း။ အဆိုး။ မကောင်းမှု။ the eternal struggle between good and evil ❍ the forces of evil ❍ You cannot pretend there's no evil in the world.၂။ [C usu pl ] အနိဋ္ဌာရုံ။ the evils of drink/slavery ❍ social evils. ❏ the evil day, hour, etc [IDM ] ရင်မဆိုင်ချင်သော အချိန် ကာလ။ I know I need to go to the dentist but I've been putting off the evil day as long as possible. ❏ the evil eye n [sing] ယုတ်မာသောအကြည့်။ ဒုစရိုက်မျက်စိ။ protection against the evil eye ❍ an incantation to ward off the evil eye ❍ give sb the evil eye. ❏ evilly /'i:vǝli/ adv မကောင်းစိတ်ဖြင့်။ ယုတ်မာစွာ။ He eyed her evilly.
evince /Ç'vÇns/ v (fml )စိတ်ထားကိုပြသည်။ သဘောထားကိုဖော်ထုတ် သည်။He evinced a strong desire to be reconciled with his family.
eviscerate /Ç'vÇsǝreÇt/ v (fml )ကလီစာကို ထုတ်သည်။
evocative /Ç'vɒkǝtÇv/ adj ~ (of sth)ပြန်လည် အမှတ်ရစေသော။ စိတ်အာရုံကို နှိုးဆွ ပေးသော။an evocative account of his life as a coalminer ❍ evocative smells/sounds.

evoke /Ç'vǝƱk/ vလှုံ့ဆော်သည်။ ဖြစ်ပေါ်စေသည်။ သတိရစေသည်။ evoke admiration/surprise/sympathy ❍ the sensations evoked in the crowd by his speech ❍ The music evoked memories of her youth. evocation /i:vǝƱ'keÇʃn/ n [C, U] (fml ): a flood of childhood evocations ❍ The play was a brilliant evocation of life in the 1930s.

evolution /i:vǝ'lu:ʃn, ev-/ n [U]၁။ (biology ) ဆင့်ကဲဖြစ်စဉ်။play an important part in human evolution ❍ Darwin's theory of evolution.၂။ တစ်စတစ်စ ပြောင်းလဲတိုးတက်မှု။the evolution of farming methods ❍ In politics Britain has preferred evolution to revolution(ie gradual development to sudden violent change). ❏ evolutionary /i:vǝ'lu:ʃǝnri, ev-; US evǝ'lu:-ʃǝneri/ adj (fml )ဆင့်ကဲဖြစ်စဉ်နှင့်ဆိုင်သော။ တစ်စတစ်စ ပြောင်းလဲ တိုးတက်လာသော။evolutionary changes/processes.

evolve /i'vɒlv/ v၁။ ~ (from sth) (into sth)ပြောင်းလဲ ဖြစ်ပေါ်သည်။He has evolved a new theory after many years of research. ❍ The information system can be adapted to meet evolving needs. ❍ The novel evolves as an elegy for a lost way of life. ❍ The idea evolved from a drawing I discovered in the attic.၂။ (biology ) (အပင်၊ တိရစ္ဆာန် စသည်တို့) အဆင့်ဆင့် ပြောင်းလဲ ဖြစ်ပေါ်သည်။The three species evolved from a single ancestor. ❍ An extraordinary system of sexual reproduction evolved. ❍ The dolphin has evolved a highly developed jaw.
ewe /ju:/ nသိုးမ။ ❍ SHEEP Compare LAMB ၁, RAM n ၁
ewer /'ju:ǝ(r)/ nရေသယ်ချိုင့်ကြီး။ a basin and ewer.
ex1 /eks/ n (pl exes , ex's ) (infml )ခင်ပွန်းဟောင်း၊ ဇနီးဟောင်း စသည်။Her ex shares custody of the children.
ex2 /eks/ prepမပါဝင်ဘဲ။ ထည့်မတွက်ဘဲ။Prices quoted are ex VAT.
ex- pref (used widely with ns )ယခင်။ …ဟောင်း။ex-wife ❍ ex-President ❍ ex-convict.
exacerbate /Çg'zæsǝbeÇt/ v (fml )ပိုမိုဆိုးဝါးစေသည်။Scratching exacerbates a skin rash. ❍ Her mother's interference only exacerbated the difficulties in their marriage.

exact /Çg'zækt/ adj၁။ တိကျသော။ တစ်ထပ်တည်းကျသော။ an exact copy/replica of the painting ❍ the exact time/date/figure/location/size ❍ What were his exact words? ❍ They elected a leader who was almost the exact opposite of the previous one. ❍ He's in his mid-fifties — well, fifty-six to be exact.၂။ (က) အလွန်တိကျသော။ စေ့စပ်သေချာသော။ She's a very exact person. (ခ) (သိပ္ပံ သဘောအရ) ပုံသေကားကျ။ Bringing up children is not an exact science, you know!v ~ sth (from sb) အတင်းတောင်းဆိုသည်။ အရယူသည်။ ညှစ်ယူသည်။ The kidnappers exacted a ransom of £50,000 from the family. ❍ He exacted a terrible revenge for their treatment of him. ❏ exacting adj အမှားမခံသော။ ကွက်တိဖြစ်သော။ products designed to meet the exacting standards of today's international market-place ❍ His work schedule is exacting. exaction /Çg'zækʃn/ n (fml ) [U, C] ❏ exactitude /Çg'zæktÇtju:d; US -tu:d/ n [U] (fml ) တိကျမှန်ကန်မှု။ scholarly exactitude. ❏ exactly adv၁။ တိတိ။ အံကိုက်။ အသေအချာ။That's exactly what I expected. ❍ I know exactly how she felt. ❍ You've arrived at exactly the right moment. ❍ It happened almost exactly a year ago. ❍ His words had exactly the opposite effect.၂။ အတိအကျ။ Your answer is exactly right. ❍ Where exactly were you in France?၃။ (သေချာကြောင်းပြောရာ၌ သုံးသောစကား)။ တကယ်ပါ။ အစစ်ပဲ။ အဲဒီအတိုင်းပဲ။ ‘So she wants to sell the house and move to Berlin. ’ ‘Exactly. ’ ❏ not exactly [IDM ] (infml ) ၁။ (ironic ) လုံးလုံး။ လုံးဝ။ He wasn't exactly pleased to see us; in fact he refused to open the door.၂။ အသေအချာတော့ မဟုတ်ဘူး။ မဟုတ်ပါ ဘူး။ ‘Do you have an appointment, sir?’‘Not exactly, but I know he'll see me. ’ exactness n [U]

exaggerate /Çg'zædʒǝreÇt/ vချဲ့ကားပြောသည်။ ပုံကြီးချဲ့သည်။ တစ်ဆိတ်ကို တစ်အိတ်လုပ်သည်။He always exaggerates to make his stories more amusing. ❍ You're exaggerating the difficulties. ❍ It would be easy to exaggerate the importance/significance of these new laws. ❍ I'm sure he exaggerates his Irish accent. ❏ exaggerated adj(က) ချဲ့ကားထားသော။make greatly/wildly/grossly exaggerated claims ❍ He has an exaggerated sense of his own importance.(ခ) ဟန်လုပ်သော။ an exaggerated laugh ❍ with exaggerated politeness.exaggeratedly adv ❏ exaggeration /Çgzædʒǝ'reÇʃn/ n၁။ [U] ချဲ့ကားခြင်း။ He told his story simply and without exaggeration.၂။ [C] ချဲ့ပြောသောစကား။It would be an exaggeration to say he knew her well — they met only two or three times.

exalt /Çg'zↄ:lt/ v (fml )၁။ မြှင့်တင်သည်။ The poor will be exalted.၂။ ဂုဏ်တင်ချီးကျူးသည်။ He was exalted as a pillar of the community. ❏ exaltation /egzↄ:l'teÇʃn/ n [U]၁။ ပီတိဖြာခြင်း။ ဘဝင် ခိုက်ခြင်း။ a feeling of exaltation and delight.၂။ (fml ) မြှင့်တင်ခြင်း။ ဂုဏ်တင်ခြင်း။ ချီးမြှောက်ခြင်း။ his exaltation of their culture. ❏ exalted adj၁။ (fml or joc ) အဆင့်မြင့်သော။She occupies an exalted position in the firm. ❍ No leader, however exalted, was allowed to speak from a platform.၂။ ပီတိဝေဖြာနေသော။ တက်ကြွပျော်ရွှင်နေသော။I felt exalted and newly alive. Compare EXULT
exam /Çg'zæm/ n= EXAMINATION ၁ : pass/fail one's exams ❍ The teachers set and mark our school exams. ❍ a maths exam ❍ an exam paper ❍ When do you take your final exams? ❍ I got my exam results today.

examination /ÇgzæmÇ'neÇʃn/ n၁။ (fml ) (also exam ) [C] စာမေးပွဲ။ စာစစ်ခြင်း။ sit an examination in Human Biology ❍ successful candidates in GCSE examinations ❍ an oral examination ❍ an entrance examination (eg to test the ability of sb wishing to enter a school or college).၂။ (က) [U] စူးစမ်းလေ့လာခြင်း။Careful examination of the ruins revealed an even earlier temple. ❍ On closer/further examination it was found that the signature was not genuine.(ခ) [C] စစ်ဆေးခြင်း။undergo a medical examination ❍ an examination of business accounts ❍ The proposals are still under examination.

examine /Çg'zæmÇn/ v၁။ ~ sth/sb (for sth) စစ်ဆေးသည်။ စူးစမ်းသည်။ ဆန်းစစ်သည်။The team examined the wreckage thoroughly/ minutely. ❍ examine facts/evidence/possible solutions ❍ examine the impact of aid programmes ❍ The doctor was examining a patient. ❍ Detectives examined the room for fingerprints. ❍ The book examines how attitudes have changed since the war.၂။ ~ sb (in/on sth) (fml ) အရည်အချင်းစစ်သည်။ examine students in mathematics/on their knowledge of mathematics.၃။ (law ) အမှုစစ်သည်။be examined under oath. See also CROSS-EXAMINE ❏ examiner /Çg'zæmÇnǝ(r)/ n စာစစ်။The papers are sent to external examiners (ie ones not connected with the students' school or college).

example /Çg'zɑ:mpl; US -'zæmpl/ n၁။ ပုံစံ။ သာဓက။ နမူနာ။ ဥပမာ။Can you give me/cite a specific example of what you mean? ❍ This dictionary has many examples of how words are used. ❍ It was a typical example of his generosity.၂။ စံနမူနာ။ ပြယုဂ်။This is a good/fine example of Shelley's lyric poetry. ❍ This church is a striking/an outstanding example of Norman architecture. ❍ a perfect/prime example of bad manners ❍ It is a classic example of how not to design a new city centre.၃။ ~ (to sb) စံထားစရာ။ စံ။ စံပြ။Her bravery should be an example to us all. ❍ a shining example of moral strength ❍ She sets an excellent example to the rest of the students. ❍ Don't be tempted to follow his example. ❍ He is a captain who leads by example. ❏ for example (abbr eg ) [IDM ] သာဓကအနေဖြင့်။ ဥပမာအားဖြင့်။Consider, for example, the effect that the new measures will have on small businesses. ❍ I know many women who have a career and a family — Alison, for example. ❍ The report is incomplete; for example, it does not include sales in France. Compare SAMPLE ❏ make an example of sb [IDM ]စံနမူနာပြ အပြစ်ပေးသည်။The headteacher decided to make an example of him by expelling him from the school.

exasperate /Çg'zæspǝreÇt; Brit also -'zɑ:sp-/ vစိတ်တိုအောင် လုပ်သည်။ အလွန်အနှောင့်အယှက်ပေးသည်။His constant whistling exasperated her. ❏ exasperated adj ~ (at/with sb/sth) စိတ်တိုနေသော။ စိတ်အနှောင့်အယှက်ဖြစ်နေသော။ ‘Now who can that be?’ said Mr Norris, exasperated. ❍ She was thoroughly exasperated at/with her mother's attitude. ❏ exasperating adj စိတ်ကုန်စရာကောင်းသော။ ကျွဲမြီး တိုစရာကောင်းသော။He's probably the most exasperating man I've ever met. ❍ It's really exasperating to run for a train and then miss it by seconds. exasperation /Çgzæspǝ'reÇʃn; Brit also -'zɑ: sp-/ n [U]: She sat back with a sigh of exasperation. ❍ We eventually had to give up in exasperation.

excavate /'ekskǝveÇt/ v၁။ တူးဖော်သည်။ excavate a buried city/a Greek vase.၂။ (fml ) တူးသည်။ excavate a trench. ❏ excavation /ekskǝ'veÇʃn/ n၁။ [U, C] တူးဖော်မှု (လုပ်ငန်း)။ recent excavations at Pompeii ❍ Excavation of the site has proved difficult.၂။ [C usu pl ] တူးဖော်ပြီး သော နေရာ။ visit the excavations. ❏ excavator n (က) မြေတူးသမား။(ခ) မြေတူးစက်။

exceed /Çk'si:d/ v (က) ပိုသည်။ လွန်သည်။The price will not exceed £100. ❍ The number admitted must not exceed 200. ❍ Births far exceed deaths at the moment. ❍ Their success exceeded (all) expectations (ie was greater than anyone expected). (ခ) (ခွင့်ပြုသည်ထက်၊ လိုသည်ထက်) ပိုလွန်သည်။ exceed one's instructions/authority (ie do more than one has permission to do) ❍ You should not exceed the speed limit (ie drive faster than is allowed). ❏ exceedingly adv (rather fml )အလွန့်အလွန်။ an exceedingly difficult problem ❍ They played exceedingly well.

excel /Çk'sel/ v (-ll- ) ~ (in/at sth/at doing sth)ထူးချွန်သည်။ တော်သည်။excel in foreign languages ❍ The firm excels at producing cheap radios. ❍ Throughout her life she felt the need to excel. ❏ excel oneself [IDM ] ဇော်ဆွဲသွားသည်။ အကောင်းတကာ့ အကောင်းဆုံး ဖြစ်သည်။His meals are always very good, but this time he's really excelled himself.
excellence /'eksǝlǝns/ n [U] ~ (in sth)ထူးချွန်မှု။The university's reputation for academic excellence ❍ set high standards of excellence in the fine arts. See also PAR EXCELLENCE
Excellency /'eksǝlǝnsi/ n(သံအမတ်ကြီး စသည်ကို ဂါရဝပြု ခေါ်သော အာလုပ်စကား)။Good evening, Your Excellency. ❍ His Excellency the French Ambassador.

excellent /'eksǝlǝnt/ adj၁။ ထူးကဲသော။ အကောင်းဆုံး ဖြစ်သော။ ပြောင်မြောက်သော။an excellent meal ❍ provide excellent service/facilities ❍ At $300 the bike is excellent value (for money). ❍ She speaks excellent French.၂။ (ဝမ်းသာအားရကြောင်း၊ သဘောတူလက်ခံကြောင်း ဖော်ညွှန်း သော စကား)။ အကောင်းဆုံးပေါ့။ အတိုင်းထက်အလွန်ပေါ့။You can all come? Excellent! excellently adv

except /Çk'sept/ prep ~ (for sb/sth); ~ (that…)မှလွဲ၍။ မှတစ်ပါး။The restaurant is open every day except Monday. ❍ We'll invite everyone, except perhaps Martin. ❍ I understand everything except why she killed him. ❍ He could answer all the questions except for the last one. ❍ The room was empty except for an old piano in the corner. ❍ She remembered nothing about him except that his hair was black. ❍ The two books are the same except (for the fact) that this one has an answer key at the back.v ~ sb/sth (from sth) (fml ) (often with a negative) ချန်လှပ်သည်။ ဖယ်ချန်သည်။Children under five are excepted from the survey. ❍ The whole staff, not excepting the art teacher, had to take part in the pantomime. ❍ Spain excepted, the most popular European holiday destination is Greece.

exception /Çk'sepʃn/ n၁။ (က) [C] (လူ၊ အရာဝတ္ထု) ခြွင်းချက်။Most of the buildings in this town are rather unattractive, but this church is a notable exception. ❍ The children did well, the only exception being Jo, who failed. ❍ Freedom of choice is at the heart of all our policies, and transport is no exception.(ခ) [U] ခြွင်းချန် ခြင်း။ All students without exception must take the English examination. ❍ I enjoyed all his novels with the exception of (ie except/not including) his last.၂။ [C] ခြွင်းချက်။ an exception to a rule of grammar ❍ Such community spirit is unfortunately the exception rather than the rule (ie not usual). ❍ Children are not normally allowed in, but in your case I'm prepared to make an exception (ie to allow you in). ❏ exceptionable /-ʃǝnǝbl/ adj (fml ) လက်မခံနိုင်စရာ။ သဘောမတွေ့စရာ။ There are no exceptionable scenes in the play. ❏ the exception proves the rule [IDM ] (saying ) ခြွင်းချက်ဆိုတာ ရှိစမြဲ။ All his family have red hair except him. ❍ He is the exception that/which proves the rule. ❏ take exception to sth [IDM ] လက်သင့်မခံ။ ဒေါပွသည်။ He took great exception to what I said. ❍ She took exception to having to wait outside in the corridor.

exceptional /Çk'sepʃǝnl/ adjထူးခြားသော။show exceptional musical ability ❍ This weather is exceptional for June. ❍ I could only condone violence in exceptional circumstances. Compare UNEXCEPTIONAL exceptionally /-ʃǝnǝli/ adv : an exceptionally beautiful child.
excerpt /'eksɜ:pt/ n [C] ~ (from sth)ကောက်နုတ်ချက်။excerpts from a novel ❍ I've seen a short excerpt from the movie on television.

excess /Çk'ses/ n၁။ [sing] an ~ of sth (derog ) ပိုကဲမှု။ an excess of enthusiasm/anger/emotion/zeal ❍ An excess of fat in one's diet can lead to heart disease.၂။ [U] တရားလွန်ခြင်း။ ပိုကဲခြင်း။ He's drinking to excess. ❍ He was driving at speeds in excess of 120 mph.၃။ [C] အပို။ She was charged an excess of $4 over the amount stated on the bill.၄။ excesses [pl] (fml ) လွန်ကဲမှု။ the excesses of popular journalism ❍ His excesses at parties are well known. ❍ One is reminded of the worst excesses (eg acts of cruelty) of the French Revolution./'ekses/ adj ပိုသော။ အပိုပေးရသော။ excess sugar in one's diet ❍ pay an excess fare (eg for travelling further than is allowed by one's ticket). ❏ excess baggage (also excess luggage ) n [U] (လေယာဉ်) ဝန်ပို။ အလေးချိန်ပို။ ❏ excessive /Çk'sesÇv/ adj လွန်ကဲသော။ ပိုလွန်သော။ excessive prices ❍ an excessive amount of alcohol ❍ an excessive enthusiasm for football. excessively adv : excessively high prices. ❏ excess postage n [U] တံဆိပ်ခေါင်းမလုံလောက်သော စာအတွက် ရွေးခ။

exchange /Çks'tʃeÇndʒ/ n [C, U]၁။ (က) လဲလှယ်ခြင်း။ ဖလှယ် ခြင်း။ အလဲအလှယ်။ Is five apples for five eggs a fair exchange? ❍ a house exchange (eg for a holiday) ❍ The exchange of prisoners during a war is unusual. ❍ She's giving him French lessons in exchange for his teaching her English. (ခ) အပြန်အလှန်ပြုခြင်း။ အတုံ့အလှယ်။the exchange of contracts (ie when buying or selling a house) ❍ an exchange of glances ❍ an exchange of gunfire.၂။ [C] အပြန်အလှန် အချီအချ စကားများခြင်း။ ခွန်းကြီးခွန်းငယ်ဖြစ်ခြင်း။ bitter exchanges between MP's in parliament.၃။ [U] ငွေကြေးလဲလှယ်မှု။ What is the exchange rate/rate of exchange between the dollar and the pound? See also ERM, FOREIGN EXCHANGE၄။ (often Exchange [C]) စီးပွားရေးသမားများ အရောင်းအဝယ် လုပ်ရာဒိုင်။ the London Metal Exchange ❍ the Stock Exchange.၅။ [C] = TELEPHONE EXCHANGE၆။ [C] အပြန်အလှန် လည်ပတ်ခြင်း။be on/do/organize an exchange ❍ exchange teachers ❍ Sarah is going on an exchange to Paris to stay with Pierre, and he is coming to stay with her here in Scotland next year.v (က) ~ A for B; ~ sth (with sb)လဲလှယ်သည်။ ဖလှယ်သည်။He exchanged the blue sweater for a red one. ❍ Ali exchanged seats with Ben. ❍ The warring factions exchanged hostages/prisoners.(ခ) တုံ့လှယ်သည်။ တုံ့ပြန်သည်။exchanging blows (ie hitting each other) ❍ They exchanged glances (ie looked at each other). ❍ The two men exchanged greetings (ie Each greeted the other). ❍ I heard them exchanging angry words (ie quarrelling). ❏ exchangeable /-ǝbl/ adjလဲလှယ်နိုင်သော။Goods bought in the sale are not exchangeable.

exchequer /Çks'tʃekǝ(r)/ n [sing] (က) the Exchequer (ယခင် ဗြိတိန်) ဘဏ္ဍာရေးဌာန။The Chancellor of the Exchequer is the minister in charge of finance in Britain.Compare TREASURY ၁ (ခ) တိုင်းပြည့်ဘဏ္ဍာ။This resulted in a considerable loss to the exchequer.

excise1 /'eksaÇz/ n [U]ယစ်မျိုးခွန်။the excise on beer/spirits/tobacco ❍ the Board of Customs and Excise ❍ excise duties ❍ an excise officer (ie an official employed in collecting excise). Compare CUSTOMS

excise2 /Çk'saÇz/ v ~ sth (from sth) (fml )ဖြတ်တောက်သည်။ ဖြတ်ထုတ်သည်။excise all references to the USSR ❍ A lump was excised from her breast. ❏ excision /Çk'sÇʒn/ n (fml )(က) [U] ဖြတ်ထုတ်ခြင်း။ the excision of a tumour. (ခ) [C] ဖြတ်တောက်ဖယ်ထုတ် လိုက်သော အရာ။ The numerous excisions have destroyed the literary value of the text.
excitable /Çk'saÇtǝbl/ adjစိတ်လှုပ်ရှားတတ်သော။ တက်ကြွသော။an excitable and hyperactive child ❍ She has an excitable temperament. excitability /ÇksaÇtǝ-'bÇlǝti/ n [U]

excite /Çk'saÇt/ v၁။ စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားစေသည်၊ တက်ကြွစေသည်။The children were very much excited by the news. ❍ The prospect of going to India for a year greatly excited her. ❍ Don't excite yourself (ie Keep calm).၂။ (က) ~ sth (in sb) (ခံစားမှု တစ်ခုခု) ဖြစ်ပေါ်စေသည်။excite envy/admiration/greed (in sb) ❍ excite public suspicion ❍ Recent discoveries have excited great interest among doctors.
