(ခ) ရာဂစိတ်ကို နိုးကြားစေသည်။Some people are (sexually) excited by pornographic magazines.၃။ (fml ) ဖျတ်လတ်တက်ကြွစေသည်။drugs that excite the nervous system. ❏ excitation /eksÇ'teÇʃn, eksaÇ/ n [U] (fml or techn ) နိုးကြားလာမှု။ sexual excitation. ❏ excited /Çk'saÇtÇd/ adj ~ (about/at sth); ~ (to do sth) စိတ်ထက်သန်တက်ကြွသော။the children's excited faces ❍ He was terribly excited to be asked to play for Wales. ❍ be excited about going on holiday ❍ It's nothing to get excited about. excitedly adv : The girls danced around excitedly. ❏ exciting adjစိတ်လှုပ်ရှားရသော။ ပျော်စရာကောင်းသော။an exciting story/discovery ❍ A trip in a hot-air balloon sounded very exciting. excitingly adv

excitement /Çk'saÇtmǝnt/ n၁။ [U] စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားခြင်း။ စိတ်လှုပ်ရှား ပျော်ရွှင်မှု။ The news of Julia's engagement caused great excitement. ❍ The excitement soon wore off. ❍ They were jumping about in excitement at the discovery. ❍ His eyes were wide with excitement.၂။ [C] (fml ) စိတ် ဝင်စားစရာ။ စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားဖွယ်။ After all the excitements of last month's election campaign, the papers are now rather dull.

exclaim /Çk'skleÇm/ vအာမေဍ္ဍိတ်သံပြုသည်။ အံ့အားသင့်စွာ ပြောသည်။‘I don't understand you,’ he exclaimed angrily. ❍ I could not help exclaiming at how much his son had grown. ❍ He exclaimed that he had never even met her.
exclamation /eksklǝ'meÇʃn/ nအာမေဍ္ဍိတ်။Mrs Davis gave an exclamation of disgust. ❏ exclamation mark (US exclamation point ) n အာမေဍ္ဍိတ်သင်္ကေတ။ (!)။

exclude /Çk'sklu:d/ v၁။ ~ sb/sth (from sth) (က) ဖယ်သည်။ ခြွင်းချန်သည်။ ကြဉ်သည်။exclude a person from membership of a society ❍ Women are still often excluded from positions of authority.(ခ) ထုတ်ပစ်သည်။ ဖယ်ထုတ် သည်။ All air must be excluded (from the bottle) if the experiment is to work.၂။ ထည့်မတွက်ဘဲ ချန်ထားသည်။ The police have excluded robbery as a motive for the murder. ❍ We must not exclude the possibility that the child has run away.၃။ ချန်လှပ်သည်။ Lunch cost £10 per person, excluding drinks. ❍ Buses run every hour, Sundays and public holidays excluded. Compare INCLUDE

exclusion /Çk'sklu:ʒn/ n (က) [U] ~ (of sb/sth) (from sth) ချန်လှပ်ထားခြင်း။ ထည့်မတွက်ခြင်း။ ထုတ်ပစ်ခြင်း။ the exclusion of women from the temple ❍ the exclusion of robbery as a motive ❍ an exclusion zone around the islands (eg excluding enemy ships). (ခ) [C] ချန်လှပ်ထား သော သူ၊ အရာ။ exclusions on account of age ❍ The insurance policy contains several exclusions. Compare INCLUSION ❏ to the exclusion of sb/sth [IDM ] … ကို ဘေးချိတ်၍။ He spent his spare time gardening, to the exclusion of all other interests.

exclusive /Çk'sklu:sÇv/ adj၁။ (က) အထူးသီးသန့်။He belongs to an exclusive club.(ခ) ဈေးကြီးသော။ (သာမန်လူ) အနား မသီနိုင်သော။exclusive styles/designs/articles ❍ an exclusive restaurant/private school/shop.၂။ သီးသန့်။ မူပိုင်။ have exclusive rights to televise the World Cup ❍ We granted them an exclusive agency for the sale of our books in Spain. ❍ The interview is exclusive to this magazine.၃။ တစ်ခုတည်းသာ လက်ခံသော။ The two plans are mutually exclusive (ie If you accept one you must reject the other).၄။ ~ of sb/sth မပါ [သော]။ The ship has a crew of 57 exclusive of officers. ❍ The price of the excursion is exclusive of accommodation.n တစ်စောင်တည်း၌သာ ဖော်ပြ(ခွင့်ပြု)သော ဇာတ်လမ်း၊ သတင်း ဆောင်းပါး။a Daily Mirror exclusive. exclusively adv : an area that relies almost exclusively on tourism ❍ This special offer has been exclusively designed for readers of ‘Home’ magazine. ❏ exclusiveness, exclusivity /eksklu:'sÇvǝti/ ns [U] အထူးသီးသန့်ဖြစ်ခြင်း။ the resort's exclusivity ❍ The shop was proud of its exclusiveness.
excommunicate /ekskǝ'mju:nÇkeÇt/ v(အထူးသဖြင့် ရိုမန် ကက်သလစ်) ခရစ်ယာန်အသင်းတော်ဝင်အဖြစ်မှ ကြဉ်သည်။ excommunication /ekskǝmju:nÇ'keÇʃn/ n [U, C]:They were threatened with excommunication.
excoriate /eks'kↄ:rieÇt/ v (fml )ပြင်းပြင်းထန်ထန် ဝေဖန်သည်။excoriate the government for its failure to act. excoriation n [U, C]
excrement /'ekskrÇmǝnt/ n [U] (fml )ကျင်ကြီး။ မစင်။The lawn was covered in dogs' excrement. excremental adj
excrescence /Çk'skresns/ n (fml )(အကောင်) အဖုအကျိတ်လုံး။ (အပင်) အဆစ်အမျက်လုံး။(fig ) The new office block is an excrescence (ie It is very ugly).
excreta /Çk'skri:tǝ/ n [U] (fml )ကျင်ကြီးကျင်ငယ် အညစ်အကြေး။ human excreta.
excrete /Çk'skri:t/ v (fml )အညစ်အကြေးစွန့်သည်။excretion /Çk'skri:ʃn/ n [U, C]

excruciating /Çk'skru:ʃieÇtÇŋ/ adjဝေဒနာပြင်းထန်သော။ ဒုက္ခကြီး သော။ excruciating misery ❍ Backache can be excruciating. ❍ (joc ) an excruciating concert ပျင်းစရာအလွန်ကောင်း သော ပွဲ။ ❍ He's an excruciating bore.သူဟာတကယ် ငြီးငွေ့စရာ ကောင်းတဲ့လူ။ excruciatingly adv : an excruciatingly painful experience ❍ The evening was excruciatingly dull.
exculpate /'ekskʌlpeÇt/ v ~ sb/oneself (from sth) (fml )အပြစ်မရှိကြောင်းပြောသည်၊ ပြသည်။ ။ exculpation n [U]

excursion /Çk'skɜ:ʃn; US -ɜ:rʒn/ n (က) အပျော်ခရီး။ Your tour includes a one-day excursion to the Grand Canyon by air. ❍ All the excursions had been arranged by the travel company. ❍ an excursion ticket (ie one issued at a reduced fare) ❍ (fig ) a writer who made occasional excursions into the realm of science fiction.သိပ္ပံဝတ္ထုနယ်ထဲသို့ တစ်ခါတစ်ရံနယ်ကျွံရေးတတ်သော စာရေးဆရာ။ (ခ) လေ့လာရေးခရီး။a shopping excursion. ❍ JOURNEY

excuse /Çk'skju:s/ n၁။ ~ (for sth/for doing sth) ဆင်ခြေ။ ဆင်ခြေဆင်လက်။ စောဒက။ He's always making excuses for being late. ❍ Late again? What's your excuse this time? ❍ There's no excuse for such behaviour. ❍ He made his excuses (ie He said sorry and gave his reasons for leaving early) and left.၂။ ~ (for sth/doing sth); ~ (to do sth) အကြောင်းပြချက်။ အခွင့်အလမ်း။ a good excuse for a party ❍ The party gave me an excuse to wear my new dress./Çk'skju:z/ v ၁။ ~ sth; ~ sb (for sth/doing sth) ခွင့်လွှတ် သည်။ Please excuse my late arrival. ❍ Excuse me for being late. ❍ The audience could be excused for thinking it was an amateur production. ❍ Excuse my interrupting you.၂။ (က) ~ sth; ~ sb/oneself for sth/doing sth ဆင်ခြေပေးသည်။ အကြောင်းပြသည်။ Nothing can excuse such rudeness. ❍ He excused himself for being late by saying that his car had broken down. (ခ) ~ oneself ခွင့်ပန်သည်။ ခွင့်တောင်းသည်။ She excused herself hurriedly, and ran out of the room.၃။ ~ sb (from sth) (esp passive) ခွင့်ပြုသည်။ လွတ်ငြိမ်းခွင့်ပေးသည်။ He was excused (from) piano practice. ❍ She excused herself from the walk saying she didn't feel well. ❍ Only pregnant women can be excused. ❏ be excused [IDM ] (often euph ) (ကျောင်းသားများ အပြင်ထွက်လို၍ ပန်ကြားသောစကား)။ ခွင့်ပြုပါ။Please can I be excused? ❏ excusable /Çk'skju:zǝbl/ adj ခွင့်လွှတ်နိုင်လောက်သော။Their mistake was excusable. Compare INEXCUSABLE ❏ excuse me [IDM ]၁။ တစ်ဆိတ်လောက်။ ကျေးဇူးပြု၍။Excuse me, do you have the right time?၂။ (ကြားဖြတ် ပြောလိုရာ၌ အယဉ်အကျေးသုံးသောစကား)။ ခွင့်ပြုပါ။Please excuse me while I answer the telephone. ❍ Excuse me, but I don't think that's quite true. ၃။ excuse me? (esp US ) ပြန်ပြောပါဦး။
ex-directory /eks dǝ'rektǝri/ (US unlisted ) adjတယ်လီဖုန်း လမ်းညွှန်တွင် ဖော်ပြမထားသော။an ex-directory number ❍ go ex-directory ❍ She's ex-directory.
execrable /'eksÇkrǝbl/ adj (fml )မနှစ်သက်စရာ။ အလွန် ညံ့သော။execrable manners/poetry.

execute /'eksÇkju:t/ v၁။ ကွပ်မျက်သည်။ execute suspected rebels ❍ He was executed for treason.၂။ (fml ) လိုက်နာ ဆောင်ရွက်သည်။ စီမံဆောင်ရွက်သည်။ execute sb's commands ❍ execute a plan/a piece of work ❍ The crime had been cleverly executed.၃။ (fml ) ကပွဲ စသည်တွင် ပါဝင်သည်။ execute a dance step ❍ The whole sonata was superbly executed.၄။ (law ) (က) အကောင်အထည် ဖော်သည်။ ဖြစ်မြောက်အောင်လုပ်သည်။ execute a will. (ခ) တရားဝင်ဖြစ်စေသည်။ execute a legal document (ie by having it signed in the presence of witnesses, sealed and delivered).

execution /eksÇ'kju:ʃn/ n၁။ [U, C] သေဒဏ်စီရင်ခြင်း။ ကွပ်မျက် ခြင်း။ condemn sb to execution by hanging ❍ Over 200 executions take place/are carried out in the country each year.၂။ [U] အကောင်အထည်ဖော်မှု။ His original idea was good, but the execution of it was disastrous. ❍ The plans were finally put into execution.၃။ [U] (fml ) (ဂီတ) ကျွမ်းကျင်မှု။ Her execution of the difficult finale was faultless.၄။ [U] (law ) သေတမ်းစာနှင့်အညီ ဆောင်ရွက်ခြင်း။ The solicitors are proceeding with the execution of my mother's will. ❏ executioner /eksÇ'kju:ʃǝnǝ(r)/ n အာဏာသား။ ပါးကွက် သား။ လက်မရွံ့။

executive /Çg'zekjǝtÇv/ adj၁။ စီမံခန့်ခွဲရေး။ executive duties ❍ a woman of considerable executive ability.၂။ စီရင် ဆုံးဖြတ်ခွင့်အာဏာရှိသော။ executive authority/power ❍ the executive committee of a political party ❍ the executive head of State(eg the President of the USA).n ၁။ [C, CGp] အလုပ်အမှုဆောင်။ အလုပ်အမှုဆောင်အဖွဲ့။ a sales executive ❍ She's the chief executive of a computer company. ❍ The union executive has/have yet to reach a decision. ❍ an executive briefcase/suite.၂။ the executive [Gp] နိုင်ငံတော် အုပ်ချုပ်မှုကဏ္ဍ။
executor /Çg'zekjǝtǝ(r)/ nသေတမ်းစာအရ ဆောင်ရွက်ပိုင်သူ။ သေတမ်းစာ အတည်ပြုသူ။
exegesis /eksÇ'dʒi:sÇs/ n (pl exegeses /-si:z/) [U, C] (fml )(အထူးသဖြင့် သမ္မာကျမ်းစာ) အဖွင့်ဋီကာ။
exemplar /Çg'zemplɑ:(r)/ n (fml )စံ။ စံပြ။an exemplar of theatre at its most challenging.
exemplary /Çg'zemplǝri/ adj၁။ စံထားထိုက်သော။ အတုယူ ထိုက်သော။ စံပြ။ exemplary behaviour ❍ an exemplary student.၂။ (law or fml ) နောင်ကြဉ်အောင် သတိပေးသော။ စံနမူနာပြ။ exemplary damages/punishment.

exemplify /Çg'zemplÇfaÇ/ v (pt , pp -fied )၁။ နမူနာဖြစ်သည်။ စံပြဖြစ်သည်။ Her style exemplifies modern Italian cooking at its best.၂။ (fml ) ဥပမာပေးသည်။ သာဓကပြသည်။ exemplify the problems involved. exemplification /ÇgzemplÇfÇ'keÇʃn/ n [U, C]

exempt /Çg'zempt/ adj ~ (from sth )လွတ်ငြိမ်းခွင့်ရသော။ ကင်းလွတ်ခွင့်ရသော။exempt from military service ❍ exempt from working overtime ❍ goods exempt from tax ❍ In the UK children under 16 are exempt from prescription charges.v ~ sb/sth (from sth) (fml ) လွတ်ငြိမ်းခွင့်ရသည်။ His bad eyesight exempted him from military service. exemption /Çg'zempʃn/ n [U, C] ~ (from sth) : claim/seek tax exemption ❍ exemptions from planning restrictions.

exercise /'eksǝsaÇz/ n၁။ (က) [U] ကိုယ်လက်လှုပ်ရှားခြင်း။ စိတ်အလုပ်ပေးခြင်း။ ဉာဏ်အလေ့အကျင့်။The doctor advised him to take more exercise. ❍ Jogging is a healthy form of exercise. ❍ Doing crosswords gives the mind some exercise. (ခ) [C] လေ့ကျင့်ခန်း။ vocal/gymnastic/keep-fit/deep-breathing exercises ❍ exercises for the piano/flute/harp ❍ The teacher gave her class a mathematics exercise for homework. ❍ an exercise book (ie a book for writing school work, notes, etc in).၂။ [U] ~ of sth အသုံးချခြင်း။ လက်ကိုင်ပြုခြင်း။ the exercise of one's civil rights ❍ The exercise of patience is essential in diplomatic negotiations. ❍ His stories showed considerable exercise of the imagination.၃။ [C] ~ (in sth) စွမ်းဆောင်မှု။ an exercise in public relations ❍ In the end it proved a pointless exercise.၄။ [C often pl ] စစ် လေ့ကျင့်ခန်း။ military exercises.၅။ exercises [pl] (US ) အခမ်းအနား။ graduation exercises ❍ opening exercises (eg speeches at the start of a conference).v ၁။ ကိုယ်လက်လေ့ကျင့်ခန်း ပြုလုပ်သည်။He exercises twice a day.၂။ (ကိုယ်စိတ်ကြံ့ခိုင်အောင်) လေ့ကျင့်သည်။Horses get fat and lazy if they are not exercised. ❍ Swimming exercises the whole body.၃။ ကျင့်သုံးသည်။ အသုံးချသည်။ exercise patience/tolerance/power/control ❍ exercise one's rights as a citizen ❍ Teachers exercise authority over their pupils.၄။ (fml ) ပူပန် ကြောင့်ကြသည်။ ရတက်မအေးဖြစ်သည်။ စိတ်ပူသည်။ This problem is exercising our minds a good deal at the moment. ❍ I am greatly exercised about my son's education.

exert /Çg'zɜ:t/ v၁။ ~ sth (on sb/sth) အသုံးပြုသည်။ သုံးသည်။He exerted all his influence to make them accept his plan. ❍ She exerted a lot of pressure on her children to succeed.၂။ ~ oneself (no passive) အားထုတ်ကြိုးပမ်းသည်။ ထကြွ လုံ့လစိုက်သည်။ You'll have to exert yourself more if you want to pass your exam. ❍ He doesn't have to exert himself on my behalf.

exertion /Çg'zɜ:ʃn/ n [C, U]အားစိုက်မှု။ ကြိုးပမ်းမှု။ ပင်ပန်းမှု။strenuous physical exertion ❍ Now that I'm 90, I find the exertions of travel too much for me. ❍ It requires no great exertion of the imagination to recognize that.
exeunt /'eksiʌnt/ v (Latin )(ဇာတ်ကသူ) ဆိုင်ရာဇာတ်ခန်း ပြီး၍ ဝင်သွားသည်။ Exeunt Antony and Cleopatra. Compare EXIT v ၂
ex gratia /eks 'greÇʃǝ/ adv , adj (Latin )စိတ်စေတနာအလျောက် ပေးသော၊ ပေးလျက်။an ex gratia payment.
exhale /eks'heÇl/ vအသက်ရှူထုတ်သည်။exhale air from the lungs ❍ exhale smoke ❍ She exhaled very slowly to show her annoyance. Compare INHALEexhalation /ekshǝ'leÇʃn/ n [U, C]
exhaust1 /Çg'zↄ:st/ n၁။ [U] ကားအင်ဂျင်စသည်မှ ထုတ်လွှတ်သော အခိုး။the smell of the exhaust ❍ exhaust fumes/emissions.၂။ (also exhaust-pipe ) [C] အိပ်ဇောပိုက်။My car needs a new exhaust.

exhaust2 /Çg'zↄ:st/ v၁။ ပင်ပန်းနွမ်းနယ်သည်။The long cycle ride exhausted her. ❍ She was exhausted by the trip. ❍ He exhausted himself trying to rescue the trapped animal.၂။ ကုန်ခန်းသည်။ exhaust one's strength ❍ My patience was finally exhausted. ❍ exhaust a money supply ❍ exhaust a well.၃။ ပြီးပြည့်စုံအောင် ပြောပြီး၊ ရေးပြီး၊ လေ့လာပြီး ဖြစ်သည်။I think we've exhausted that particular topic. ❏ exhausted adj ခြေကုန်လက်ပန်းကျသော။I'm absolutely/completely exhausted! ❍ She felt exhausted at the end of the climb. ❍ The exhausted troops surrendered. ❏ exhausting adj ခြေကုန်လက်ပန်းကျစေသော။It had been an exhausting day.

exhaustion /Çg'zↄ:stʃǝn/ n [U]၁။ ခြေကုန်လက်ပန်းကျခြင်း။ They were in a state of exhaustion after climbing for ten hours. ❍ She was overcome by nervous exhaustion.၂။ (fml ) ကုန်ခန်းခြင်း။ ပြုန်းတီးခြင်းthe exhaustion of the earth's natural resources.
exhaustive /Çg'zↄ:stÇv/ adjပြည့်စုံစေ့စပ်သော။ စုံတကာစေ့သော။conduct and exhaustive enquiry/search. exhaustively adv

exhibit /Çg'zÇbÇt/ n၁။ ပြတိုက်ပစ္စည်း။ ပြခန်းပစ္စည်း။ ပြပွဲပစ္စည်း။ a priceless exhibit ❍ The upper gallery contains some interesting new exhibits from Mexico. ❍ Do not touch the exhibits.၂။ (ရုံးတော်၌ တင်ပြသော) သက်သေခံ အထောက်အထား။ The first exhibit was a knife which the prosecution claimed was the murder weapon.၃။ (US ) = EXHIBITION ၁v ၁။ (က) ခင်းကျင်းပြသသည်။ exhibit flowers at a flower show ❍ documents exhibited in a lawcourt. (ခ) ~ (at/in…) (အနုပညာလက်ရာများ) ပြခန်းတင်သည်၊ ပြသသည်။ He has exhibited (his work) in several galleries.၂။ (fml ) ထုတ်ဖော်ပြသည်။ She exhibited great powers of endurance throughout the climb. ❍ He exhibited a total lack of concern for the child. ❏ exhibitor n ပြပွဲတင်သူ။ Nearly fifty exhibitors have provided photographs for the display.

exhibition /eksÇ'bÇʃn/ n၁။ (US also exhibit ) [C] ပြပွဲ။ ပြခန်း။ one of the exhibition halls at the book fair ❍ Have you seen the Picasso exhibition (ie the exhibition of paintings, etc by Picasso)?၂။ (က) [sing] ~ of sth စိတ်သဘောထားကို ထုတ်ဖော်ပြခြင်း။ an appalling exhibition of bad manners. (ခ) [C] (ကျွမ်းကျင်မှု) သရုပ်ပြပွဲ။ a dancing exhibition ❍ an exhibition of pottery-making ❍ The West Indies team gave a superb exhibition of clean, powerful hitting. ❏ exhibitionism /-ʃǝnÇzǝm/ n [U]၁။ (often derog ) ကိုယ်ရည်သွေးမှု။ the vein of exhibitionism that runs through all his writings.၂။ (psychology ) မဖွယ်မရာကို လူမြင်သာအောင် တမင် ပြတတ်သော စိတ်ဝေဒနာ။ ❏ exhibitionist /-ʃǝnÇst/ n အရေးစိုက်ခံချင်သူ။ Children are natural exhibitionists. ❏ make an exhibition of oneself [IDM ] (derog ) ကိုယ့် အထုပ်ကိုယ်ဖြေပြသည်။ ကိုယ့်ပေါင် ကိုယ်လှန်ထောင်းသည်။I'm afraid Frank got drunk and made an exhibition of himself.

exhilarate /Çg'zÇlǝreÇt/ v (usu passive)ရွှင်ပျလန်းဆန်း စေသည်။ မြူးကြွရွှင်လန်းစေသည်။ exhilarated by the news ❍ We felt exhilarated by our walk along the beach. ❏ exhilarating adjရင်ဖိုရသော။ ပျော်စရာကောင်းသော။My first parachute jump was an exhilarating experience. exhilaration /ÇgzÇlǝ'reÇʃn/ n [U]: the sheer exhilaration of sailing single-handed. တစ်ကိုယ်တော် ရွက်လွှင့် ရသော အရသာ။

exhort /Çg'zↄ:t/ v ~ sb (to sth/to do sth) (fml )အလေးအနက် တိုက်တွန်းသည်။ တွန်းအားပေးသည်။ The chairman exhorted the party workers to action. ❍ The teacher kept exhorting us to work harder. exhortation /egzↄ:'teÇʃn/ n [C, U]: All his father's exhortations were in vain.
exhume /eks'hju:m, Çg'zju:m; US Çg'zu:m/ v(စစ်ဆေးရန်) အလောင်းဖော်သည်။After exhuming the corpse the police discovered traces of poison in it. exhumation /ekshju:'meÇʃn/ n [U, C]
exigency /'eksÇdʒǝnsi, Çg'zÇdʒ-/ n [C often pl , U] (fml )လတ်တလောကိစ္စ။ အရေးပေါ်ကိစ္စ။prepare oneself for all exigencies ❍ the harsh exigencies of war.
exiguous /eg'zÇgjuǝs/ adj (fml )သေးသော။ နည်းသော။an exiguous diet ❍ the last of the old man's exiguous savings.

exile /'eksaÇl, 'egz-/ n၁။ [U] ပြည်နှင်ဒဏ်ခံရခြင်း။ be/live in exile ❍ go/be sent into exile ❍ a place of exile.၂။ [C] မိမိတိုင်းပြည်မှ ကြာရှည်စွာခွဲခွာနေခြင်း။ After an exile of ten years her uncle returned to Britain.၃။ [C] ဆန္ဒ အလျောက် မိမိတိုင်းပြည်မှ ထွက်ခွာသွားသူ။ ပြည်နှင်ဒဏ်ခံရသူ။ a tax exile (ie a rich person who moves to another country where the rate of income tax is lower) ❍ There were many French exiles in England after the Revolution.v ~ sb (from…) (esp passive) အနှင်ခံရသည်။ ပြည်နှင်ဒဏ် ခံရသည်။ be exiled for life ❍ the party's exiled leaders ❍ She was exiled from her country because of her part in the uprising.

exist /Çg'zÇst/ v၁။ (က) တည်သည်။ ရှိသည်။ laws that have existed for hundreds of years ❍ Do you believe fairies exist (ie that there are really fairies)? ❍ Does life exist on Mars? (ခ) တွေ့နိုင်သည်။ တည်ရှိသည်။ This plant exists only in Australia. ❍ Without conservation many species would cease to exist.၂။ ~ (on sth) အသက်ဆက် နေရသည်။ ရပ်တည်နေရသည်။ We cannot exist without food and water. ❍ He exists on rice and little else. ❍ I can hardly exist on the wages I'm getting. ❏ existence /-ǝns/ n၁။ [U] ရှိခြင်း။ ဖြစ်တည်ခြင်း။ Do you believe in the existence of ghosts? ❍ This is the oldest Hebrew manuscript in existence (ie that exists). ❍ When did the world come into existence (ie begin to exist)? ❍ I was unaware of his existence until today.၂။ (က) [sing] ရပ်တည်မှု။ ဘဝ။ living a miserable existence miles from the nearest town ❍ We led a happy enough existence as children. (ခ) [sing, U] အသက်ရှင်ရေး။ ရပ်တည်ရေး။ The peasants depend on a good harvest for their very existence (ie simply in order to survive). ❍ They eke out a bare existence (ie hardly manage to live) on her low salary. ❏ existent /-ǝnt/ adj (fml ) တကယ်ဖြစ်သော။ တကယ်တည်ရှိ သော။ Compare non-existent ❏ existing adj တည်ဆဲ။ existing rates of pay ❍ No changes need be made to the existing rules.

existentialism /egzÇ'stenʃǝlÇzǝm/ n [U] (philosophy )အတ္တဘဝအမှန်ဝါဒ။ (ဖြစ်တည်မှုပဓာနဝါဒ)။ ❏ existential /egzÇ'stenʃǝl/ adj၁။ (fml ) လူ့ဘဝနှင့် ဆိုင် သော။၂။ (philosophy ) အတ္တဘဝအမှန်ဝါဒ သဘောတရားနှင့် ဆိုင်သော။ existentialist /-ʃǝlÇst/ n , adj : She's an existentialist. ❍ She holds existentialist views.

exit /'eksÇt, 'egzÇt/ n၁။ ထွက်ခွာခြင်း။ ဇာတ်ဆောင် ကားလိပ်နောက်သို့ ဝင်ခြင်း။ The heroine makes her exit (from the stage). ❍ To avoid meeting her he made a swift exit (ie he left quickly). ❍ an exit visa (ie a stamp or signature on a passport giving sb permission to leave a particular country).၂။ ထွက်ပေါက်။ There are four fire exits in the department store. ❍ The emergency exit is at the back of the bus. ❍ The exit signs in hospitals are usually illuminated.၃။ အထွက်လမ်း။ At the roundabout, take the third exit. ❍ Get off the freeway at the exit for Encinitas. ❍ We leave the autoroute at the next exit.v ၁။ ထွက်ခွာသည်။ သရုပ်ဆောင်ခန်းပြီး၍ ကားလိပ်နောက်သို့ ဝင်သည်။She exits in the middle of the third scene. ❍ Scotland exited from the World Cup after their defeat by Germany.၂။ (3rd pers sing only ) (Latin ) (ဇာတ်သုံး စကား)။ ဝင်စေ။ Exit Macbeth. Compare EXEUNT ❏ exit poll n မဲထည့်ပြီးသူများနှင့် တွေ့ဆုံမေးမြန်းခန့်မှန်း သော မဲအခြေအနေ။

exodus /'eksǝdǝs/ n [sing] ~ (from…) (to…) (fml or joc )(တစ်ချိန်တည်း) အစုအပြုံလိုက်ထွက်ခွာခြင်း။ the mass exodus of people to the seaside for the summer holidays ❍ The play was so awful that there was a general exodus from the theatre at the interval.
ex officio /eks ǝ'fÇʃiǝƱ/ adj , adv (fml )ရာထူးအရ။ an ex officio member of the committee ❍ He was present at the meeting ex officio.
exonerate /Çg'zɒnǝreÇt/ v ~ sb (from sth)အပြစ်မရှိကြောင်း ထုတ်ဖော်ကြေညာသည်။A commission of inquiry exonerated him (from all responsibility for the accident).
exorbitant /Çg'zↄ:bÇtǝnt/ adj (fml )မတန်တဆ။exorbitant rents ❍ The price of food here is exorbitant. exorbitantly adv : exorbitantly expensive.

exorcize , -ise /'eksↄ:saÇz/ v ~ sth (from sb/sth )မကောင်းဆိုးဝါး ကို နှင်သည်။ ချွတ်လွှဲသည်။A priest exorcized the ghost from the house. ❍ (fig ) She can never exorcize the memory of her childhood sufferings. ❏ exorcism /'eksↄ:sÇzǝm/ n [U, C] အစွဲချွတ်ခြင်း။ မကောင်းဆိုးဝါးနှင်ခြင်း။ ❏ exorcist /'eksↄ:sÇst/ n ချွတ်လွှဲပေးသူ။ ပယောဂဆရာ။

exotic /Çg'zɒtÇk/ adj၁။ တိုင်းတစ်ပါးမှလာသော။ ဒေသဖြစ် မဟုတ်သော။ exotic houseplants ❍ monkeys and other exotic animals.၂။ ထူးခြားဆန်းပြားသော။ အရောင်အသွေး စုံစုံနှင့် စွဲကြိုက်နှစ်သက်ဖွယ် ကောင်းသော။exotic plumage/clothes.
exotica /Çg'zɒtÇkǝ/ n [pl]အထူးအဆန်းပစ္စည်း။ ရှားပါးပစ္စည်း။a sale of antiques and exotica.

expand /Çk'spænd/ v၁။ ~ (sth) (into sth) ကြီးလာ၊ ကျယ်လာ၊ ကားလာ၊ ပြန့်လာသည်။ ယင်းသို့ဖြစ်စေသည်။ ဆန့်သည်။ စန့် သည်။ တိုးချဲ့သည်။Metals expand when they are heated. ❍ A tyre expands when you pump air into it. ❍ His modest business eventually expanded into a supermarket empire. ❍ We have greatly expanded our foreign trade in recent years. ❍ Why don't you expand your story into a novel?၂။ ပွင့်ကားသည်။ ပြန့်ကားသည်။The petals of the flowers expanded in the sunshine. ❍ His face expanded in a smile of welcome. Compare CONTRACT v ၅(ခ)၃။ ရင်းရင်းနှီးနှီးဖြစ်လာသည်။ လေပေး ဖြောင့်လာ သည်။She expanded considerably after a glass or two of wine. ❏ expand on sth [PHRV ] ထပ်ရှင်းသည်။You mentioned the need for extra funding. Could you expand on that?
expanse /Çk'spæns/ n ~ (of sth)ပြင်ကျယ်။ ပြန့်ကျယ်။ တစ်ပြင် တစ်ခွင်။wide expanses of flat, open farmland ❍ Her short skirt exposed a large expanse of thigh.

expansion /Çk'spænʃn/ n [U, C]ကျယ်ပြန့်ခြင်း။ ပြန့်ကားခြင်း။ တိုးချဲ့ခြင်း။ ယင်းအခြေအနေ။ the expansion of gases when heated ❍ the expansion of his business interests ❍ expansions of the school system under successive governments. ❏ expansionism /-ʃǝnÇzǝm/ n [U]နယ်ချဲ့ရေးဝါဒ။ the cultural and economic expansionism of Europe and America. expansionist /-ʃǝnÇst/ adj , n :Hitler's expansionist policies ❍ a ruthless expansionist.

expansive /Çk'spænsÇv/ adj၁။ ပြန့်ကားသော။ He greeted us with an expansive gesture (eg he stretched his arms wide) and a wide smile.၂။ ရင်းရင်းနှီးနှီး စကားဖောင်ဖွဲ့ လိုသော။ He was clearly relaxed and in an expansive mood. expansively adv expansiveness n [U]
expatiate /Çk'speÇʃieÇt/ v❏ expatiate on/upon sth [PHRV ] (fml ) အကျယ်တဝင့် ရေးသားပြောဆိုသည်။He was expatiating eloquently on the state of the economy.
expatriate /eks'pætriǝt; US -'peÇt-/ nပြည်ပြေး။ American expatriates in Paris ❍ expatriate Englishmen in Spain.

expect /Çk'spekt/ v၁။ (က) ~ sth (from sb/sth) မျှော်လင့်သည်။ မှန်းသည်။ ထင်သည်။ တွက်သည်။ This is the parcel we've been expecting (from New York). ❍ I expect (that) I'll be back on Sunday. ❍ You can't expect to learn a foreign language in a week. ❍ We expected him (to arrive) yesterday. ❍ House prices are expected to rise sharply. ❍ You would expect there to be some disagreement on this point. (ခ) ~ sth (from sb) ယုံကြည်ထား သည်။ မျှော်လင့်ထားသည်။ ထင်ထားသည်။ I was half expecting a present (from her) and was rather disappointed when I didn't get one. ❍ I'm still learning the job so please don't expect too much (from me). ❍ Don't expect any sympathy from me! ❍ WAIT၂။ ~ sth (from sb) လိုလားသည်။ An officer expects obedience from his men/expects that his men will obey him/expects his men to obey him. ❍ I expect you to be punctual. ❍ You will be expected to work on Saturdays.၃။ (infml esp Brit ) ထင်သည်။ ‘Who has eaten all the cake?’ ‘Tom, I expect/I expect (that) it was Tom. ’ ❍ ‘Will you be late?’ ‘I expect so. ’ ❏ be expecting (a baby/child) [IDM ] (infml ) ကိုယ်ဝန် ရှိသည်။ I hear Sally's expecting again. ❏ expectancy /Çk'spektǝnsi/ n [U] မျှော်လင့်ထားဟန်။ မျှော်လင့်နေပုံ။ There was an air/a sence of expectancy among the waiting crowd. See also LIFE EXPECTANCY ❏ expectant /Çk'spektǝnt/ adj၁။ မျှော်လင့်စောင့်စား သော။ children with expectant faces waiting for the pantomime to start.၂။ ကလေးရတော့မည် ဖြစ်သော။ expectantly adv ❏ expect sth of sb/sth [PHRV ] ယုံကြည်မျှော်လင့် ထားသည်။ I expected better of him (ie that he would behave better). ❍ People expect courtesy of the police. Compare UNEXPECTED ❏ (be only) to be expected [IDM ] ဖြစ်လာနိုင်တယ်။ ဖြစ်တတ်တယ်။ ဖြစ်ရိုးဖြစ်စဉ်ပဲ။A little tiredness after taking these drugs is to be expected. ❍ It is only to be expected your sonwill leave home eventually.

expectation /ek'spek'teÇʃn/ n၁။ [U] ~ (of sth) မျှော်လင့်ချက်။He has little expectation of winning a prize. ❍ A few fans waited for a glimpse of the star, but more in hope than in expectation. ❍ In the twentieth century people's expectation of life has been greatly increased.၂။ [C usu pl ] မျှော်မှန်းချက်။ His parents have great expectations for his future. ❍ She had high expectations of what university had to offer. ❍ The holiday was beyond all our expectations (ie better than we had hoped for). ❏ against/ contrary to (all) expectation(s) [IDM ] ထင်ထားတာနှင့်တလွဲ။ a gold medal that was against all expectations. ❏ fall short of sb's/ not come up to (sb's) expectations [IDM ] မျှော်လင့်ထားသလောက် ဖြစ်မလာ။ မှန်းချက်နှင့် နှမ်းထွက်မကိုက်။ Unfortunately the restaurant he recommended fell far short of our expectations. ❍ His performance didn't come up to expectations.
expectorant /Çk'spektǝrǝnt/ n (techn )သလိပ်ပျော်ဆေး။ The cough medicine contains an expectorant.

expedient /Çk'spi:diǝnt/ adjသင့်တော်လျော်ကန်[သော]။ သင့်တော် သလို လုပ်[သော]။ အသုံးတည့် [သော]။His action is seen as expedient rather than principled. ❍ The government has clearly decided that a cut in interest rates would be politically expedient. expedience /-ǝns/ (also expediency /-ǝnsi/) n [U]: He acted from expediency, not from principle.n လက်တွေ့အကျိုးဖြစ်စေသော နည်းလမ်း။She gets quicker results by the simple expedient of telephoning customers rather than writing to them.
expedite /'ekspǝdaÇt/ v (fml )အလုပ်တွင်စေသည်။ သွက်လက် မြန်ဆန်စေသည်။ rapid order processing to expedite delivery to customers.

expedition /ekspǝ'dÇʃn/ n (က) ရည်ရွယ်ချက်တစ်ခုခုဖြင့် စုရုံးသွား သော ခရီး။ စူးစမ်းလေ့လာရေးခရီး။ plan/ go on an expedition to the North Pole ❍ a hunting expedition ❍ (joc) a shopping expedition. (ခ) ယင်းခရီးသွားအဖွဲ့။ members of the Mount Everest expedition. ❏ expeditionary /-ʃǝnǝri; US -neri/ adj ယင်းအဖွဲ့နှင့် ဆိုင်သော။ (အထူးသဖြင့်) နိုင်ငံရပ်ခြား ၌ စစ်ဆင်ရေးအတွက် ဖွဲ့စည်းစေလွှတ်သော (တပ်)။ an expeditionary force (eg an army sent to take part in a war abroad).
expeditious /ekspǝ'dÇʃǝs/ adj (fml )မြန်ဆန် ထိရောက်သော။ an expeditious response. expeditiously adv : The work will be carried out as expeditiously as possible.

expel /Çk'spel/ v (-ll- ) ~ sb (from sth)၁။ နှင်ထုတ်သည်။ ထုတ်ပစ်သည်။ Two members of the embassy staff were expelled from the country. ❍ Following reports of drug-taking at the school, several senior boys have been expelled.၂။ မှုတ်ထုတ်သည်။ expel air from the lungs ❍ a fan in the kitchen for expelling cooking smells. See also EXPULSION

expend /Çk'spend/ v ~ sth (in/ on sth/ doing sth) (fml )သုံးစွဲ သည်။ သုံးစွဲကုန်ကျသည်။expend time, effort and money(on a project) ❍ He had already expended large sums in pursuing his claim through the courts. ❏ expendable adj (fml ) သုံးပစ်လိုက်နိုင်သော။ ဖျက်ပစ်လိုက် နိုင်သော။Former allies were considered expendable.

expenditure /Çk'spendÇtʃǝ(r)/ n၁။ (က) [C, U] သုံးစွဲကုန်ကျ ငွေ။ အသုံးစရိတ်။an increase in defence/ capital/ public expenditure ❍ an expenditure of £1000 on new furniture ❍ a programme to reduce expenditure ❍ Limit your expenditure to what is essential. Compare INCOME(ခ) [U] အကုန်အကျ။ the expenditure of money on weapons.၂။ သုံးစွဲခြင်း။ a huge expenditure of time and energy.

expense /Çk'spens/ n၁။ (က) [U] အကုန်အကျ။ စရိတ်။ the expense of time, energy and cash ❍ He hired a plane, regardless of expense. ❍ Most children in Britain are educated at public expense. ❍ The garden was transformed at great/ considerable/ vast expense. ❍ She spared no expense (ie spent as much money as was needed) to make the party a success. (ခ) [C usu sing ] ငွေကုန်ပေါက်။ ငွေယိုပေါက်။ Running a car is a big expense.၂။ expenses [pl] စရိတ်စက။ အကုန်အကျ။ travelling expenses ❍ House repairs, new furniture and other expenses reduced her bank balance to almost nothing. ❍ Who's meeting (ie paying for) the expenses of your trip? ❍ She's just returned from an all-expenses-paid trip to Sweden (ie paid for by her employer). ❏ at sb's expense [IDM ] ၁။ အကုန်အကျခံလျက်။ We were entertained at the company's expense.၂။ ရယ်သွမ်း သွေးလျက်။ ရယ်စရာလုပ်လျက်။ They had a good laugh at Sam's expense. ❏ at the expense of sth [IDM ] အဆုံးရှုံး အနစ်နာခံလျက်။ အထိခိုက်ခံလျက်။ He build up a successful business but at the expense of his health. ❏ expense account n လုပ်ငန်းသုံးငွေစာရင်း။ Whenever he entertains clients, he puts it on/ charges it to his expense account. ❏ go to/ put sb to the expense of sth/ doing sth, go to/ put sb to a lot of, etc expense [IDM ] ငွေကုန်ကြေးကျခံ သည်။ ကုန်ကျသည်။ It's stupid to go to the expense of taking music lessons if you never practise. ❍ Their visit has put us to a great deal of expense. ❏ no expense(s) spared [IDM ] ကုန်ချင်ကုန်ပါစေ။ ကုန်စမ်း ပါစေ။ I'm going to take you out to dinner, no expense spared.

Expensive /Çk'spensÇv/ adjဈေးကြီးသော။ တန်ဖိုးကြီးသော။an expensive car ❍ Houses are very expensive in this area. ❍ It's too expensive for me to buy. Compare INEXPENSIVE expensively adv : an expensively dressed woman.

experience /Çk'spÇǝriǝns/ n၁။ [U] ကိုယ်တွေ့။ အတွေ့အကြုံ။ We all learn by experience. ❍ Not many people have had experience of real hunger. ❍ Does she have much teaching experience? ❍ He hasn't had enough previous experience (ie experience of work) for us to give him the job. ❍ Our next speaker is a person with long experience of this problem. ❍ I know from experience that he'll arrive late.၂။ [C] ထူးထူးခြားခြား အတွေ့အကြုံ။ an unpleasant/ a trying/ an unusual experience ❍ You must try some of her home-made wine — it's quite an experience (ie it is very unusual)! ❍ He had many interesting experiences while travelling in Africa.v တွေ့ကြုံသည်။ ခံစားသည်။ experience pleasure/ pain/ difficulty/ hardship ❍ The child had never experienced kindness. ❍ I experienced a brief moment of panic. ❏ experienced adjအတွေ့အကြုံရှိသော။ ဝါရင့်သော။ သမ္ဘာ ရင့်။an experienced nurse ❍ He's experienced in looking after children. ❏ experiential /ÇkspÇǝri'enʃl/ adj (fml ) အတွေ့အကြုံနှင့် ဆိုင်သော။ အတွေ့အကြုံကို အခြေခံသော။ experiential knowledge.

experiment /Çk'sperÇmǝnt/ n [C, U] (က) (သိပ္ပံ) လက်တွေ့ သုတေသန။ perform/ carry out/ conduct an experiment ❍ The researchers are repeating the experiment on rats. ❍ prove a theory by experiment. (ခ) ~ (in sth) စမ်းသပ် လုပ်ဆောင်ချက်။ an experiment in communal living ❍ The play was staged as an experiment.v ~ (on sb/ sth); ~ (with sth) စမ်းသပ်လေ့လာသည်။ သုတေသနလုပ်သည်။We experimented until we succeeded in mixing the right colour. ❍ experiment on animals ❍ experiment with different hairstyles. ❏ experimentation /ÇksperÇmen'teÇʃn/ n [U] (fml ) စမ်းသပ်လေ့လာမှု။ experimentation with a new brand of socialism ❍ Many people object to experimentation on embryos. ❏ experimenter n(လက်တွေ့) သုတေသီ။

experimental /ÇksperÇ'mentl/ adjစမ်းသပ်လေ့လာနေဆဲ။ အစမ်း သဘော။an experimental farm ❍ an experimental physicist ❍ experimental theatre ❍ The technique is still at the experimental stage — it hasn't been fully developed yet. ❍ Doctors stress that this type of treatment is still experimental. experimentally /-tǝli/ adv : The new measures were introduced experimentally in 1993.

expert /'ekspɜ:t/ n ~ (at/in/ on sth/ doing sth)ကျွမ်းကျင်သူ။ ပညာရှင်။ ပါရဂူ။ an agricultural expert ❍ an expert in psychology ❍ get the advice of the experts ❍ an expert at getting his own way ❍ an expert on Japan/ Mozart/ ancient Greek vases.adj ~ (at/ in sth/ doing sth) ကျွမ်းကျင်သော။ ပါရဂူ မြောက်သော။ take expert advice ❍ an expert rider ❍ have expert knowledge ❍ He's expert at/ in cooking good cheap meals. ❍ She glanced down the page with on expert eye. Compare INEXPERT expertly adv : expertly applied theatrical make-up. ❏ expert system n (computing ) ဆိုင်ရာပညာရှင်များထံမှ အတွေ့အကြုံ၊ ဗဟုသုတများ သိုမှီးထား၍ ယင်းကိုအခြေခံပြီး မေးခွန်းပြဿနာ ဖော်ထုတ် အကြံဉာဏ်ပေးခြင်း ပြုလုပ်ပေးသော ကွန်ပျူတာပရိုဂရမ် စနစ်။ an expert system to aid medical diagnosis.

expertise /ekspɜ:'ti:z/ n [U] ~ (in sth/ doing sth)(ပညာခန်း ဆိုင်ရာ) ကျွမ်းကျင်မှု။ professional/scientific/ technical expertise ❍ They have considerable expertise in dealing with oil spills. ❍ We were amazed at his expertise on the ski slopes.
expiate /'ekspieÇt/ v (fml )အပြစ်ကိုခံယူသည်။ အမှားအတွက် ကျေနပ်အောင် ပြုသည်။expiate one's guilt. expiation /ekspi'eÇʃn/ n [U]

expire /Çk'spaÇǝ(r)/ v၁။ သက်တမ်းကုန်သည်။ သက်တမ်းစေ့သည်။ Our present lease on the house expires next month. ❍ When does your driving licence expire? ❍ His term of office as Chairman expires at the end of June.၂။ (esp medical ) အသက်ရှူထုတ်သည်။၃။ (dated fml ) ကွယ်လွန်သည်။ ❏ expiration /ekspǝ'reÇʃn/ n [U] (fml )၁။ သက်တမ်း အဆုံး။ သက်တမ်းကုန်ဆုံးချိန်။ the expiration of a lease/ tenancy/ share offer.၂။ (esp medical ) အသက်ရှူထုတ်ခြင်း။
expiry /Çk'spaÇǝri/ n ~ (of sth)သက်တမ်းကုန်ဆုံးခြင်း။ the expiry of a driving licence/ lease/ credit card ❍ What is the expiry date?

explain /Çk'spleÇn/ v၁။ ~ sth (to sb) ရှင်းချက်ထုတ်သည်။ အကြောင်းပြသည်။ ဖြေရှင်းသည်။ That explains his absence. ❍ He explained that his train had been delayed. ❍ ‘I had to wait over an hour at the dentist's,’ he explained. ❍ They explained what had happened. ❍ Please explain why you are late. ❍ She explained her conduct to her boss. ❍ She explained to the children that the school had been closed. ❍ The manager has explained to customers why the goods were late.၂။ ~ sth (to sb) (အသေးစိတ်) ရှင်းလင်းပြသည်။ ရှင်းပြသည်။ A dictionary explains the meaning of words. ❍ He explained his plan to us. ❍ Can you explain (to me) how it works? ❍ Let me explain. ❏ explain oneself [IDM ]၁။ ကိုယ့်ဟာကိုယ် ရှင်းပြသည်။ I don't understand your argument— could you explain yourself a bit more?၂။ (fml ) ကိုယ့်လုပ်ရပ်ကိုယ်ရှင်းပြသည်။ Last week you were late for work every day — please explain yourself. ❏ explain sth away [PHRV ] ဆင်ခြေပေးသည်။ အကြောင်းပြ ချက် ပေးသည်။Government ministers will not find it easy to explain away their poor performance in recent by-elections.

explanation /eksplǝ'neÇʃn/ n၁။ [U] ရှင်းပြချက်။ He left the room without (further) explanation. ❍ These developments need a word of explanation. ❍ ‘I had to see you,’ he said by way of explanation.၂။ [C] အကြောင်းပြခြင်း။ ဖြေရှင်းချက်။a plausible/ satisfactory explanation of the mystery ❍ That's not an adequate explanation ❍ The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed. ❍ I can think of no other explanation for his absence.
explanatory /Çk'splænǝtri;US -tↄ:ri/ adjရှင်းလင်းဖော်ပြသော။explanatory notes at the back of a book.
expletive /Çk'spli:tÇv;US 'eksplǝtÇv/ n (fml )(ဆဲရေးတိုင်းထွာ စကား)။ (မကြားဝံ့မနာသာစကား)။ ‘Damn!’ is an expletive. ❍ She dropped the iron on her foot and uttered several vigorous expletives.
explicable /Çk'splÇkǝbl, 'eksplÇkǝbl/ adj (fml )ရှင်းပြ၍ ရနိုင် သော။ နားလည်နိုင်လောက်သော။ His behaviour is explicable in the light of his recent illness. Compare INEXPLICABLE
explicate /'eksplÇkeÇt/ v (fml )စိတ်ဖြာရှင်းလင်းသည်။ explicate one's moral values. explication /eksplÇ'keÇʃn/ n [U, C]: give a long explication of a theory.

explicit /Çk'splÇsÇt/ adj၁။ (က) ပြည့်စုံရှင်းလင်းစွာ ဖော်ပြထားသော။He gave me explicit directions (on) how to get there. ❍ They gave explicit reasons for leaving. (ခ) တိကျ ပြတ်သားသော။ ပွင့်လင်းသော။ She was quite explicit about why she had left. Compare IMPLICIT ၁၂။ တစ် တစ်ခွခွ။ The film contains a number of explicit sex scenes. explicitly adv : a novel dealing explicitly with incest ❍ He was explicitly forbidden to see the children. explicitness n [U]: sexual explicitness in the arts.

explode /Çk'splǝƱd/ v၁။ ပေါက်ကွဲသည်။ The boiler exploded, injuring several people. ❍ The firework exploded in his hand. ❍ They exploded the bomb by remote control. Compare IMPLODE၂။ (က) ~ (with/ into sth) မထိန်းချုပ်နိုင်ဘဲ အော်သည်၊ ငိုသည်၊ ရယ်သည် စသည်။ ‘Something wrong!’ he exploded, ‘You ask me if there's something wrong!’ ❍ explode with rage/ fury/ joy ❍ Everyone exploded into laughter. (ခ) (ခံစားချက်) ပွင့်ထွက်သည်၊ ပေါက်ကွဲသည်။ At last his anger exploded.၃။ ~ (into sth) ရုတ်တရက် အကြီးအကျယ် ဖြစ်ပေါ်ပြောင်းလဲ သည်။ The protest march exploded into a riot. ❍ In spring the resort explodes into life.၄။ (လူဦးရေ) ထိန်း မနိုင် သိမ်းမရ တိုးပွားသည်။ the exploding world population.၅။ (အတွေးအခေါ်၊ စိတ်ကူးစသည်) ပျက်ပြယ်သွားသည်။ explode a superstition ❍ The myth that eating carrots improves your eyesight was exploded years ago. See also EXPLOSION ❏ exploded adj (used of a drawing or diagram) အရာဝတ္ထု၏ အစိတ်အပိုင်းအဆက်အစပ် နေရာ များ ကို အနည်းငယ် ခွာ၍ ရေးဆွဲဖော်ပြထားသော (ပုံ)။ exploded drawings of aircraft.
exploit1 /'eksplↄÇt/ n [C usu pl ]စွန့်စားခန်း။He describes his exploits as a war correspondent in his new autobiography. ❍ (joc ) I'm not interested in hearing about Bill's amorous exploits. ❍ ACT

exploit2 /Çk'splↄÇt/ v၁။ အပြည့်အဝ အသုံးချသည်။ အကျိုးရှိရှိ သုံးစွဲသည်။ exploit oil reserves/ water power/ solar energy ❍ exploit an opportunity.၂။ (derog ) ခေါင်းပုံဖြတ် သည်။ ကိုယ်ကျိုးရှာသည်။ အမြတ်ထုတ်သည်။child labour exploited in factories ❍ exploit a situation for one's own advantage ❍ They exploited her generosity shamelessly. ❏ exploitation /eksplↄÇ'teÇʃn/ n [U] (sometimes derog ) အပြည့်အဝ အသုံးချခြင်း။ အမြတ်ထုတ်ခြင်း။ full exploitation of oil wells ❍ the exploitation of cheap labour. ❏ exploitative /Çk'splↄÇtǝtÇv/ adj (derog ) ခေါင်းပုံဖြတ် သော။the exploitative role of multinational companies. exploiter n : exploiters of anti-government feelings.

explore /Çk'splↄ:(r)/ v၁။ (က) သွားလာစူးစမ်း ရှာဖွေသည်။ explore the Arctic regions ❍ Columbus discovered America but did not explore it. ❍ explore the sea bed for (ie in the hope of finding) oil ❍ As soon as they arrived in the town they went out to explore. (ခ) (လက်၊ ခြေဖြင့်) စမ်းသည်။ explore the dark recesses of the cupboard.၂။ စူးစမ်းစစ်ဆေးသည်။ လေ့လာဖော်ထုတ်သည်။ explore one's conscience ❍ We explored several solutions to the problem. ❍ The biological effects of radiation are still being explored. exploration /eks- plǝ'reÇʃn/ n [U, C]: the exploration of space ❍ a voyage of exploration ❍ oil/ gas exploration (ie looking for natural oil/ gas reserves) ❍ a detailed exploration of the subject ❍ the film's explorations of human character ❍ Her explorations led her into the deserts of central Asia. ❏ exploratory /Çk'splɒrǝtri;US -tↄ:ri/ adjစူးစမ်း လေ့လာရေး။ exploratory medical tests ❍ an exploratory expedition up the Amazon. ❏ explorer /Çk'splↄ:rǝ(r)/ nစူးစမ်းလေ့လာသူ။ နယ်သစ် ရှာဖွေသူ။cave explorers ❍ Marco Polo was one of the great explorers.

explosion /Çk'splǝƱʒn/ n၁။ (က) ပေါက်ကွဲခြင်း။ ပေါက်ကွဲသံ။gas explosions ❍ The explosion was heard over a mile away.(ခ) (ခံစားချက်) ပွင့်အန်ထွက်ခြင်း။an explosion of rage.၂။ တစ်ဟုန်ထိုး တိုးပွားခြင်း။a population explosion ❍ an explosion of interest in learning Japanese ❍ the explosion of oil prices.

explosive /Çk'splǝƱsÇv, -zÇv/ adj၁။ ပေါက်ကွဲတတ်သော။ ပေါက်ကွဲလွယ်သော။an explosive mixture of chemicals ❍ explosive materials ❍ Hydrogen is highly explosive.၂။ [ဥ] ပေါက်ကွဲနိုင်သော။ an explosive situation/ issue ❍ an explosive temper ❍ Politics can be an explosive subject.n [C, U] ပေါက်ကွဲတတ်သော ပစ္စည်း။ secret stores of arms and explosives ❍ The bomb was packed with several pounds of high explosive(ie a substance that explodes with great force). explosively adv

exponent /Çk'spǝƱnǝnt/ n၁။ (ဝါဒ၊ အယူအဆ တစ်ခုခုကို) ထောက်ခံအားပေးသူ။ a leading exponent of free trade ❍ Huxley was an exponent of Darwin's theory of evolution.၂။ (အတတ်တစ်ခုခုတွင်) ကျွမ်းကျင်ပိုင်နိုင်သူ။the most famous exponent of the art of mime.၃။ (mathematics ) ထပ်ညွှန်း။ In a3, the figure3 is the exponent. ❏ exponential /ekspǝ'nenʃl/ adj (mathematics )၁။ ထပ်ညွှန်းနှင့်ဆိုင်သော။ ထပ်ညွှန်းနှင့်ပြထားသော။ 24 is an exponential expression.၂။ ကိန်းတူချင်း အဆင့်ဆင့် ထပ်မြှောက်၍ ရသော။ ယင်းသို့ မြှောက်ထားကြောင်း ညွှန်ပြသော။ an exponential curve/ function ❍ (fig ) exponential (ie more and more rapid) growth. exponentially /-ʃǝli/ adv : increase exponentially.

export /Çk'spↄ:t/ v၁။ ~ (sth) (to…) နိုင်ငံခြားသို့ ကုန်တင်ပို့သည်။ Currently only 5% of their output is exported. ❍ steel-exporting countries ❍ Much of the fruit is exported to Europe. ❍ India exports tea and cotton to many different countries.၂။ တိုင်းတစ်ပါးသို့ ဖြန့်ဖြူးသည်။ The powerful dance rhythm has been exported across the world. Compare IMPORT vn ၁။ [U] ပို့ကုန်လုပ်ငန်း။ a ban on the export of gold ❍ an export licence ❍ launch an export drive ❍ export duties (ie tax paid on goods sent abroad for sale).၂။ [C usu pl ] ပို့ကုန်။ a system of export quotas ❍ calls for the government to support industry and promote exports ❍ a rise/ fall in exports ❍ What are the country's chief exports? Compare IMPORT n ❏ exportation /ekspↄ:'teÇʃn/ n [U] ပြည်ပသို့ ကုန်စည် တင်ပို့ခြင်း။ He manufactures paper for exportation only. ❏ exporter n ပို့ကုန်တင်ပို့သောသူ၊ ကုမ္ပဏီ၊ တိုင်းပြည်။ Britain is no longer a net exporter of vehicles. ❍ Argentina is the world's biggest/ leading exporter of beef products.

expose /Çk'spǝƱz/ v၁။ မြင်သာအောင်ပြသည်။ ဖော်သည်။ လှစ်သည်။ His trousers were too short, exposing his white ankles. ❍ She lifted the leaves to expose a lovely row of radishes.၂။ ~ sth/ sb/ oneself (to sth) ပေါ်လာသည်။ အဖုံးအအုပ် အကာအကွယ်မဲ့ထားသည်။ ထိတွေ့စေသည်။ The soil was washed away by the flood, exposing the bare rock. ❍ expose employees to unnecessary risks ❍ Don't expose babies to strong sunlight. ❍ (fig ) expose oneself to criticism/ ridicule ❍ He believes in regularly exposing his pupils to great works of art.၃။ ဖော်ထုတ်သည်။ expose a plot/ a fraud/ an injustice/ a weakness ❍ an unfortunate remark which exposed his ignorance of the subject ❍ She was exposed as an impostor.၄။ (ဖလင်ကို) အလင်းရောင်နှင့် ထိတွေ့စေသည်။ expose a reel of film.၅။ ~ oneself လူရှေ့သူရှေ့၌ မဖွယ်မရာ လှစ်ပြသည်။ See also၁။ ဟာလာဟင်းလင်းဖြစ်နေသော။ The cottage is in a very exposed position at the top of the hill.၂။ ဝေဖန်တိုက်ခိုက်မှုအတွက် အကာအကွယ်မဲ့သော။ She was left feeling exposed and vulnerable.
exposé /ek'spǝƱzeÇ;US ekspǝƱ'zeÇ/ nအုတ်အော်သောင်းနင်း ဖြစ်စေသော ဖော်ထုတ်ချက်။ a damning exposé of corruption within the government.
exposition /ekspǝ'zÇʃn/ n (fml )၁။ [C, U] ရှင်းလင်းဖော်ပြခြင်း။a brilliant exposition of the advantages of nuclear power.၂။ [C] (ကုန်စည် စသည်) ပြပွဲ။
expostulate /Çk'spɒstʃuleÇt/ v (fml )ဟန့်သည်။ ငြင်းခုံ ကန့်ကွက် သည်။They expostulated about the financial risks involved in his plan.expostulation /Çkspɒstʃu'leÇʃn/ n [U, C]

exposure /Çk'spǝƱʒǝ(r)/ n၁။ [U] ~ (to sth) ဖော်ထုတ်ခြင်း။ ထိတွေ့ခြင်း။ brief/ prolonged exposure to radiation ❍ the exposure of currency frauds ❍ the benefits of constant exposure to a bilingual environment. See also INDECENT EXPOSURE၂။ [U] ပြင်းထန်သော ရာသီဥတုဒဏ်ခံရခြင်း။ Two climbers were brought in suffering from exposure.၃။ [U] ကြော်ငြာခြင်း။ seeking maximum exposure ❍ Her new film has had a lot of exposure in the media.၄။ [C] (က) ဓာတ်ပုံရိုက်ခြင်း။ ဖလင်ကွက်။take/ make four exposures.(ခ) (ဓာတ်ပုံရိုက်ရာ ၌) အလင်းရောင်ဖွင့်ပေးချိန်။ We used long exposures. ❍ an exposure meter.

expound /Çk'spaƱnd/ v ~ sth (to sb); ~ on sth (fml )အသေး စိတ် ရှင်းပြသည်။expound a theory ❍ He expounded his views on education to me at great length. ❍ We left him still expounding on the last act of the play.

express /Çk'spres/ v၁။ ဖော်ပြသည်။ သိမြင်စေသည်။express one's doubts/ reservations/ fears about sth ❍ express one's emotions/ views/ interest/ surprise ❍ Words cannot express my gratitude to all those who have supported me. ❍ I still can't express how I feel.၂။ ~ oneself ပြောဆို ရေးသားဖော်ပြသည်။ အမူအရာဖြင့်ပြသည်။ He is still unable to express himself in English. ❍ Dramatic gestures were how she often chose to express herself.၃။ ~ sth as/ in sth (esp mathematics ) (esp passive) သင်္ကေတနှင့် ဖော်ပြသည်။ The prices are expressed in local currency. ❍ The figures are expressed as percentages.adj ၁။ (esp Brit ) အမြန်။an express delivery service ❍ an express letter ❍ an express bus/ coach.၂။ တိကျပြတ်သား သော။ It was his express wish that you should have his gold watch after he died.adv (esp Brit ) အမြန်ချောပို့စနစ်ဖြင့်။ The parcel was sent express.n ၁။ (also express train ) [C] အမြန်ရထား။ the 0800 express to Edinburgh ❍ the Baltimore express.၂။ (က) (also esp US special delivery ) [U] အမြန်ပို့စနစ်။ အမြန်ချော။ send goods by express. (ခ) [C] (US ) အမြန်ကုန်ပို့ ကုမ္ပဏီ။ ❏ expressly adv ၁။ အသေအချာ၊ အတိအကျ။ You were expressly told not to touch my papers.၂။ အထူးတလည် ရည်ရွယ်၍။ a dictionary expressly written for foreign students of English.

expression /Çk'spreʃn/ n၁။ [C] မျက်နှာထား။ မျက်နှာပေး။ မျက်နှာအမူအရာ။ He didn't notice her expression. ❍ Her face wore a worried/ pained/ peculiar expression. ❍ ‘I don't understand,’ he said, (with) an expression of complete surprise on his face.၂။ (က) [U] ဖော်ပြခြင်း။ ထုတ်ဖော်ခြင်း။ the expression of grief ❍ The school encourages free expression in art,drama and creative writing. ❍ The poet's anger finds expression (ie expresses itself) in the last verse of the poem. (ခ) [C] (fml ) ထုတ်ဖော်ပြသမှု။ expressions of concern/ interest/ support ❍ I have not heard a single expression of regret.၃။ [C] စကားအသုံးအနှုန်း။ He has an irritating habit of using outdated English expressions to show his familiarity with the language. ❍ ‘Shut up’ (meaning ‘Stop talking’) is not a polite expression.၄။ [U] (တီးမှုတ်ရာ၊ ရွတ်ဆိုရာ၌) ခံစားမှုရသကို ပေါ်လွင်စေခြင်း။ recite a poem with expression ❍ She puts great expression into her violin playing. ❏ expressionless adj ခံစားမှုမပါသော။ အသက်မပါသော။ an expressionless face/ voice/ tone. Compare EXPRESSIVE
expressionism /Çk'spreʃǝnÇzǝm/ n [U](ပန်းချီ၊ ဂီတ၊ ရုပ်ရှင် စသည်တွင်) ခံစားမှုရသကို ဦးစားပေး ဖော်ကျူးသောဟန်။expressionist /-ʃǝnÇst/ adj, n : of the expressionist school ❍ expressionist art.

expressive /Çk'spresÇv/ adj၁။ ခံစားမှုကို ထိထိမိမိပြသော၊ ပြနိုင် သော။ အသက်ပါသော။ an expressive gesture ❍ an expressive piece of music ❍ He has a wonderfully expressive face. Compare EXPRESSIONLESS၂။ ~ of sth (fml ) ဖော်ဆောင်[သော]။ ဖော်ညွှန်း[သော]။ architecture expressive of the modern age ❍ His every word and gesture is expressive of a powerful sincerity. expressively adv expressiveness n [U]
expressway /Çk'spresweÇ/ (also thruway, freeway ) n (US )= MOTORWAY: a major accident on the expressway. ❍ ROAD

expropriate /eks'prǝƱprieÇt/v (fml or law )(အာဏာပိုင်က) လယ်ယာမြေ၊ ပစ္စည်း စသည် သိမ်းယူသည်။an expropriated landless labouring class ❍ The new regime expropriated his estate for military purposes. expropriation /eksprǝƱpri'eÇʃn/ n [U,C]
expulsion /Çk'spʌlʃn/ n ~ (from…) [U, C]နှင်ထုတ်ခြင်း။ ထုတ်ပစ်ခြင်း။The headteacher threatened him with expulsion. ❍ These clubs face expulsion from the league. ❍ the expulsions of senior diplomats.
expunge /Çk'spʌndʒ/ v ~ sth (from sth) (fml )ဖျက်ပစ်သည်။ ဖျောက်ပစ်သည်။Her name was permanently expunged from the records. ❍ (fig ) He found it hard to expunge the memory of those dreadful times.
expurgate /'ekspǝgeÇt/ vအငြိအစွန်းဖြစ်နိုင်သော စာပိုဒ်များကို စာအုပ်မှ ဖြုတ်ချန်သည်။an expurgated edition of a novel.

exquisite /Çk'skwÇzÇt, 'ekskwÇzÇt/ adj၁။ အလွန်လှပ သိမ်မွေ့ သော။ လက်ရာမြောက်သော။ an exquisite little painting/ piece of lace ❍ exquisite workmanship.၂။ (fml ) (က) ပြင်းပြစွာ ခံစားရသော။ အသည်းခိုက်သော။ exquisite pleasure/ pain. (ခ) (approv ) သိမ်မွေ့နူးညံ့သော။ စိတ်ထိခိုက် လွယ်သော။ exquisite tact/ taste ❍ an exquisite sense of timing. exquisitely adv : exquisitely tailored clothes.
ex-serviceman /eks 'sɜ:vÇsmǝn/ n(pl -men /-mǝn/; fem ex-servicewoman /-wƱmǝn/, pl -women /-wÇmÇn/)(esp Brit ) စစ်မှုထမ်းဟောင်း။an organization for ex-servicemen.
ext abbr EXTENSION: ext 4299.
extant /ek'stænt, 'ekstǝnt/ adj(အထူးသဖြင့် မှတ်တမ်းမှတ်ရာ) တည်ရှိနေဆဲ။the earliest extant account of the Arab conquests.

extempore /ek'stempǝri/ adj, advလက်တန်း။ ကောက်ကာ ငင်ကာ။an extempore speech. ❏ extemporize, -ise /Çk'stempǝraÇz/ v (fml ) လက်တန်းပြော သည်။ ကောက်ကာငင်ကာ လုပ်သည်။He forgot his words and had to extemporize. extemporization, -isation /ÇkstempǝraÇ'zeÇʃn; US -rǝ'z-/ n [U,C]

extend /Çk'stend/ v၁။ ချဲ့သည်။ ဆန့်သည်။ တိုးသည်။ ရှည်စေသည်။ extend a fence/ road/ garden ❍ There are plans to extend the no-smoking area. ❍ extend a deadline/ visa ❍ The government voted to extend the state of emergency for another six months. ❍ Careful maintenance can extend the life of your car by several years.၂။ တိုးချဲ့သည်။ The company plans to extend its operations into Europe. ❍ extend one's repertoire on the piano ❍ aiming to extend the technology.၃။ ဆက်နွှယ် စေသည်။ ပါဝင်ပတ်သက်စေသည်။ အကျုံးဝင်သည်။ The argument does not extend to politicians. ❍ His willingness to help did not extend beyond making a few phone calls. သူကူညီချင်တယ်ဆိုတာက တယ်လီဖုန်း တစ်ခါ နှစ်ခါ ဆက်ပေးရုံထက် မပိုပါဘူး။၄။ ~ sth to sb (fml ) (က) ရရှိစေသည်။ ပေးသည်။ organizations which extend credit to people ❍ extend citizenship to the immigrant community. (ခ) ကမ်းလှမ်းသည်။ လက်ကမ်းသည်။ extend hospitality to overseas students ❍ extend an invitation/ a warm welcome to sb.၅။ (က) ရောက်သည်။ တိုင်သည်။ The track extends (for) many miles into the desert. ❍ My backyard extends as far as the river. ❍ His writting career extended over a period of 40 years. (ခ) တန်းသည်။ သွယ်သည်။ extend a rope between two posts. (ဂ) (ခြေ၊ လက်) ဆန့်သည်။ ဆန့်ထုတ်သည်။ He extended his hand to (ie offered to shake hands with) the new employee.၆။ (esp passive) အစွမ်းကုန် ဆောင်ရွက်သည်။ Jim didn't really have to extend himself in the examination. ❍ Hospitals were already fully extended because of the epidemic. ❏ extendable adj တိုးနိုင်၊ ဆန့်နိုင်သော။ an extendable ladder ❍ extendable credit. ❏ extended adj တိုးထားသော။ ချဲ့ထားသော။ ဆန့်ထားသော။ go on extended leave/ an extended holiday ❍ the cost of extended hospital treatment. ❏ extended family n ထွေးတော်၊ မိကြီး၊ တူ၊ သားမြေးတို့ ပါဝင်သော မိသားစု။

extension /Çk'stenʃn/ n၁။ [U] တိုးချဲ့ခြင်း။ The extension of the subway will take several months. ❍ the extension of new technology into developing countries ❍ the extension of credit facilities.၂။ [C] (က) ~ (to sth) တိုးချဲ့အဆောင်၊ လမ်း စသည်။ build a 160bed extension to a hospital ❍ Our extension (ie the extension to our house) is nearly finished. ❍ (fig ) The characters she plays are only extensions of herself. သူ သရုပ်ဆောင်ထားတဲ့ ဇာတ်ရုပ်တွေဟာ တကယ်တော့ သူ့ရဲ့ကိုယ်ခွဲတွေပဲ။ (ခ) ~ (of sth) အချိန်၊ သက်တမ်း တိုးပေးခြင်း။The Chairman was voted a two-year extension of office. ❍ He's been given an extension to finish writing his thesis.၃။ [C] တယ်လီဖုန်းလိုင်းခွဲ။ She has an extension in the kitchen and in the bedroom. ❍ Phone me at the office — I'm on extension 326. ❏ by extension [IDM ] ဆက်၍။ တစ်ဆင့်တက်၍။ He criticized senior doctors, and by extension hospital administrators, for opposing the changes. ❏ extension lead n (လျှပ်စစ်ပစ္စည်းနှင့် ပလတ်ပေါက် အကြား) ကြားဆက်ကြိုး။

extensive /Çk'stensÇv/ adj၁။ ကျယ်ပြန့်သော။ ကျယ်ပြောသော။The house has extensive grounds.၂။ ကြီးကျယ်သော။ ကျယ်ကျယ်ပြန့်ပြန့် ဖြစ်သော။ cause extensive damage ❍ an extensive programme of reform ❍ make extensive alterations to a building ❍ Choose from our extensive range of bedroom furniture. ❍ Her knowledge of the subject is extensive. extensively adv : a spice used extensively in Eastern cookery ❍ He has travelled extensively in Europe.

extent /Çk'stent/ n [U]ပမာဏ။ အတိုင်းအတာ။I was amazed at the extent of his knowledge. ❍ He had not anticipated the full extent of the violence. ❏ to some, what, such an, a certain, etc extent [IDM ] အထိုက်အလျောက်။ သင့်သလောက်။ မည်မျှအထိ။ ဘယ်အထိ။To some extent we are all responsible for what has happened. ❍ To what extent can he be believed? ❍ The carpet was badly stained, to such an extent that (ie so much that ) you couldn't tell its original colour. ❍ I agree with you to a certain/ a limited extent, but…
extenuating /Çk'stenjueÇtÇŋ/ adjအပြစ်ဒဏ် လျှော့ပေါ့ သက်သာ စေသော။The charge was reduced from murder to manslaughter because of extenuating circumstances.

exterior /Çk'stÇǝriǝ(r)/ adjအပြင်ဘက်။the exterior walls of a house. Compare INTERIOR ၁, EXTERNALn ၁။ [sing] အပြင်ပန်း။ Underneath that hard exterior, says his wife, he is just a big softy.၂။ [C] အပြင်ဘက်။ pub exteriors ❍ The house has a Georgian exterior.
exterminate /Çk'stɜ:mÇneÇt/ vမျိုးဖြုတ်သည်။The indigenous population was virtually exterminated by settlers. ❍ What exterminated the dinosaur? extermination /Çkstɜ:mÇ'neÇʃn/ n [U]

external /Çk'stɜ:nl/ adj၁။ ပြင်ပ။ အပြင်ဘက်။ the external walls of the building ❍ an external television aerial ❍ for external use only (eg on the label of a pot of skin cream) ❍ All his injuries are external (ie He has not been injured inside his body).၂။ ပြင်ပ။ ပြည်ပ။ a tribe hardly affected by external influences ❍ a company's external financing ❍ external trade (ie with foreign countries) ❍ Canada's Minister for External Affairs ❍ an external examination (ie one set by an organization other than one's own school, etc) ❍ an external student (ie one registered with a university but studying privately and not attending a course there). Compare INTERNAL, EXTERIOR ❏ externalize, -ise /-nǝlaÇz/ v (fml ) စိတ်ထဲရှိသည်ကို သိစေသည်။externally /Çk'stɜ:nǝli/ adv :The building has been carefully restored externally. ❏ externals n [pl] (fml ) အပြင်ပန်း။Do not judge people by externals alone.

extinct /Çk'stÇŋkt/ adj (က) မျိုးသုဉ်းသွားသော။ ကွယ်ပျောက် တိမ်ကောသွားသော။an extinct species ❍ The red squirrel is now virtually extinct in England. ❍ (fig ) a wire-cage lift of a type that is almost extinct ❍ The old use of the word ‘gay’ to mean ‘happy’ is almost extinct.(ခ) (မီးတောင်)သေ။ extinction /Çk'stÇŋkʃn/ n [U, C]: a tribe threatened with extinction ❍ a species thought to be on the edge/ point/ verge of extinction ❍ save a plant from extinction ❍ the extinction of his youthful hopes.

extinguish /Çk'stÇŋgwÇʃ/ v (fml ) (က) ငြှိမ်းသည်။A sign flashed up telling them to extinguish their cigarettes. ❍ They tried to extinguish the flames.(ခ) အဆုံးသတ်စေ သည်။ ကွယ်ပျောက်စေသည်။ This defeat effectively extinguished all hopes of independence. ❍ His behaviour extinguished the last traces of affection she had for him. ❏ extinguisher n = FIRE EXTINGUISHER
extirpate /'ekstǝpeÇt/ v (fml )ပပျောက်စေသည်။ ဖယ်ရှား သုတ်သင်သည်။ extirpate terrorism/illiteracy.extirpation /ekstǝ'peÇʃn/ n [U]

extol /Çk'stǝƱl/ v (-ll- ) ~ sb (as sth) (fml )အထူးတလည် ချီးကျူးသည်။ ထောမနာပြုသည်။ အမွှမ်းတင်သည်။a report extolling the merits of small businesses ❍ Government ministers began to extol the virtues of British technology. ❍ He was extolled as a hero.
extort /Çk'stↄ:t/ v ~ sth (from sb)ခြိမ်းခြောက်၍ ငွေညှစ်သည်။extort money/bribes from sb.extortion /Çk'stↄ:ʃn/ n [U]: obtain money by extortion.
extortionate /Çk'stↄ:ʃǝnǝt/ adj (derog )(ဈေးနှုန်း၊ အတိုး စသည်) မတန်တဆ။offer loans at extortionate rates of interest ❍ The price of perfume is extortionate.

extra /'ekstrǝ/ adjပုံမှန်ထက်ပိုသော။ အပို။demand extra pay for extra work ❍ order an extra pint of milk ❍ The bus company provided extra buses because there were so many people. ❍ We need an extra £5 million a year to cover the costs of research. ❍ place an extra burden on the taxpayer ❍ Take extra care.adv ၁။ အလွန်အမင်း။ အထူး။an extra large helping of rice ❍ extra fine quality.၂။ အပိုဆောင်းလျက်။earn a bit extra this month ❍ charge/ pay 20 % extra ❍ price $ 6.30, postage and packing extra.n ၁။ အပိုပစ္စည်း။ အပိုကြေးပေးရသောအရာ။a new car with all the extras ❍ The price you pay for your excursion is the complete price; there are no hidden extras. ❍ School fees are £550 a term; music and dancing are optional extras.၂။ (ရုပ်ရှင်) ဝေလေလေအခန်းတွင် ပါရသူ။We need hundreds of extras for the battle scenes. ❏ extra time n [U] (sport ) အချိန်ပို။
extra- pref (with adjs )၁။ (ပြင်ပဖြစ်သော၊ ကျော်လွန်သော အနက်ရှိ ရှေ့ဆက်)။ extramarital ❍ extracurricular.၂။ (infml ) (အလွန်အထူးအနက်ရှိ ရှေ့ဆက်)။extra-thin ❍ extra-special.

extract /Çk'strækt/ v ~ sth (from sb/ sth)၁။ (က) ဆွဲနုတ်သည်။ ဆွဲထုတ်သည်။manage to extract a cork from a bottle ❍ He extracted a crumpled note from his pocket. ❍ have a tooth extracted. (ခ) နှိုက်ယူသည်။ ညှစ်ယူသည်။extract a contribution from everyone ❍ It took me days to extract the truth/ the information/ a confession from her.၂။ (နည်းစနစ်တစ်ခုဖြင့်) ထုတ်ယူသည်။extract juice from oranges/ oil from olives ❍ extract energy from the waves.၃။ ရွေးချယ်ထုတ်နုတ်သည်။ ကောက်နုတ် ဖော်ပြသည်။ She extracted passages for the students to translate./'ekstrækt/ n ၁။ [U,C] ထုတ်ယူ၍ရသော အဆီ၊ အနှစ်။ beef extract ❍ herbal extracts ❍ extract of malt.၂။ [C] ~ (from sth) ကောက်နုတ်ချက်။ ထုတ်နုတ်ချက်။ a short/ brief extract from a piano sonata ❍ an extract from ‘OliverTwist’ by Charles Dickens ❍ She read out extracts from his letters. ❏ extraction /Çk'strækʃn/ n၁။ (က) [U] နုတ်ခြင်း။ နှိုက်ယူခြင်း။ ထုတ်ယူခြင်း။ the extraction of a tooth ❍ the extraction of information ❍ the mineral extraction process at a mine. (ခ) [C] သွားနုတ်ခြင်း။ He needs two extractions.၂။ [U] (fml ) မျိုးရိုး။ an American of Hungarian extraction. ❏ extractor (also extractor fan ) n လေဆိုးထုတ် ပန်ကာ။
extracurricular /ekstrǝkǝ'rÇkjǝlǝ(r)/ adjသင်ရိုးပြင်ပ ဖြစ်သော။She's involved in many extracurricular activities, including music, sport and drama.

extradite /'ekstrǝdaÇt/ v ~ sb (to…) (from…)ပြစ်မှု ကျူးလွန်ခဲ့ရာ တိုင်းပြည်သို့ တရားခံကို လွှဲအပ်သည်။The government has refused to extradite a man wanted for a bank robbery in France. extradition /ekstrǝ'dÇʃn/ n [C, U]: seek the extradition of a suspected drug trafficker ❍ an extradition agreement/ treaty ❍ start extradition proceedings.
extramarital /ekstrǝ'mærÇtl/ adj(ကာမပိုင်ရှိလျက်) ဖောက်ပြန် သော။have extramarital affairs.

extramural /ekstrǝ'mjƱǝrǝl/ adj၁။ (esp Brit ) တက္ကသိုလ် အချိန်ပိုင်း ကျောင်းသား များ ပို့ချရေးနှင့် ဆိုင်သော။extramural studies/ lectures.၂။ (ပင်မ ဘာသာရပ်မဟုတ်သော) အပို ဘာသာရပ် အဖြစ် လေ့လာလိုက်စားသော။Some of our research students have extramural commitments.
extraneous /Çk'streÇniǝs/ adj ~ (to sth) (fml )တိုက်ရိုက် မသက်ဆိုင်သော။ အပယိက။ အပိုဆာဒါး။ cut out all extraneous information/ material/ details.
extraordinaire /Çkstrↄ:dÇ'neǝ(r)/ adj (approv often joc ) (following ns )ထူးခြားလှသော။ အံ့ချီးဖွယ်။ an opera for children from the musician extra- ordinaire Daryl Runswick.

extraordinary /Çk'strↄ:dnri; US -dǝneri/ adj၁။ သာမန်ထက် လွန်ကဲသော။ ထူးခြားသော။ အံ့မခန်းသော။ ဖြစ်ရိုးဖြစ်စဉ် မဟုတ်သော။ extraordinary weather for this time of year ❍ a most extraordinary story/ achievement/ spectacle ❍ a child born in extraordinary circumstances ❍ It seems quite extraordinary that the Prime Minister can claim these figures as a triumph.၂။ (fml ) အထူး။hold an extraordinary general meeting.၃။ (following ns ) (techn )အထူးခန့်ထားသော။ အထူး အာဏာပေးထားသော။ an ambassador extraordinary. extraordinarily /Çk'strↄ:dnrǝli;US -dǝnerǝli/ adv : extraordinarily beautiful/ diverse/ difficult/ effective ❍ Extraordinarily, the referee took no action.

extrapolate /Çk'stræpǝleÇt/ v ~ (sth) (from sth) (fml )(ရသမျှ အချက်အလက်ပေါ် အခြေခံ၍) တွက်ချက် ခန့်မှန်းသည်။They extrapolate a figure of at least 8000 vacant teaching posts (from responses to their questionnaire). ❍ We can extrapolate to some extent from present trends (to the future). extrapolation /Çkstræpǝ'leÇʃn/ n [C, U]: Extrapolations from results obtained in developed countries are invalid. ❍ CHART
extraterrestrial /ekstrǝtǝ'restriǝl/ adjအခြားကမ္ဘာဂြိုဟ်နှင့် ဆိုင်သော။ အခြားကမ္ဘာဂြိုဟ်မှ လာသော။extraterrestrial life/ beings.

extravagant /Çk'strævǝgǝnt/ adj၁။ (sometimes derog ) (က) အသုံးအဖြုန်းကြီးသော။ လက်ဖွာသော။ လက်ကြီးသော။ I only buy chocolates when I'm feeling extravagant. ❍ She's rather extravagant when it comes to buying perfume. (ခ) ယင်း သဘောဆောင်သော။ an extravagant five-course meal ❍ have extravagant tastes ❍ an extravagant use of natural resources.၂။ လွန်ကဲသော။ အလွန်အကျွံ။ တရားလွန်။ extravagant praise/ claims/ promises ❍ pay extravagant compliments. ❏ extravagance /-gǝns/ n၁။ [U] ဖြုန်းတီးမှု။ လက်ဖွာမှု။The government slashed public spending to make up for its past extravagance.၂။ [C] ခမ်းကြီးနားကြီး အစီအစဉ်၊ လုပ်ဆောင်ချက် စသည်။He can ill afford such extravagances. extravagantly adv : extravagantly dressed.
extravaganza /Çkstrævǝ'gænzǝ/ nမြင်ကွင်းရောင်စုံဖြင့် ခမ်းနား ကြီးကျယ်စွာ ခင်းကျင်း သောပွဲ။He's planning a multi-million dollar musical extravaganza.

extreme /Çk'stri:m/ adj၁။ (က) ထူးကဲသော။suffering from extreme anxiety ❍ a period of extreme coolness in diplomatic relations ❍ show extreme flexibility.(ခ) လွန်ကဲသော။ ပြင်းထန်သော။take extreme measures ❍ The child will be removed from its parents only in extreme cases. ❍ He promised he would not resort to anything as extreme as plastic surgery.(ဂ) (often derog )အစွန်း ရောက်သော။ တစ်ဖက်စွန်း ရောက်သော။an extreme nationalist organization ❍ hold extreme left-wing/ right-wing views ❍ His ideas are too extreme for me.၂။ ဝေးခေါင်ကွာလှမ်းသော။ အစွန်အဖျား။in the extreme north of a country ❍ at the extreme edge of the forest.n [C usu pl ]၁။ အစွန်းရောက်မှု။ တစ်ဖက်စွန်း။dealing with her extremes of mood ❍ The truth lies somewhere between these two extremes. ❍ She was once terribly shy but now she's gone to the opposite/other extreme.၂။ လွန်ကဲမှု။ ပြင်းထန်မှု။He could not tolerate the extremes of heat in the desert. ❏ extremely adv (usu with adjs and advs ) အလွန်အမင်း။ အလွန့်အလွန်။extremely complicated/ dangerous/ useful ❍ That's extremely unlikely ❍ I'm extremely sorry for the delay. ❍ He behaved extremely badly. ❏ extremism n [U] အစွန်းရောက်ဝါဒ။the dangers of political extremism. ❏ extremist n (usu derog )အစွန်းရောက်ဝါဒီ။ assassinated by extremists ❍ extremist policies. ❏ extremity /Çk'stremǝti/ n (fml )၁။ (က) [C] အစွန်အဖျား။ အစွန်း။at the camp's northern extremity.(ခ) extremities [pl] ခြေဖျားလက်ဖျား စသည်။ Cold affects the extremities first.၂။ [C, U] လွန်ကဲခြင်း။ reach an extremity/ the extremities of pain ❍ observe how people react in extremity or under pressure. ❏ go etc to extremes [IDM ] အစွန်းရောက်သည်၊ ရောက်စေ သည်။ In the jungle they were driven to extremes in order to survive. ❏ in the extreme [IDM ] (fml ) လွန်လွန်ကဲကဲ။ ပြင်းပြင်း ထန်ထန်။ I found his remarks about the cooking offensive in the extreme.
extricate /'ekstrÇkeÇt/ v ~ oneself/ sb/ sth (from sth) (fml )ကယ်ထုတ်သည်။ ကယ်တင်သည်။ လွတ်မြောက်စေသည်။The bird had to be extricated from the netting. ❍ extricate oneself from an unhappy love affair.
extrinsic /eks'trÇnsÇk, -trÇnzÇk/ adj ~ (to sth) (fml )နဂိုရှိရင်း မဟုတ်သော။ မူလမဟုတ်သော။ အပြင်အပမှဖြစ်သော။extrinsic evidence ❍ factors extrinsic to his work. Compare INTRINSIC
extrovert /'ekstrǝvɜ:t/ nဘွင်းဘွင်းပျော်ပျော်သမား။She's a good person to invite to a party because she's such an extrovert. Compare INTROVERTadj ယင်းစရိုက်ရှိသော။extrovert behaviour.

extrude /Çk'stru:d/ v၁။ (fml ) ညှစ်ထုတ်သည်။ ညှစ်ထည့်သည်။extrude glue from a tube ❍ If pressure is applied, the seal will extrude into the gap.၂။ (techn ) ပုံသွန်းသည်။ ပုံလောင်းသည်။nylon extruded as very thin fibres. extrusion /Çk'stru:ʒn/ n [C, U]

exuberant /Çg'zju:bǝrǝnt;US -'zu:-/ adj၁။ ရွှင်မြူးတက်ကြွ သော။ All evening she was witty and exuberant. ❍ an exuberant comic style ❍ an exuberant imagination.၂။ (အပင် စသည်) သန်စွမ်းသော။exuberant foliage. exuberance /-rǝns/ n [U]:We can excuse his behaviour as youthful exuberance. exuberantly adv

exude /Çg'zju:d;US -'zu:d/ v၁။ (ချွေး၊ အစေး၊ အနံ့) ထွက်သည်။Sweat exuded from him/ He exuded sweat. ❍ creatures that exude scents.၂။ စိတ်ခံစားချက်ကို ပွင့်ပွင့်လင်းလင်း ဖော်ထုတ် ပြသည်။She exudes confidence/ optimism.

exult /Çg'zʌlt/ v ~ (at/ in sth) (fml )ပျော်ရွှင်မြူးထူးသည်။Crowds exulted when victory was announced. ❍ The nation exulted at the team's success. ❍ He exulted in his role as national hero. ❏ exultant /-ǝnt/ adj ~ (at sth) မြူးထူးပျော်ရွှင်နေသော။an exultant shout/ mood ❍ The fans were exultant at their team's victory. exultantly adv ❏ exultation /egzʌl'teÇʃn/ n [U] ~ (at sth) ဝမ်းသာပီတိ။ ပီတိအဟုန်။carried along on a tide/ wave of exultation.
-ey❍ -Y

eye /aÇ/ n၁။ (က) မျက်စိ။ မျက်လုံး။I can't see out of this eye. ❍ She opened/ closed her eyes. ❍ He is blind in one eye. ❍ He lost an eye in the war. ❍ I have something in my eye. ❍ have an eye operation ❍ His eyes fell upon (ie He suddenly noticed) an advertisement in the magazine. (ခ) မျက်လုံးအရောင်။ have blue eyes.၂။ (က) [often pl ] အမြင်အား။ မျက်စိကောင်းခြင်း။You must have sharp eyes to be able to spot such a tiny detail. ❍ The eyes often deteriorate as one gets older. (ခ) [usu sing ] မျက်စိလျင် ခြင်း။ မြင်တတ်ခြင်း။ To her expert eye, the painting was clearly a fake. ❍ She has a good eye for a bargain.၃။ မျက်စိနှင့် တူသော အပေါက်၊ အဖု။The eye of a needle (ie the hole for the thread to go through) ❍ a hook and eye (ie a fastening with a hook and loop for a dress, etc) ❍ the eye of a potato (ie a point from which a shoot will grow).v (pres p eyeing or eying ) ကြည့်သည်။ He eyed me curiously/ warily. ❍ The children were eyeing the sweets hungrily. ❏ be all eyes [IDM ] စူးစူးစိုက်စိုက်ကြည့်သည်။ စိတ်ဝင်တစား ပြုံကြည့်သည်။The children were all eyes as we slowly unwrapped the parcel. ❏ clap/ lay/ set eyes on sb/ sth [IDM ] (infml ) မြင်သည်။ ကြည့်သည်။ I disliked the place the moment I clapped eyes on it. ❍ I hope I never set eyes on him again. ❏ my eye [IDM ] (infml ) (လက်မခံကြောင်း၊ မယုံကြောင်း ပြသောစကား)။ အဓိပ္ပာယ်မရှိလိုက်တာ။ အလကား။ မဟုတ်က ဟုတ်က။ သွားစမ်းပါ။She said she was only twenty-two — twenty-two my eye! ❏ eye-catching adjထင်းခနဲမြင်သာသော။ မျက်စိကို ဖမ်းစားသော။an eye-catching dress/ poster. ❏ -eyed (forming compound adjs )မျက်လုံး …နှင့်။ a blue-eyed girl ❍ a one-eyed man. See also BLACK EYE, PRIVATE EYE ❏ an eye for an eye (and a tooth for a tooth) [IDM ] သူ့နည်းအတိုင်းထပ်တူ တုံ့ပြန်လက်စားချေမှု။ The death penalty for murder works on the principle of an eye for an eye. ❏ eye-level adj မျက်စိနှင့် တည့်တည့်ဖြစ်သော။ မျက်စိနှင့် တစ်တန်းတည်း။ The oven has an eye level grill. ❏ eye-liner (also liner ) n လိုင်နာတောင့်။ ❏ the eye of the storm [IDM ] မုန်တိုင်းဗဟိုချက် ဖြစ်သည့် လေငြိမ်ရပ်။ ❏ eye-opener n မျက်စိဖွင့်ပေးလိုက်သော၊ အမြင်ကျယ်စေသော အတွေ့အကြုံ။ My trip to India was quite an eye-opener. ❏ sb's eyes are bigger than their stomach [IDM ] (saying ) ဗိုက်အိုးထက် လောဘမျက်စိ ကြီးသည်။ ❏ eye-shadow n [C, U] မျက်ခွံဆိုးဆေးတောင့်။ ❏ eye strain n [U] မျက်စိညောင်းညာခြင်း။ ❏ eye- tooth n (pl eye-teeth ) စွယ်သွား။ Compare CANINE n ❏ eye sb up [phrv ] (infml ) စိတ်ဝင်တစားကြည့်သည်။ I could see that she was eying me up as a potential customer. ❏ for sb's eye's only [IDM ] တစ်ဦးတည်း သီးသန့် ဖတ်ရှု ရန်။ The top secret file was marked 'for the President's eyes only'. ❏ get one's eye in [IDM ] (Brit ) အလေ့အကျင့်ရ၍ ဘောလုံး ဘယ်ရောက်ရောက် မြင်တတ်သွားသည်။ Once I'd got my eye in, I started to play better. ❏ give one's eye-teeth for sth [IDM ] လိုချင်သည်။ ရှိချင် သည်။ ပိုင်ချင်သည်။ I'd give my eye-teeth to own a car like that. ❏ have/ with an eye for/ on/ to the main chance [IDM ] (Brit ) (ငွေ)ရပေါက်ရလမ်း မြင်တတ်သည်။ ❏ have one's eye on sb [IDM ] မျက်လုံးဒေါက်ထောက် ကြည့်သည်။ I've got my eye on you, so you'd better behave. ❏ have one's eye on sth [IDM ] မျက်စိကျသည်။ I'm thinking of buying a car — there's a nice new model I've got my eye on. ❏ have eyes in the back of one's head [IDM ] မျက်စိရှင် သည်။ မြင်တတ်သည်။ How did you know I was behind you? You must have eyes in the back of your head. ❏ have/ with an eye to sth/ doing sth [IDM ] အကြံရှိ သည်။ ရည်ရွယ်သည်။ He always has an eye to business (ie looks for a chance of doing business). ❍ He kept the customer talking with an eye to selling him something else. ❏ have/ with half an/ one eye on sth [IDM ] အာရုံတခြား ရောက်လျက်။ စိတ်မပါ့တပါ။ I only had half an eye on the programme because Iwas reading the paper. ❏ in the eyes of sb/ in sb's eyes [IDM ] …အမြင်၌။ In the eyes of the critics, he can do no wrong. ❏ in the eyes of the law, world, etc [IDM ] …ရှုထောင့်မှ ကြည့်လျှင်။ In the eyes of the law she is guilty though few ordinary people would think so. ❏ keep an eye on sb/ sth [IDM ] စောင့်ကြည့်သည်။ ကြည့်ထားသည်။ Could you keep an eye on my suitcase for a moment? ❏ keep an eye open/ out (for sb/ sth) [IDM ] (infml ) သတိထား၍ ကြည့်သည်။ ဂရုတစိုက် ရှာကြည့်သည်။ I've lost my ring — could you keep an eye out for it when you clean the house? ❏ keep one's eyes peeled/ skinned (for sb/ sth) [IDM ] စူးစူးစိုက်စိုက် သေသေချာချာ ကြည့်သည်။ အထူး သတိထားကြည့်သည်။ She walked along slowly, keeping her eyes peeled/ skinned for any unusual flowers. ❏ look sb in the eye(s) face [IDM ] စေ့စေ့ကြည့်သည်။ မျက်နှာတည့်တည့်ကြည့်သည်။ မျက်လုံးချင်း ဆိုင်ကြည့်သည်။ Can you look me in the eye and tell me you're not lying? ❍ He couldn't bear to look her in the face. ❏ make eyes at sb [IDM ] ကြာကြည့်ကြည့်သည်။ ကြာပစ် သည်။ မျက်စပစ်သည်။ He made eyes at her across the room. ❏ never/ not (be able to) take one's eyes off sb/ sth [IDM ] မျက်တောင်မခတ် စိုက်ကြည့်သည်။ မျက်စိအောက်က အပျောက်မခံ ကြည့်သည်။ She never took her eyes off him the whole evening. ❏ one in the eye (for sb/ sth) [IDM ] (infml ) ဆုံးရှုံးမှု။ စိတ်ပျက်လက်ပျက်ဖြစ်စရာ။ လက်မှိုင်ချခြင်း။ If she gets the job, it'll be one in the eye for Peter: he thought he was bound to get it. ❏ only have eyes for/ have eyes only for sb [IDM ] တစ်မိုးအောက်တစ်ယောက် ထင်သည်။ သူမှသူ တမ်းတမ်းစွဲ ကြိုက်သည်။ It's no use asking Kim to go out with you: she only has eyes for Mark. ❏ (not) see eye to eye with sb [IDM ] သဘောချင်း (မ)တိုက်ဆိုင်။ အမြင်(မ)တူ။ Jim and I have always seen eye to eye on politics ❍ She left because she didn't see eye to eye with her boss. ❏ see, look at, etc sth through sb's eyes [IDM ] သူ့နေရာက ဝင်ကြည့်သည်။ သူ့ရှုထောင့်က ကြည့်သည်။ ။ If you saw the situation through my eyes, you'd realize why I'm so angry. ❏ shut/ close one's eyes to sth [IDM ] မမြင်ကျိုးကျွန်၊ မသိကျိုးကျွန်ပြုသည်။ မျက်နှာလွှဲထားသည်။ The government shuts its eyes to poverty. ❍ She closed her eyes to her husband's infidelities. ❏ with one's eyes open [IDM ] (ဘာဖြစ်လာနိုင် မယ်ဆိုတာ) သိပြီးသား။ သိသိကြီးနှင့်။ သိလျက်နှင့်။ I moved to this country with my eyes open, so I'm not complaining. ❏ with one's eyes shut/ closed [IDM ]၁။ မျက်စိမှိတ်လျက် (လုပ်နိုင်သည်)။ (ငှက်ပျောသီး အခွံနွှာ စားရသလို) လွယ်လွယ် ကလေး။ He's cooked that meal so often he can do it with his eyes closed.၂။ ဘာသိဘာသာ။ နမော်နမဲ့။ If you go around with your eyes shut, you never learn anything about life.
eyeball /'aÇbↄ:l/ nမျက်ဆန်။ ❏ eyeball to eyeball (with sb) [IDM ]ဒေါသနှင့် အပြန် အလှန် ကြည့်သည်။They confronted each other eyeball to eyeball.
eyebrow /'aÇbraƱ/ nမျက်ခုံး။ pluck one's eyebrows.

eyeful /'aÇfƱl/ n (pl -fuls )၁။ မျက်စိနှင့်အပြည့်။ get an eyeful of sand.၂။ (infml ) အားပါးတရ ရှုဖွယ် မြင်ကွင်း။ ရှုမဝ။ She's quite an eyeful! ❏ have/ get an eyeful (of sth) [IDM ] (infml ) အားရပါးရ ကြည့်သည်။ တစ်ဝကြီးကြည့်သည်။ Come and get an eyeful of this — there's a giraffe in the garden!
eyeglass /'aÇglɑ:s; US -glæs/ nမျက်လုံးတစ်ဖက်တပ် မျက်မှန်။The old man wore an eyeglass attached to a piece of ribbon.
eyelash /'aÇlæʃ/ (also lash ) nမျက်တောင်။She was wearing false eyelashes (ie artificial ones stuck to the eyelids).
eyelet /'aÇlǝt/ n(ကြိုး၊ အပ်ချည် ထိုးရာ) နဖားပေါက်။
eyelid /'aÇlÇd/ (also lid ) nမျက်ခွံ။ His eyelid is swollen.
eyepiece /'aÇpi:s/ n(တယ်လီစကုပ်၊ မိုက်ခရိုစကုပ်) ကြည့်ပေါက်။ ❍ MICROSCOPE
eyesight /'aÇsaÇt/ n [U]အမြင်အား။ have good/ bad/ poor eyesight.
eyesore /'aÇsↄ:(r)/ nမျက်စိစပါးမွေးစူးစရာ။That old factory is a real eyesore!

fact / fækt / n ၁။ [C] အမှန်တရား။No one can deny the fact that fire burns. ❍ Poverty and crime are facts. ❍ I know for a fact (ie I know that it is really true) that he's involved in some illegal activities. ❍ I won't come here again, and that's a fact! ❍ The judge instructed both lawyers to stick to the facts of the case.၂။ [ C ] ဖြစ်ရပ်မှန်။ အဖြစ်။The fact that I couldn't speak the language made things very difficult for me. ❍ In spite of the fact that he had never played the game before, he played well. ❍ In view of the fact that it's getting late, ❍ we'll end the meeting now.၃။ [ C ] အချက်အလက်။If you're going to make accusations, you'd better get your facts right (ie make sure they are correct).၄။ [U] အကယ်ရှိသောအရာ။ အဖြစ်မှန်။ ဖြစ်ရပ်မှန်။ The story is founded on fact. ❍ It's important to distinguish fact from fiction. ❏ fact-finding adj အဖြစ်မှန် ဖော်ထုတ်ရန်။go on a fact-finding mission/tour. ❏ the fact (of the matter) is (that)… [IDM ] ဖြစ်ရပ်မှန်ကတော့။A new car would be wonderful but the fact of the matter is (that) we can't afford one. ❍ I agree that he tried hard. Nevertheless, the fact remains that he has not finished the job on time. ❏ a fact of life [IDM ]လောကတံတွာ ဓမ္မတာ တရား။We must all die some time—that's just a fact of life. ❏ fact-sheet nအကြောင်းအရာ အချက်အလက် အချုပ်။For further details, write in for our free fact-sheet. ❏ facts and figures [IDM ]ခိုင်လုံသော အချက်အလက်။Before we make a decision, we need more facts and figures. ❏ the facts of life (euph ) [IDM ] လောကတံတွာ ဖိုမကိစ္စ။ ❏ the facts speak for themselves [IDM ] ရှင်းနေတာ ဘာအထူးပြောစရာ လိုသေးလဲ။ ❏ in (actual) fact [IDM ] အမှန်အားဖြင့်။ တကယ်တော့။ I thought the work would be difficult.
